O Lord Siva, you are beyond the three gunas, Prakrti are absolute, unblemished, and perform several sports. You are the Divine Being.

O Mahadeva, you kindly save me from this sin. My father and brothers have become evil- minded.”

Brahma said, “At the prayer to Siva, offered by Dharma, then Brahma himself arrived for the protection of dharma.

Siva finding me arriving with Daksa and others, through the sky laughed in his mind at me.

Expressing his gratitude to them all and laughing again and again, O Sage, putting all of us to shame,

Siva said, “O Brahma, how could the passions arise in you seeing at your own daughter? A person who is well-versed in the Vedas, should not feel lustful at the sight of a giri.

As for example, evil eye should not be cast over one’s own mother, sister, wife of the brother, one’s own daughter.

The decision of the Vedic path is very much before you. O Brahma, how could you forget the same at the rising of the lustful thought?

O Brahma, why could you not develop the patience, because of which you were overtaken by the degraded Kama and became desirous of a union.

How could the mind of Daksa who always looks at the sun, Marici and others, get attracted towards a woman?

Then how could the evil-minded and degraded soul Kamadeva, with his sharp arrows, create blemish in them?

Disgrace to him and the knowledge of the Sastras attained by the one whose mind is captivated by a woman and removing his patience makes his mind unstable?”

Brahma said, “Thus listening to the words of Siva, the lord of the three worlds, I felt doubly shameful and my body started perspiring.

Thereafter even after my being desirous of Sandhya- the passionate one, I discarded her because of the fear of Siva.

At that point of time the drops of perspiration fell from my body, which gave birth to the manes known as Agnisvatta and other ascetics who did not perform the sacrifices while living on earth. They were shone like the split collyrium, had eyes resembling the full blown lotus, were meritorious and averse to the worldly activities.

They were sixty three in number, O Sage, and the manes called Barhisads, seated on grass were eighty six thousand in number.

From the body of Daksa Prajapati, sweat fell, from which a beautiful damsel possessing all the virtues, emerged.

She was slander waisted and had symmetrical hips. Her waist was well built, well shaped, small curly hair decorated her head. Her body was soft and her teeth were white. She had a complexion of molten gold. Her face was like the full moon and fully blossomed lotus flower. She was known as Rati and could captivate with her beauty even the great ascetics.

Excepting Kratu, Vasistha, Pulastya, and Angiras the six rsis like Marici and others controlled their sense organs. O best of sages! the semen of Kratu etc. four fell on earth, and other manes were born from the same.

The were Somapas, Ajyapas, Kalins and Havisman, who are called also Kavyavahas. They are their sons.

Somapas was born as son of Kratu, Kalins to Vasistha, Ajyapas to Pulastya and Havisyaman of Angiras.

O Best of the Brahmanas, with the birth of manes like Agnisvata, etc. they were assigned the job of Kavyavahas among the manes.

Siva then found the faultless Sandhya who was quite religious minded, engaged in her aim, and the mother of manes.

Thereafter, being graceful on all the Brahmanas, and after protecting the Dharma appropriately, Lord Siva disappeared.

After the departure of Siva, I (Brahma) curving my eye brows, I was enraged at Kamadeva.

At this, Kamadeva, looking at my face and understanding my intentions, O Sage, getting afraid of Siva, stopped the shooting of the arrows.

O Sage, then having been born of the lotus flower, he started burning with the fire of anger, as the fire goes in flames to bum others.

Then Brahma said, “This Kamadeva, overpowered with his arrogance, would exercise his strength over Mahadeva, and would be reduced to ashes with the fire of his eyes.

O Brahmana, these words which could not be forgiven, were spoken by Brahma, before the sages who had controlled all the sense organs, besides the manes.

Thus listening to the terrific curse pronounced by Brahma, Kamadeva left the shooting of the arrows, then and there, appeared at once at the same place.

O Sage, he, becoming free from the arrogances, spoke in presence of my sons Daksa and others, the manes, as well as Sandhya.

Kamadeva said, “O Brahma, O Lord of the universe, why have you pronounced such a terrific curse on an innocent person like me, the follower of the path of justice?

O Brahma, whatever job had been assigned by you to me, I did the same and nothing else. Therefore, it would not be proper for you to pronounce a curse on me.

You had spoken that both Brahma and Visnu would be victims of my arrows. I had only tested the truthfulness of your words.

O Brahma, O Deva, O Lord of the Universe, I am quite innocent, what is my fault? Therefore, the time and the curse are both painful.”

Thus listening to the words of Kamadeva, I, the lord of the universe, advised him again and again.

Brahma said, “You looked at my daughter named Sandhya with voluptuous eyes. This has resulted in my pronouncing a curse to you.

O Kamadeva, I have now been freed from anger. Therefore, I tell you, that getting free from fear and doubt, you be comfortable.

O Kamadeva, you would be reduced to ashes with the fire of the eyes of Siva, no doubt, thereafter you would again get your body back.

After the marriage of Siva, you would automatically get your body back,”

I being the Grandsire of the universe, after speaking these words to Kamadeva, disappeared from that place.

Thus listening to my words, Kamadeva and the mind-born sages, felt comfortable and left for their respective abodes.

## Chapter 4 - Marriage of Kamadeva

Narada said, “O Disciple of Visnu, 0 Immensely intelligent one, O Destiny, and the lord creation of the universe, you have narrated the surprising story of the sports of Siva, which are like the nectar.

O Dear one, what happened thereafter? You please tell me. I am interested in the listening to the story of Siva.”

Brahma said, “After Siva left for his abode, and Brahma disappeared from the scene, then Daksa Prajapati, having been reminded of my words, said to Kamadeva.

Daksa Prajapati said, “O Kamadeva, you better make this damsel your wife, who is quite beautiful, possesses all the virtues and has been born out of my body. She compares well with our temperament.

She is quite illustrious, and would always move along with you. She would always be under your command as per your will as well as the dharma.

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, he created a damsel out of his sweet, and giving her the name of Rati and presented her before Kamadeva.

O Narada, Kamadeva, after marrying the daughter of Daksa Prajapati, known as Rati, was immensely delighted.

Thereafter find Rati, his wife to be favourable according to his virtues, Kamadeva became passionate for her.

She was of fair complexion, tremulous side glances, and eyes resembling the fawns. She admirably suited to his love of pleasure and offered him sufficient sports.

Looking at her eyebrows, Kamadeva developed a doubt whether, the destiny had placed them over her face just to insult his bow?

O Dear one, her side-glances, moved swiftly. Looking at her beauty he lost faith in the movement of his weapons.

Enjoying her natural beauty and the fragrant breath, Kamadeva became disinterested in the wind of the Malaya mountain.

She had all the auspicious symbols, her face resembled the full moon. Therefore, looking at her face Kamadeva was unable to distinguish between the moon and her face.

Like the bud of the golden lotus, her breasts with nipples appeared like the bees hovering over them.

Kamadeva had kept aside and forgotten the string his flowery bow with tumultuous humming sound of the bees because her eyes were riveted to the auspicious necklace with eyes of the peacock’s tail suspended over her firm protruding plump breasts down to her umbilical part.

Her navel was quite deep and two eyes appeared like the two red lotus flowers over her lotus like face.

Kamadeva, looked at the slander waisted damsel, who had the gold complexion by nature, like the golden pedestal.

Her both the thighs resembled the trunks of the banana tree, and were quite pleasant. Kamadeva looked at them like his own strength.

The heels of the feet of Rati and the fore parts of her feet, were of red colour, and looking at them, Kamadeva became friendly to them.

Her both hands resembling the kimsuka flowers were red and with well rounded tapering fingers were quite beautiful.

Both her arms resembled the lotus stalk, which were soft and glossy. They resembled corals putting forth beams of splendour. Her hair was black like the clouds or resembled the tail of the Camar cow and were quite long. Because of the long hair the beloved of Kamadeva looked quite beautiful.

As the Ganga emerging from the Himalaya was housed by Siva (over his head) similarly, Kamadeva accepted Rati, quite delightfully.

Her hands were embossed with Cakra and the lotus and her arms resembled the lotus stalk, and both her eye-brows resembled the waves of the Ganga.

Her eyebrows resembled walvets. Her eyes resembled the lotus flowers, her curly locks of hair falling over the body resembled the mossy growth in the river. She could dwell in the mind like a tree.

She had a deep navel resembling a lake, a slander waist, all her limbs were beautiful, was the abode of all the beauties and as such she appeared graceful like Laksmi.

She was adorned with twelve types of ornaments. She was well-versed in the sixteen types of amorous gestures and could charm all the lokas with her beauty. Besides she could illumine all the directions with her lustre.

Thus observing Rati in this way, Kamadeva, enthusiastically accepted her in the same way, as lord Visnu had accepted Laksmi, who had lovingly arrived to him.

He, having been overpowered with delight forgot the terrific curse pronounced on him by Brahma, Kamadeva did not speak anything to Daksa Prajapati.

O Narada, at that time a function was organised which increased the delight. Daksa felt quite happy at that time and same was the case with Rati- his daughter.

Kamadeva also having been filled with delight, forgot all the pain of his heart. Thus the daughter of Daksa Prajapati was extremely happy by getting Kamadeva as her husband.

The sweet tongued Kamadeva, appeared unique with Rati at that time, as the clouds appear in the evening time with lightning.

In this way, Kamadeva, having been overpowered with the virtues of Rati, gave her space in his heart, as the yogis lodge vidya (wisdom) in their hearts. Rati also on the other hand after having the husband (like Kamadeva) looked graceful as Kamala having moon like face feels delighted by getting Visnu.

## Chapter 5 - The story of Sandhya

Suta said, “On hearing the words of Brahma, the excellent sage remembered Siva with a delighted heart and spoke with pleasure.

Narada said, “O Brahma, O Exalted one, O Disciple of Visnu, possessing enormous intelligence, you have narrated the astonishing sports of Siva.

Kamadeva, after getting the wife, and after the departure of Daksa Prajapati to his abode, and your mind born sons to their respective abodes, where did Sandhya, the daughter of Brahma go, and what did she do thereafter. To whom did she marry? You kindly narrate the entire story of Sandhya?”

Suta said, “Thus listening to the intelligent son’s words, remembering Siva with devotion, Brahma, to whom all the secrets were known, said, “O Narada, you listen to the complete story of Sandhya, hearing which all the ladies become chaste.

Sandhya was initially been born out of my mind. Subsequently she performed penance, and leaving that body, she was reborn in the next birth as Arundhati.

She, the intelligent one then became the daughter of the sage Medhatithi. Accepting the words of Brahma, Visnu and Siva, she started performing penance.

She, the beautiful one sought for Vasistha as her husband and thereafter she became adorable by all as a chaste lady.”

Narada said, “Where did Sandhya perform the penance and for what purpose? How did she put an end to her body and how did she become the daughter of the Medhatithi?

How did she accept Vasistha as her husband at the advice of Brahma, Visnu and Siva?

O Brahma, you kindly speak out the story of Arundhati, correctly to me because I am quite anxious to hear about the same.”

Brahma said, “When I first had a look at my daughter Sandhya, then my mind became lustful, but getting afraid of Siva, I discarded her.

On the other hand the minds of the great sages who had controlled all the senses, had also been disturbed at the sight of Sandhya.

Listening to the words of Siva, filled with mockery about me, she had realised that her mental aberration in regard to the sages was beyond decency. She had witnessed the behaviour of Kamadeva, resulting in the delusion of the sages, frequently. Sandhya was therefore, exceedingly distressed about her marriage.

O Sage, then Kama was cursed by me, then Siva left the place and I also disappeared from the site. Under these circumstances, her support was totally lost and she became furious. Sandhya- my daughter, thought about all these things and meditated for long on the recent events. Then, she of great fortitude was mused as to what was to be done in the given circumstances?

Sandhya said, “Soon after my birth, finding me quite youthful, my father having been overpowered with lust, desired to have me as his wife.

Besides the sages and the rsis born out of the mind of Brahma, were also filled with passions, at my sight, crossing the limits of decency.

Wicked Kamadeva also made my own mind lustful, as a result of which, on seeing the sages my mind became excessively shaken.

Kamadeva has already achieved the reward of the sin, who has been cursed by Brahma.

I also being sinful would surely reap the reward of the sin. I am also desirous of the destruction of this sin, that my father and my brothers became desirous of me, at my sight, therefore, there is no sinner greater than me on earth.

Besides, my own mind crossing all the limits looking at my own father and brothers, developed the feeling of a husband for them.

I shall myself repent for this sin. I shall burn my body in the fire as per the provision of the Vedas.

But I shall establish a tradition on earth by following which the people would not become lustful.

For this purpose, I shall perform severe tapas. I shall establish the tradition and then end my life.

The body, observing which my father and brothers, became desirous of having me, I have nothing to do with that body.

My body for which my father and brothers became desirous, no good deed could be performed with the same.”

Thus thinking, Sandhya went to a mountain known as Candrabhaga which is the place of origin of the river Candrabhaga.

Thereafter Sandhya started performing penance over that mountain. Learning about it, I (Brahma) spoke to the sage Vasistha, who was well-versed in Vedic and post Vedic literature, who had controlled all his senses, who was omniscient, knowledgeable and a yogi, who was seated besides me.”

Brahma said, “O Son of Vasistha, you bestow proper diksa (initiate duly) to Sandhya, my daughter, approaching her who is proceeding for the performing of tapas.

O great Sage, formerly seeing you all and me as her lovers and realising her own lustful feelings she had blushed.

Having been overpowered with the unprecedented evil conduct, she is presently desirous of ending her life.

By performing penance, she would establish a limit among those who observe limits and conventions. The chaste lady has gone to the mount Candrabhaga for the performing of penance.

She is not aware of the method of performing the penance, O Dear, you see that she attains her goal by means of your instructions.

O Sage, discarding your present form, you go to her in another form and you display to her the form of performing the penance.

She is well aware of the present form of both of us, therefore, she would never accept one in the present form. Therefore, you better take to some other form.”

Brahma said, “O Narada, in this way, the compassionate Vasistha at my command, said, “I shall do so,” and then went to Sandhya.

Reaching there Vasistha found the divine lake filled with the virtues like the lake of Manasarovara, besides Sandhya seated there over its bank.

The lake was beautified with the lotus flowers, but because of the presence of Sandhya there, it looked more beautiful, as the sky appears in the dusk with the moon rising and the twinkling of the stars.

The sage having been filled with anxiety looked at the red lake filled with the lotus flowers as well as Sandhya.

He also saw the river Candrabhaga, on the southern side, flowing towards the ocean.

As the Ganga flows towards the ocean, emerging from the Himalaya, similarly the river Candrabhaga, breaking through the western wing of the mountain, flows towards the ocean.

Close to the red lake over the Candrabhaga mountain, Vasistha asked Sandhya respectfully, who had been seated close to the lake.

Vasistha said, “O Lady with simple temperament, what for have you arrived over the auspicious spot of the mountain? Whose daughter are you? What have you thought?

I would like to listen to you. In case there be no secret, then tell me how have your moon like bright face faded out?”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of the sage Vasistha, and finding him like the flames of burning fire, Sandhya, offered her salutation to the brahmacari, having locks of hair over his head, an ascetic and then said.

Sandhya said, “O Lord, the purpose for which I had arrived over the mountain, has been fulfilled by an audience with you.

I have arrived here in this lonely forest for the performing of the tapas. I happen to be the daughter of Brahma, well known by the name of Sandhya.

In case you don’t feel troubled then you kindly deliver some discourse to me. This is my secret desire. I am not concerned with anything else.

I have arrived in this forest unaware of the method of performing of penance. Because of this I feel perplexed and my heart is shaking.”

Brahma said, “When Vasistha, the foremost of the great ascetics, heard the words of Sandhya, then he put her no more questions, because, everything else was already well known to him.

Then remembering in his mind, the lord Siva, who is well disposed towards his devotees who was always engaged in tapas, then said to Sandhya.

Vasistha said, “Siva possesses the best of lustre, who is known as the biggest tapas, who is supreme and deserves to be adored supremely, you should meditate upon him in your mind.

You should recite the name of the same Purusottama, who is the cause of dharma, artha, kama and moksa besides being the eternal cause of the universe.

O Damsel with beautiful face, adore lord Siva, who is the lord of the Devas, with the following mantra, by which you will surely achieve everything. There is no doubt about it.

The mantra is- “om namah Sahkaraya om”. Keeping silent, you should recite this mantra in your mind, performing tapas. You listen to me the special method for the same.

Keeping silent you should take your bath and worship Siva. the food taken should totally comprise of water in the first and the second sastakalas (i.e. four hours of the day).

On the third sastakala, you should observe complete fast. (Even water is not to be taken). This shall continue till the completion of the penance. The rites shall be performed at the end of the each of the sastakala.

This is called the adoration of silence and yields all the benefits of the celibate life. O Damsels, it fulfills all the desires. This is true, there is no doubt about it.

Keeping this goal in your mind, O Damsel, you worship lord Siva well. The moment he is pleased he would fulfil all your desires.”

Brahma said, “Then Vasistha, explained to Sandhya, the entire method of performing penance. Thereafter the sage vanished from the scene.

## Chapter 6 - Siva pleased with the worship of Sandhya

Brahma said, “O Intelligent one, O Best son, now you listen to the great tapas performed by Sandhya, hearing which the heaps of sins get destroyed.

Listening to the method of the performance of the penance, and after the departure of Vasistha to his respective abode, Sandhya, learning the method of the performing of tapas felt immensely delighted at heart.

Turning to the form of an ascetic, she sat over the bank of Brhallohita lake, and started performing the tapas with pleasure.

The mantra which had been given by Vasistha, for the success of the penance, (was patronised by her) and she started adoring Siva, reciting that mantra.

Concentrating her mind at the feet of lord Siva, Sandhya kept on adoring Siva with a devoted mind and while doing so, four yugas elapsed.

With the performing of her tapas, Siva displaying his true form to her within, and outside as well as in the sky, felt immensely pleased.

The form in which she adored the lord, Siva appeared in the same form.

Thereafter she found lord Siva, appearing before her in his peaceful form, as per her own imagination, which delighted her the most.

Becoming nervous, she thought, “What should I speak? How should I pray to lord Siva?” Thus thinking, she closed her eyes.

Then Siva entered the heart of Sandhya, who had closed her eyes and bestowed on her the divine knowledge, the divine speech, and the divine vision.

Then having been bestowed with the divine knowledge, divine vision and divine speech, she offered prayer to lord Siva, the spouse of Parvati and the lord of the universe.”

Sandhya said, “O Lord, you are formless, could be known only by the true knowledge, you are neither gross nor subtle, and neither high. Therefore the yogis keep on thinking about your form. You are the creator of the universe, salutation to you.

You are peaceful, spotless, unblemished, beyond the (human) knowledge, unblemished in your lustre, well-versed in the path leading to Para-brahmans, beyond the path of darkness, and having a delightful mind. Salutation to you.

Your form is solitary, pure, luminous, free from illusion, knowledge-cum-bliss, undecaying by nature, eternal blissful, you are delighted at the outcome of the truth and prosperity. You purify even the pure ones. I offer my salutation to this form of the lord.

Your form can be imagined with the application of the true knowledge, which is different from insentient things. You are the form of sattva, to be meditated upon, the form of the soul, which is the utmost essence and which is the holiest of the holy things. Salutation to you.

You are a yogi with pure Saguna form, lovely, bedecked in jewels, as well as the camphor, and which holds in his hands the attributes of abhayamudra, trident, human head, salutation to such a form of a yogi.

You have the forms as the sky, the earth, the directions, water, flames, and eternal time. Salutation to you.

Salutation to Siva of unmanifest form from whom unmanifest primordial nature and Purusa issued forth as its effect.

The one who creates the universe in the form of Brahma, preserves it in the form of Visnu and destroys it as Rudra, salutation to you again and again.

You are the cause of all the causes, bestowers of the divine nectar like wisdom and prosperity, bestower of the fortunes of the people of the world, form of lustre, besides being the greatest of the great, salutation to you.

From whose feet, have emerged the earth, directions, the sun, the moon, Kamadeva, Bahirmukha and other gods, the sky from the navel as well as the universe, salutation to such a lord like you.

O Siva, you are the greatest of the great, the supreme soul, besides being the form of the various types of knowledge. You are the pure Brahman, the supreme Brahman and the utmost object of deliberation.

How can I fully pray to lord Siva, who is beyond beginning, middle or the end, from whom the entire universe has emerged and who is beyond the mind and speech?

Whose form is beyond the description of Brahma and other gods, the ascetics and the sages, how could I be able to describe his form.

Your form which had been beyond the comprehension of the gods and the asuras, how could a woman like me know about your form?

O Lord, you are the personification of penance, salutation to you. O Lord of the gods, O Siva, salutation to you again and again.”

Brahma said, “The lord who is favourably disposed towards his devotees, Parmesvara, lord Siva felt extremely delighted, hearing the prayer of Sandhya.

Her body was covered with bark of the trees and deer-hide and her head was decorated with the matted locks of hair.

Her face resembled the lotus flower that fades out with the snow fall. Looking at her, the compassionate Siva said.

Mahesvara said, “O Gentle Damsel, your prayer and tapas has delighted me the most. Now you ask for a boon.

You ask for the desired boon. I am extremely pleased with your tapas. Let you meet with welfare.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the delightful words of Siva, Sandhya was pleased and she offered her salutation to him again and again.”

Sandhya said, “O Mahesvara, in case I have been purified from that sin, in case I am fit to be blessed with a boon, and in case you lovingly intend to bestow a boon on me, in case you are pleased with my penance, then I ask for the first boon, which you kindly give me.

O Lord of the gods, after the birth let no living being born on earth, be full of lust at the time of nativity.

There is another boon desired by me that no other woman in the world, shall become famous in the three worlds as I have become or shall become in future.

No creation of mine shall be lustful or degraded. O Lord, whosoever be my husband, should be friendly to me.

Whosoever a person, except my husband, would cast a passionate glance at me, would fail in all his efforts and become a eunuch.”

On hearing the words of the woman, who had been absolved of the sins by Siva, who is kind to his devotees and was delighted at the words spoken by Sandhya, told her.

“O Damsel, O Sandhya, listen, your sin has been reduced to ashes. I have absolved you of my anger towards you. By this penance, you have been purified.

O Beautiful Sandhya, whatever boons you have desired, I have given you getting pleased with your tapas.

You would enjoy the infancy, childhood, youthful as well as the old ages like all human beings.

After reaching the third stage of life, the living beings shall become lustful. Sometimes it could be at the end of the second stage.

This is the new limitation prescribed by me because of your penance. No living being shall be lustful at the stage of his nativity.

You would acquire the type of chastity, which could never be achieved by any other woman in the world.

Except your husband, whosoever would look at you with lustful eyes, he would become weak in his body and turned as a enunch.

Your husband would be a great ascetic with a beautiful body and would remain alive with you for three kalpas.

Thus whatever boon has been desired by you have been granted by me. Besides this, I shall narrate the events of your earlier birth.

It has already been decided that you would bum your body in fire. I shall speak out the method for the same, which should be followed by you without hesitation.

The sage Medhatithi is performing a twelve year yajna in which the eternal fire is burning. You should go and sacrifice your body in the fire of the yajna.

The sage Medhatithi is performing yajna over the bank of the Candrabhaga river at the foot of the hill.

Getting rest assured, you go there. By my grace, no sage would be able to spot you and you should enter the fire. Thereafter, you would be born as the daughter of Medhatithi.

Whatever boon you have desired, keep them in your mind and enter the fire.

O Sandhya, after performing hard penance on mountain for four yugas and after the passing of Satyayuga.

In the first part of Tretayuga, you would be born as the daughter of Daksa Prajapati and would be married with all humility.

Out of his daughters, he married twenty seven of them to moon. The moon on his part, leaving aside those girls, loved only Rohini.

Then the angry Daksa Prajapati, cursed the moon. Then all the gods came to you.

O Sandhya, you did not find Brahma with those gods. Keeping me in mind, looking at the sky, you would find him again.

In order to get the moon relieved of the curse of Prajapati, Brahma created a river named Candrabhaga. At that point of time the sage Medhatithi also arrived there.

There had been no ascetic comparable to Medhatithi in the past, nor shall be there in future. He, with enormous efforts started the jyotistoma yajna.

The fire is lighted there and you should end your body in the same. You are extremely purified at present. Let your desire be fulfilled.

O Female ascetic, I have established this place for the success of your task. O Immensely fortunate one, you go to the yajna of the great sage and perform your task successfully. Thus benefitting her, lord Siva disappeared from that place.

## Chapter 7 - Sandhya married to Vasistha as Arundhati

Brahma said, “After the disappearing of Siva, granting boons to Sandhya, she went to the place of Medhatithi.

By the grace of Siva, no one in the asrama of the sage could find her. At that time she remembered the sage who had enlightened her about the method of the performing of tapas.

O Great sage, at the command of Brahma, the sage Vasistha, taking to the form of a Brahmacari, had enlightened about the performing of the tapas.

The Brahmacari, who had advised Sandhya about the method of the performing of tapas was conceived as her husband by Sandhya in her mind.

Then in the rising flames of the fire of yajna, the daughter of Brahma entered, but none out of the sages present at the time could see her doing so.

Her invisible body was reduced to ashes in a moment. But it could not be distinguished from the ordinary offerings, and its fragrance was spread in all the four directions.

Then at the command of Siva, the fire god, sent forth her body to the solar region.

The sun divided her body into two halves and kept both the parts in his chariot to please the gods and the manes.

O Sage, the upper part of her body became, the dawn or the pracah-sandhya which is at the beginning of the day and night.

The rest or the lower part of the body became the dusk or the evening Sandhya, which is in the middle of the day and night. This period always delights the manes.

At the day break or at sun rise, the time is called morning- Sandhya, which delights the gods.

After the setting of the sun, assuming the colour of a red lotus, the period is called evening- Sandhya, which delights the manes.

The compassionate Siva, created embodied beings with vital airs, mind and the divine body.

O Sage, at the end of the yajna, the sage Medhatithi, got a girl with the complexion of the molten gold.

O Sage, the sage Medhatithi with great delight took up the daughter, even though she were a sacrifical article and had the girl bathed and took her in his lap.

And gave her the name Arundhati, thereafter surrounded by his disciples, he delightfully celebrated the event.

The girl did not disturb the sacred rites in any way therefore she was given the name of Arundhati.

The sage at the end of the yajna, felt successful in his resolve, getting the wealth of a girl and then he started bringing up the girl in the asrama with his pupils.

The girl started growing up in the asrama of Medhatithi in the taposaranya located over the bank of the Candrabhaga river.

On reaching the age of five years, then she started purifying even the Candrabhaga river with her virtues.

Then Brahma, Visnu and Siva, married Arundhati with the sage Vasistha- the son of Brahma.

A huge function was organised at the time of her marriage, which increased pleasure of all. All the gods and the sages felt delighted.

With the dropping of the water from the hands of Brahma, Visnu and Siva, seven auspicious rivers started including Sipra.

O Sage, Arundhati, the daughter of Medhatithi, had been the best among the chaste women and became graceful by getting Vasistha as her husband.

O Sages, Sakti and other sons were born to her. She also appeared graceful on getting Vasistha as her husband.

O Best of the sages, I have thus narrated the story of Sandhya to you, which is auspicious, divine, excellent and fulfills all the desires.

Whosoever men or women listens to it, all their desires are fulfilled. There is no doubt about it.

## Chapter 8 - Features of Vasanta

Suta said, “Thus listening to the words of Brahma- the Prajapati, Narada said, “O Brahma, you are quite fortunate, are bestowed with wisdom, O pupil of Visnu and the devotee of Siva and you can enlighten us about the supreme tattva.

You have narrated the story of Arundhati, which increases devotion of Siva. You are well-versed in dharma.

Now you tell me the excellent story of Siva which destroys the sins and bestows welfare.

What happened after the departure of Kamadeva with his wife and the departure of Sandhya, for the performing of tapas?"

Suta said, “Thus listening to the words of Narada, Brahma, spoke, feeling delighted.

Brahma said, “O Narada, the best of the Brahmanas, being the devotee of Siva, you are quite graceful. You listen to the excellent story of Siva.

O Dear one, when I disappeared from that place, having been overpowered with illusion, and then I kept on thinking about the words of Siva.

Overpowered with the Maya of Siva, I thought over the subject for long and then became envious of Siva. I am revealing that event before you.

Thereafter, I went to the place of Daksa Prajapati. Reaching there, finding Kamadeva with Rati there I became a bit elated.

O Narada, under the influence of the Maya of Siva, I said to Daksa and his other sons.

Brahma said, “O Daksa, O Marici, my sons, listen to my words and thereafter you think of some remedy to remove my distress.

Siva-the great yogin, had utterly denounced us when I became desirous of a woman.

Since that time, I feel painful at heart. I am not at all comfortable since then. You people should do something by which Siva should also accept a spouse.

The moment he accepts a wife, I would be free from discomfiture. Though according to my mind, this desire of mine is difficult to be fulfilled.

Siva rebuked me for the simple reason that I desired for a woman, in presence of the sages. Then how would he himself take a wife.

Who could be a woman in the three world, who would ever attract his mind, make him discard the path of yoga and attract him towards her.

Even the god of love will not be able to enamour him, because he always remains absorbed in yoga and cannot tolerate even the mention of the name of damsel.

Without marriage, how could Siva the primordial being, indulge in sexual sports, because according to his own words, no one else could do so. Some of the great asuras (demons) could be killed at the hands of Visnu, myself as well as Siva.

Siva always remains detached from the world and averse to the universe, would do nothing except this task. There is no doubt about it.”

Thus speaking to Daksa Prajapati and my other sons, and finding Kamadeva and Rati having arrived there, delightfully I said to him.”

Brahma said, “O Kamadeva, you happened to be the best of all my sons. You provide pleasure to all. O Dear to your father, you listen to my words with your wife. O Kamadeva, with your wife, you look quite graceful and by getting you as her husband, your wife too looks graceful.

As Laksmi looks graceful with Visnu as her husband and as Visnu looks graceful with Laksmi as his wife, as the night looks graceful with the moon and the moon looks graceful with the night.

Similarly both of you mutually illuminate each other and tend your married life. Therefore you would be the leader of the entire universe.

Therefore, O Son, you captivate the mind of Siva, for the welfare of the universe so that he may marry expeditiously.

Wherever Siva goes in the lonely places, beautiful places, over the mountains, tanks, you should follow him, and captivate him, who has controlled the sense organs, there is none also who could be able to captivate him.

O Kamadeva, when Siva falls in love, you will then feel redeemed and be free from the curse. Therefore, you do good to yourself.

When lord Siva, having been filled with love, would desert tapas for an excellent woman, then he would redeem you.

Therefore in order to captivate the mind of Siva, try to get some other woman. By enamouring Siva, you would become the foremost in the world.”

Brahma said, “Listening my words, being the father and the lord of the universe, then Kamadeva, spoke correctly to me- the lord of the world.

Kamadeva said, “O Master, I at your command would try to captivate the mind of Siva. But woman is my biggest weapon, who will have to be created by you.

O Creator, arrange for the way how Siva has to be further enchanted after He has been deluded by me.”

Brahma said, “When Kama put forward the suggestion, I, the creator and Prajapati (Daksa) thought over the matter as to who could be the lady by whom Siva could be enchanted? When I was so engrossed in thought, the Vasanta emerged out of my breath, with the punch of flowers.

He was like the fully blossomed red lotus flower, full of shine. His eyes resembled the blossomed lotus flowers. His face was like the full moon rising at the evening time. He had beautiful nostrils.

His feet were arched like a bow, the hair was dark and curly. His ears were adorned with two ear-rings and he looked bright like the morning sun.

His gait (walking) was majestic, like that of an intoxicated elephant, his thighs were strong and stout, had developed shoulders, the neck resembling the conch, besides the vast chest. His face was plump and finely shaped.

All his limbs were beautiful in appearance, was blue complexioned, possessing all the auspicious symbols, handsome to look at. He was capable of captivating all and would lighten the feeling of love.

When Vasanta the abode of flowers was born, the fragrant wind started blowing and the trees blossomed with flowers.

Hundreds of Cuckoos cooed the note of pancama, sweetly. The water in the lakes was purified.

At the birth of such an excellent being, I Brahma (Hiranyagarbha or golden womb) spoke sweetly to Kama.

“O God, thus a constant companion is born for your help. Lord is therefore sure to help you in your efforts.

As the wind being the friend of fire, always helps it, everywhere, similarly, this Vasanta (spring) will always help you.

Being the cause of the internal pleasure, it would be known by the name of Vasanta from today onwards. It will follow you for the delight of all the people.

Since Malaya breeze is the elegance of your person, it would be friendly with you and shall remain under your control.

The feminine gestures, like the difference in amorous poses and the sixty four fine arts, shall be friendly to your wife Rati in the same manner like your own friends.

O Kama, in the company of your associates Vasanta and Rati, you make all the efforts, to charm lord Siva.

O Son, in the mean time I would like to trace out the damsel who would be able to captivate the mind of Siva.

Brahma said, “Thus at my command, Kamadeva, feeling delighted, together with his wife offered their salutation at my feet as well as my other sons like Daksa and went to the place of Siva.”

## Chapter 9 - Strength of Kamadeva and his attendants

Brahma said, “On the arrival of Kamadeva, with his attendants to the place of Siva, there happened an astonishing event, which you may listen.

Kamadeva, who could captivate all, extended his influence and overpowered all.

Vasanta too in order to captivate Siva, with its own influences made all the trees to blossom with flowers.

Kamadeva accompanied with Rati, made several attempts, as a result of which he overpowered all the creatures, except Ganesa and Siva.

When all the efforts of Vasanta and Kamadeva become infractous, then he, was deprived of all his pride and returned to his respective abode.

Getting sad, having been deprived of his pride, Kamadeva, than offering his salutation to me (Brahma) said with choked voice.

Kamadeva said, “O Brahma, it would be difficult to disturb Siva and to enamour him when he is engaged in tapas. No one else or even myself would be able to captivate Siva.

O Brahma I together with my friend Vasanta and Rati have made all the efforts to captivate Siva variously, but these were of no avail.

O Brahma, I am going to speak out the methods applied by us to overpower Siva, which you please listen.

Having controlled all sences, Siva sat in meditation over his seat, the fragrant cool breeze started blowing.

With the same fragrant, cool breeze, I who captivate all daily, tried my best to disturb Siva from his meditation.

Then I lifted up my bow and fitted my reputed five arrows. Going round him, I tried to enchant him.

With my mere entry all the creatures come under my control, but Siva and his attendants, remained unaffected with the same.

O Brahma, when Siva went to the Himalaya mountain, I also arrived there with Rati and Vasanta.

On Siva’s arrival at the Sumeru mountain or when he went to the mountains of Nagakesara or Sumeru, or Kailasa, I followed him with my friends at all these places.

When Siva did not discard his samadhi then I made two cakravak birds to appear before him.

O Brahma, those birds displayed diverse gestures, of amorous dalliance with brows and other limbs.

Many pairs of deer and birds, were made to appear before Siva exhibiting several gestures of love making in order to excite him.

Many pairs of peacocks displayed before him with their tricks in front of him as well as on his sides.

My arrows did not find any weak point in him. O lord of speech, I tell you the truth, I am not competent enough to captivate him.

O Excellent one, I am speaking the truth. You also please listen to the efforts Vasanta mode in order to lure him.

He caused the various types of flowers like campaka, kesara (saffron), punnaga, (Rottderia tinctoria), ketaka, jasmine, mallika, kurabaka etc., to blossom in the place where Siva was stationed.

He filled the lakes with fragrant lotus flowers in the hermitage of Siva and made the fragrant Malaya breeze to blow.

All the creepers were made full of flowers twine round trees as if resting on their laps with great attachment- Seedlings of Dhattura were scattered to beautify the place.

With the trees having developed with the fragrant breeze and laden with full blown flowers, even the sages were found disturbed with passion.

Inspite of all these efforts, I could trace no symptom in Siva of having been filled with lust, nor did he display his anger upon me observing all this and realising about his intentions, I dissuaded myself from further influencing Siva. I am going to reveal the reason for the same.

I thought, “In case he leaving his meditation, looked at me, I would not be able to stand before him. Then who would be the person on earth to think of captivating Siva?

Siva having the eyes burning like the fire flames, having the terrific locks of hair and holding a trident, then O Brahma, who is there to face him?”

Brahma said, “O Kamadeva, on hearing your words, I would like to say something but am unable to speak out. I feel worried.

O Sage, when Kamadeva expressed his inability to captivate Siva, and hearing this my breathing was stopped.

Thereafter several horrible ganas with tongues of flames were generated from my breath; they were of various forms, immensely strong and frightening.

Those terrific ganas creating great noise, were innumerable in number and started playing on drums and other musical instruments.

The ganas emerging out of my breath, stood before me and started shouting to kill or to cut off.

When those ganas got ready to kill me shouting "Kill-Cut", Kamadeva heard those words and said to Brahma.

O Brahminical sage, Kamadeva, stopped the ganas and in their presence, he spoke to me.

Kamadeva said, “O Brahma, the lord of the people and creator of the universe, who are these horrible and frightening warriors?

O Brahma, what for are they meant, where shall they live, you tell me? What is their name? You better engage them in some work.

You better entrust some work to them, give them some name and provide some abode to them. Thereafter, O God of gods, you get me the command.”

O Excellent sage, listening his words, I the creator of the world directing about his activities, Brahma said, “Soon after their birth they uttered maraya (to kill), therefore they would be called as Mara.

These ganas, if not adored by the passionate people, they would create obstructions in every walk of life.

O Kamadeva, they would be bound to follow you and there is no doubt that they would always help you.

Wherever would you go for the success of you mission, these ganas would always follow you.

They would create confusion and fear in the minds of the people who would be subjugated by your weapons. They shall always create obstruction in the wise people in the path of knowledge in all possible manner.”

Brahma said, “O best of sages, Listening to my words, Kamadeva, born from mind felt delighted with Rati.

Listening to my words, all the ganas, sat there in a natural way surrounding me and Kama.

Thereafter Brahma lovingly said to Kamadeva, you at my command, accompanied with these ganas, proceed once again in order to captivate Siva.

Accompanied with the Mara-ganas make all the efforts, concentrating your mind by which a desire for a woman develops in the mind of Siva.”

O Narada, on hearing these words, gaining some pride, offering his salutation to Brahma with humility, Kamadeva again said.

Kamadeva said, “O Dear One, I had done my best to captivate Siva earlier as well. He could not be captivated then, nor would he be captivated now.

But giving importance to your words and seeing Mara-ganas, I shall go to that festival again with your order.

O Brahma, I firmly believe, that I would not be able to captivate him. I have a doubt that he might reduce my body to ashes.”

O Sage, thus speaking Kamadeva, accompanied with Vasanta and Rati, getting frightened, followed by my Mara-ganas went to the place of Siva.

Kamadeva employed all his wiles as before. Vasanta too displayed his influence intelligently.

Mara-ganas too made all the efforts but lord Siva remained undisturbed.

Kamadeva again returned to me. The Mara-ganas also stood before me with shattered pride and disappointed.

Kamadeva, too feeling sad, together with Vasanta and Mara-ganas sat before me, offering their salutation and then spoke to me.

They said, “O Dear one, we made much more efforts than before to captivate Siva, but he had been engrossed in meditation and remained undisturbed. He could not be moved even slightly.

The compassionate Siva, had also not reduced my body to ashes because of my earlier merits and because the lord is unblemished.

O Brahma, in case you are still desirous that Siva should have a woman, then shedding all the arrogance, make some other efforts. This is what I feel.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, Kamadeva, offering his salutation to me, and remembering Siva who bestows, the pride and is favourably disposed towards the down¬trodden people, retired to his asrama.

## Chapter 10 - Conversation between Brahma and Visnu

Narada said, “O Brahma, O Destiny, O Fortunate one, you are graceful as the devotee of Siva. You have narrated the beautiful story of lord Siva.

With the departure of Rati and Kamadeva with Mara-ganas to their respective abodes, what happened thereafter and what did you do after that, you tell us the relevant story.”

Brahma said, “O Narada, you lovingly listen to the story of. Siva by listening to which a person is freed from all the desires.

After the return of Kamadeva to his abode with his family, and what happened thereafter, you listen from me.

O Narada, my arrogance was shattered that my plans about Siva remained unrealised. I felt surprised at heart.

I started thinking in my mind, that Siva, is unblemished, has conquered himself, and is devoted to the yogic practices. How can he accept a wife?

Thus thinking for long, my pride was shattered, then I remembered Hari, who had given me my body, who bestows welfare to all, with great devotion.

I offered my salutation to him with humble words and excellent stotras, hearing which the lord Visnu appeared before me.

Hari had four arms, lotus like eyes, holding the conch and lotus as attributes and clad in yellow garments. He had dark complexion, and was dear to his devotees.

Observing him in that form again and again, I again devotedly offered my prayer to the lord who is favourably disposed towards his devotees.

Lord Visnu, who destroys the miseries of his devotees, listening to the prayer of Brahma who had taken refuge with him, delightfully said.

Lord Hari said, “O Brahma, O Immensely intelligent one, O Creator of the universe, you are graceful. What for have you remembered me today?

What is the enormous misery that has befallen on you. You tell me. I shall remove it, there is no doubt about it.”

Brahma said, “Hearing the words of lord Visnu, with the pleasing face, I spoke to him with folded hands offering my salutation to him.

Brahma said, “O God of gods, O Lord of Laksmi, you bestow grace on all, you listen to my words and removing the pain of my heart, you remove my misery.

O Visnu, I had sent Kamadeva with Vasanta and Mara-ganas etc. in order to captivate Siva.

All of them made all the efforts but could do nothing against Siva- a great yogi and an ascetic with absolute self control.”

Thus listening to my words, lord Visnu, who was well aware of the Siva-tattva, the omniscient one, felt surprised and spoke thus, Visnu said, “O Great sire, why have you started thinking like this? Thinking sensibly, you tell me the truth.”

Brahma said, “O Dear one, you listen to the story. Your Maya fascinates all. The world is also attracted by the same, which is also the base of the pleasure and the pain.

Having been overpowered with the influence of your Maya I indulged in committing this sin, O Lord of the gods, I am going to repeat the same at your command.

At the beginning of the creation ten sons including Daksa and others besides a beautiful daughter Sandhya were born to me.

Dharma emerged from my chest, Kamadeva from the mind, and several others were born from the body. The girl was born from my speech, looking at whom, I felt enamoured.

Having been overpowered with your Maya I cast an evil eye on her. Siva suddenly arrived at that time and denounced me and my sons.

He rebuked me claiming himself to be the sole lord, possessing Supreme knowledge and the one who had the complete control over his sense organs.

O Visnu, my discomfiture is that even after manifesting himself as my son, he rebuked me on my face (in presence of all). I have stated it to you, now.

In case he could take a wife for himself, I would be happy and forget all my discomfiture. O Kesava, it is for this purpose that I have sought refuge in you.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of the creator of the universe, Lord Madhusudana, smilingly spoke in order to please me.”

Visnu said, “O Brahma, you listen to my words which will surely relieve you of the frustration.

O Brahma, the speaker of the Vedas, and the creator of the universe, how is it that you have developed a confused mind?

You shed away your foolishness, and think of the Vedas and what do they speak on the subject. With noble wisdom remember the same.

O Evil minded one, you treat Rudra- the Paramesvara as your son? You are the orator of the Vedas and still you have been deprived of your entire knowledge.

Taking Siva to be an ordinary god you have developed enmity with him. Your noble wisdom has disappeared today and has been replaced by the evil wisdom.

Listen to the first principle which had been narrated in the ancient times. You should have a spotless conscience. It is the true being which is glorified as the true cause of creation. This is certain.

Siva is the creator of the universe, the preserver and the destroyer. He is greater than the greatest, is supreme Brahman, the greatest lord without attributes and eternal.

He is beyond definition and beyond deterioration or decay. He is the Supreme soul, without a second, unswerving and endless. He is the cause of dissolution, all pervasive and the great lord.

He is all pervading, possessing three gunas i.e. sattva, rajas and tamas. He is the cause of creation preservation and dissolution as Brahma, Visnu and Siva. He is beyond the three gunas.

He is distinct from Maya, free from desires, creates illusion or is form of illusion. He is the creator Maya, but he himself remains unaffected by it. He is adept. He possesses attributes, but is free from them. He is blissful in himself. He is always engaged in continued meditation.

He moves in his own soul. He is free from controversies. He is subservient to his devotees, has the well-built body, is a great yogi always engaged in yoga and leads to the path of yoga.

He shatters the pride of all and is the lord of all the lokas. He is compassionate to the down-trodden people. Thus he is the lord, and you call him as your son.

Shed away your foolishness. Take refuge with him. Recite the name of Siva in every way. He would bestow welfare on you when pleased.

In case you are of the opinion that Siva would have a wife then perform hard tapas, keeping Siva in your mind.

For the success of your desire, in case he is pleased, he would surely fulfil your desires.

In case Siva incarnates on earth in the form of a woman, she would surely be the wife of Siva.

O Brahma, you command Daksa Prajapati that he should perform tapas to have Siva born in his house as his daughter.

O Dear one, both Siva and Siva are subservient to their devotees. Both of them are the form of Supreme Brahman and take to Saguna form at their own desire.”

After saying this, Visnu- the lord of Laksmi, remembered in his heart lord Siva and getting knowledge by his grace, he said to me.”

Visnu said, “O Brahma, when both of us were born at his will, remember his words which Siva had spoken at our prayer.

Have you forgotten all that? Graceful is the Maya of Siva, which overpowers the entire universe. None else except Siva can be aware of it.

When absolute Siva, at his own will took to Saguna form, then he produced both of us, with his own power with his divine sport. Then lord Siva assigned to you the task of creation. The same imperishable Siva entrusted me the task of preserving the world.

Then both of us went to Siva with folded hands lowering our heads and said, “O Lord of all, you can take to Saguna form.

At the words spoken by us, the compassionate lord who indulges in various types of sports, looked towards the sky and spoke lovingly.

“Visnu is my form. Similarly Rudra would be manifested from Brahma and shall be well known in the world by the same name. He will be my form.

He is my complete form and lord of all the gunas and is worthy of being worshipped by you. He will fulfil all your desires.

Brahma, Visnu and Siva are my forms. Hara is especially my complete form. Similarly Uma shall also have three forms.

As Laksmi, she would be the spouse of Visnu, as Sarasvati, the spouse of Brahma, and as Sati- having the complete form, would be the spouse of Rudra.”

Visnua said, “Thus speaking, bestowing his grace on all, lord Siva disappeared from the scene. Thereafter, we too feeling comfortable engaged ourselves in our respective jobs.

O Brahma, after sometime both of us had got the spouses, while Siva incarnated at Kailasa as Rudra.

O Lord of the people, Siva too shall incarnate as Sati. An effort should be made for her future incarnation.”

After saying this, lord Visnu, disappeared after blessing me. Then I felt immensely delighted and soon my jealousy against Siva vanished.

## Chapter 11 - Brahma worships Durga and gets a boon

Narada said, “O Dear one, O Good speaker, O Destiny, O Brahma, after the disappearing of Visnu, what happened thereafter and what did you do?”

Brahma said, “O Son of an excellent Brahmana, whatever was done by me after the departure of Visnu, you listen to it carefully.

Thereafter I started offering prayers to Durga, who is the form of Vidya and avidya, spotless form of Supreme Brahman, the support of the universe, and the beloved of Siva.

She is the one who is all pervading, eternal, without support, undistressed, is the mother of the three deities, who is the grossest of the gross elements and is still formless.

O Goddess of the gods, you are the supreme knowledge, supreme soul, comparable with the supreme soul. Be pleased with me and fulfil my task. Salutation to you.”

O Divine Sage, when so worshipped, Candika- the Yoganidra or mystic slumber, appeared before me.

She had the complexion of glossy collyrium, beautiful form, she looked divine and had four arms and was seated over a lion, displayed varada-mudra in one of her hands and the pearls decorated her dishevelled hair.

Her face resembled the full moon of the winter season, she had three eyes; she looked quite beautiful and the nails of her lotus like feet were shining.

O Sage, finding Uma, the Sakti of Siva before me, I, offering my salutation to her, started praising her.

Brahma said, “O Goddess, you are in the form of Pravrti (action), Nivrtti, (salvation), the creation and preservation of the universe. You are the eternal energy of moveable and immeavable beings and are capable of captivating everyone, salutation to you.

You are manifest as Laksmi like garland around the image of Visnu. You sustain the universe and protect all. You resort to creation and becoming Mahesi, destroy all the three worlds by your gunas.

You are the one who is adored even by the yogis, you are present in everything including the atom. You are perceivable in the hearts of the yogis, purified by discipline and the path of their meditation.

You possess light as well as purity, free from confusion. You assume kutastha (perpetually immovable), avyakta (unmanifest) and ananta (infinite) forms. You take to many forms.

O Siva, you are the prime cause of the three gunas and are still beyond them. But in combination with the gunas, you certainly infuse the seed of change in every matter.

You are free from the deprivity of the three gunas viz.: sattva, rajas and tamas. You are something else beyond them. You entering the heart of Brahma, cause the creation, protection and destruction.

You are the form of seed of the entire universe. You are knowable as well as the form of knowledge. You always remain benevolent to the world, O Spouse of Siva salutation to you.”

Brahma said, “Listening to my prayer the goddess Kali- who is adorable by the world, lovingly spoke to me.

The goddess said, “O Brahma, what for have you praised me? In case it is worth revealing, then speak it out.

With my appearance, the success is assured. Therefore, you speak out your desired task, which shall be performed by me with your inspiration.”

Brahma said, “O Goddess, O Mahesani, you kindly listen to me. O Omniscient goddess, I shall speak out my mind, as have been directed by you.

O Goddess of the Devas, your husband had been born out of my head and known as Rudra and is dwelling at Kailasa as Siva.

He, the lord of the Bhutas is performing the long penance alone. He is without a spouse, unblemished and is not desirous of a spouse.

O Sati, you better fascinate him, lest he casts his glance at some other lady. It is you alone who could capture his mind.

Therefore, O Siva, you in this form itself, becoming the daughter of Daksa, become the spouse of Siva, capturing his mind. Salutation to you.

Just as you, assuming the form of Laksmi, pleased Visnu, similarly, for the benefit of the universe, you also do this.

O Goddess, Siva, who finding in me just the desire of a woman, denounced me, how could he accept a spouse?

Siva is the cause of the universe in the beginning middle and end. In case he remains detached and refuses to take a wife, then now could the auspicious beings be created?

This thought has tormented me. It would not have been befitting for me to seek for another refuge. Therefore, I pray to you to accomplish the task for the benefit of the universe.

O Mahesvaris, you becoming the daughter of Daksa, creation delusion for Mahesvara, become his wife.

O Mother of the universe, no one else except you can accomplish this task, because, Laksmi, Visnu, Kamadeva and even I myself could not captivate him.

O Goddess of the gods, seated over the northern shore of the ocean of milk, Daksa Prajapati is performing a tapas, with a firm resolve in order to achieve you.”

Brahma again said, “Listening to my words Siva felt concerned and said, getting surprised in her mind.

The goddess said, “It is a matter of great surprise as to what is being spoken by the reciter of the Vedas, creator of the universe, and the destiny, overpowered with great ignorance?

The great confusion has overpowered the mind of Brahma which is the cause of pain and he intends to captivate Siva who is unblemished.

He desires a boon from me, that I should captivate Siva. What is he going to gain by the same. The great lord Siva is free from delusion and mental aberrations.

Siva is well known as Supreme Brahman, absolute and unblemished, I am like a maid servant for him always ready to obey his command.

He is the one who redeems his devotees, is independent Paramesvara Rudra also known as Siva.

He is the lord of Hari and Brahma- the destiny and is supreme. He is a great yogi, free from illusion but is not absorbed in it. He is the greatest of the great.

This Brahma considering him as an ordinary god, treats him as his son, himself having been overpowered with ignorance, intends to captivate him.

In case I do not bestow the boon, then the Vedic tradition shall be broken. Now what should I do, not to displease lord Siva?”

Brahma said, “Thus thinking, Siva, remembered Siva in her mind and with the permission of Siva, she said to me.”

Durga said, “O Brahma, whatever has been spoken by you, is utterly true. There is none else in the world to captivate Siva.

You have spoken a great truth that if Siva does not take a wife unto Himself, the creation cannot continue long.

I had also not been able to captivate the great lord, but at your words my mind has been filled with double the enthusiasm.

O Brahma, I shall do something by which - Siva getting captivated would himself accept a spouse.

As Laksmi is the beloved of Visnu, similarly, I taking to the form of Sati shall obey the command of Siva.

O Brahma, I shall, by his grace make efforts that he could remain captivated by me.

O Brahma, I shall be born from the womb of the wife of Daksa Prajapati, by the name of Sati, and honour Siva by my sports.

As the other people remain attached to their wives, similarly, Siva would remain attached to me because of my devotion.”

Brahma said, “O Dear one, thus speaking to me, Siva the mother of the universe, disappeared in my presence.

After the disappearing of Durga, from the scene, I also left the place and went to my mind-born sons and narrated the sequence of events to them.

## Chapter 12 - Receiving a boon by Daksa from Durga

Narada said, “O Brahma, devotee of Siva, O Sinless one, you have spoken correctly. You have purified my life by narrating the story of Siva and Siva.

Presently you tell me, what type of boon was received by Daksa, after performing the hard tapas and how did the goddess become the daughter of Daksa?”

Brahma said, “O Narada, you are graceful among the sage, because of your devotion towards Siva. I am going to tell you as to how Daksa performed penance and got the boon as a result thereof.

At my command the wise Daksa, for the accomplishment of his task, went for the adoration of the mother of the world.

Reaching the northern shore of the ocean of milk, reciting the name of the goddess in his mind, in order to have an audience with her, he started performing tapas.

Daksa, controlling his sense organs, with a firm resolve, performed penance for three thousand divine years.

Consuming the tree leaves, water, fasting and using the wind as food, he recited the name of the mother of the world and he spent that time.

Daksa performing vrata, devoting his mind towards Durga, continued penance for long and kept on adoring the goddess in many ways.

O Sage, thus adoring Jagadamba- the mother of the world, Siva the goddess, appeared in person before Daksa Prajapati.

Then finding of the mother of the world having appeared before him Daksa Prajapati thought himself having become successful.

She was mounted over a lion and was of black complexion. She had beautiful face, four arms, displaying varada and abhaya mudras in two hands, besides the sword and lotus flower in the other two hands as attributes. She attracted the minds of all.

With her eyes being red, dishevelled hair, the mother of the universe, possessed beautiful lustre. Daksa offered his salutation to the goddess and he started offering his prayer to her.

Daksa-Prajapati said, “O Mother of the world, O Mahamaya, mistress of the universe, be pleased with me. You have shown me your form gracefully. Salutation to you.

O Eternal Bhagavati, the form of Siva, bestower of boons on the devotees, your are the illusory form of the universe, be pleased with me. Salutation to you.

Brahma said, “O Sage, thus having been praised by Daksa, having the purified soul, the Goddess spoke to him, though she was well aware of his desire.”

The Goddess said, “O Daksa, I am extremely pleased with your devotion. You better ask for a boon you desire. There is nothing, which cannot be granted to you.”

Brahma said, “Daksa Prajapati then listening to the worlds of the mother of the universe, felt delighted and offering his salutation to Siva, again and again and then said to her. Daksa Prajapati said, “O Mother of the Universe, O Mahamaya, in case you are inclined to pronounce a boon on me, then listening to my prayer lovingly, fulfil my desire.

Siva is my lord, who is Rudra- the son of Brahma and is the complete incarnation of the Supreme Soul.

Till now you had not incarnated on earth. Then who could be his spouse. Therefore, incarnating on earth, O Siva, you better captivate him.

Except you, no one else would be able to captivate him. Therefore you become the spouse of Siva, after taking birth as my daughter.

In this way displaying your sports, you captivate Siva. O Goddess, this is the boon desired by me, which has been placed by me truthfully before you.

In this desire of mine, there is not only my own selfish motive, but also that of Brahma, Visnu and Siva as well. Actually, it is Brahma, who inspired me for performing this tapas."

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Daksa Prajapati, Durga, adoring lord Siva in her heart started smiling.

The goddess said, “O Dear one, O Daksa Prajapati, you listen to my words. I am speaking the truth to you. I can bestow everything when pleased.

Having been pleased with your devotion, I shall be born as your daughter from your wife. There is no doubt about it.

I shall make all the efforts to do so, performing hard tapas, by which after seeking a boon from Siva to become his spouse, for the success of our task, because the lord Sadasiva, is adorable by Brahma and Visnu as well.

I happen to be his dear slave girl in every birth, and he happens to be my lord always. The same lord Siva takes to many forms.

With the influence the tapas he emerged from the eye brows of Brahma and I also at his command, and the boon shall incarnate on earth.

O Dear one, you better go home. I have instructed the female messenger. Now, I shall be taking birth as your daughter and shall become the wife of Siva.”

In this way speaking quite nicely to Daksa Prajapati, having been so commanded by Siva, devoting her mind at the lotus like feet of Siva, the goddess spoke again.

“O Daksa Prajapati, you will have to keep in mind my resolve. I am speaking you the truth. Don’t take it as false.

In case you show disrespect to me, after am born to you as a daughter, then I shall put an end to my body. This is because I am self- supporting.

O Prajapati, I have given this boon to you for every creation that, I being your daughter shall be the wife of Siva.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking to Daksa Prajapati, Mahesani, at once disappeared from the scene.

After the disappearing of the goddess Durga, Daksa also retired to his own abode. He was happy for the simple reason, that Durga would be born as his daughter in his house.

## Chapter 13 - Daksa’s curse to Narada

Narada said, “0 Brahma, O Destiny, O Abode of wisdom, O Best of the speakers, after the departure of Daksa Prajapati, to his abode, what happened thereafter, you please speak out lovingly.”

Brahma said, “Daksa with a delightful mind, went back to his abode and resorted to the several types of creation.

Then finding that the creation was not at all increasing, Daksa said to his father (myself).

Daksa Prajapati said, “O Brahma, O Dear one, O Lod of the people, the increase in the people is at a stand still. The number of the created beings remain the same.

O Lord of the people, what should I do? How can I increase them? Yo tell me the way out, to increase the people.

Brahma said, “O Dear one, O Daksa Prajapati, you better listen to my words, you keep on engaging yourself in creating the universe; Lord Siva would bless you.

O Prajapati, O Lord of the universe, let Asikni, the beautiful daughter of Pancajana, the lord of the five tribes, be taken by you as your spouse.

Indulging into sexual intercourse with her, you can create many people from the beautiful woman like her.

Then at my instance, he married the daughter of Virini in order to procreate subjects by way of coitus.

Prajapati Daksa begot sons known as Haryasvas on his wife Virini.

O Sage, the sons so produced were devoted to their father who followed the path of the Vedas. They had no separate virtues or practices.

O Dear one, all the sons of Daksa- Prajapati, at the desire of their father went to the western direction, for the performing of the tapas, for the purpose of creation.

There is an auspicious place of pilgrimage known by the name of Narayana lake at the confluence of the river Sindhu as well as the ocean.

With the simple touch of the water of that place, one could achieve the spotless wisdom. All the impurities of these ascetics possessing dharma, were vanished.

Bound with the command of his father, with a firm mind, the sons of Daksa, performed tapas there.

O Narada, then finding them engaged in tapas for the purpose of creation, you went to lord Visnu in order to know about his mind.

He spoke to Haryasva and other sons of Daksa with great respect. How could you engage yourself in the creation without knowing or having an idea of the creatures of the world?”

Brahma said, “Then Haryasva and others carefully listened to your words and started thinking about the creation themselves.

They thought, “How can a person think of starting the work of the creation, putting faith in the gunas alone, in case, he is unaware of the command of the creator of the sacred texts.

Then the sages who had similar types of thoughts, bowed to you in reverence and circumambulated you. They therefore moved on a path from which they had never to return.

O Sage Narada, with your mind devoted to Siva, and desirous of carrying out his command, you proceeded on to the various worlds without any mental reservations.

Thereafter a long time passed and Daksa Prajapati- my son, learning about Haryasva and his other sons, he became angry with Narada.

He started saying again and again, “A large number of sons bring disaster only.” Daksa who had been overpowered with Maya of Siva, bewailed like this in several ways.

Then I arrived there and consoled my son Daksa, saying that the moves of the destiny are quite strong.” By saying such words I some how pacified him.

Thereafter, after having been consoled by me, Daksa produced from Pancajani, thousands of sons.

All of them were of firm mind, those sons, at the command of their father, went to the same place where their brothers known as Haryasvas had gone for the creation.

With the very touch of the water of that lake all their sins were washed out and their hearts became spotless. Then those ascetics, reciting the name of the Supreme Brahman, performed penance for a long time.

Realising the moves of Siva, finding them to have been engaged in the creation of the people, Narada went there and spoke to them as he had spoken earlier.

O Brother, O Sage of beneficent sight, you showed them the path, followed by their brothers. Thereafter you went back to the heaven and they, the sons of Daksa, went to the path of their brothers.

At the same time distressed in mind Prajapati Daksa- my son witnessed many ill omens and was filled with surprise.

Listening to the deeds having been performed by you earlier. Daksa was surprised, and fainted with the grief of the death of his sons.

Having been filled with grief, Daksa said to you. He is wicked one, fortunately you have arrived as a move of the destiny.”

Because of the anger and grief, his lips were fluttering and showering disgrace on you, he denounced you.

Daksa said, “O Foremost of the base people, disguised as an ascetic, what have you done. O Beggar, you have not done well by showing my sons the path of mendicants.

You are cruel and wicked, you have put obstacles in the path of their progress in the present as well as their future world.

A person who discarding his parents, without repaying their debts, leaves the house, and becomes a recluse, he falls in the hell inspite of his being desirous of moksa.

You are cruel, shameless and are the destroyer of the glory. You have shattered the wisdom of my son. O Fool, you uselessly wander among the attendants of Hari.

O Worthless and depicable Narada, you have done harm to me, again and again, therefore, you would never remain stable and keep on wandering in three lokas. Your feet will never be steady.

Getting enamoured with the Maya of Siva and unmindful of the desire of the lord, Daksa, overpowered with grief pronounced a curse on you.

O Sage, you possessing the spotless wisdom accepted that cures. All the saintly persons well-versed in the Brhamajnana accept the evil designs of others like this.

## Chapter 14 - Birth of Sati and her childhood sports

Brahma said, “O Divine ascetic, then I the grand sire of all the lokas, arrived there, in order to know the facts about the divine story.

As had been done by me earlier, I consoled Daksa, then he again became friendly towards you.

I also consoled you since you happened to be my son, the best among the sages, and then took you to my place.

Then at my advice, Daksa Prajapati, produced sixty beautiful daughters from his wife.

O Sage, he, quite carefully married the sixty daughters to Dharma and others. You listen to that story with pleasure.

Daksa gave away ten girls in marriage to Dharma. Thirteen out of them were given to Kasyapa and twenty seven of them were given to the moon.

Bhrgu, Angirasa and Krsasva were given two girls each. The remaining six were given to Garuda for creation.

All the three lokas were filled with them. A detailed narration has been avoided keeping in view the unnecessary expansion of the topic.

Some say that Siva was the eldest of them all. Some say, she was the middle one and some of the people with wisdom, treat her to be the youngest of all. All the three opinions are correct, because of the difference in the kalpas.

After the birth of the daughter, Daksa Prajapati, together with his wife, devoted their minds to the mother of the universe.

Then with the choked voice, with loving humility they offered their salutation to her again and again and offered their prayer to her.

The goddess, then getting delighted, and thinking in her mind for the fulfilling of her promise, incarnated in Virini.

Thereafter when the mother of the universe started dwelling in the mind of Daksa, he started looking extremely beautiful.

He deposited his semen in his wife in an auspicious moment. Thus compassionate Siva started residing in the womb of Daksa's consort.

Thereafter Virini started developing the symptoms of pregnancy. O Dear one, thereafter Virini too started remaining more delightful in mind, because of the goddess she was carrying in her womb, and also shone with mental pleasure.

Daksa, on the other hand, following his family tradition, according to his own honour, and loftiness of his mind, besides the provisions of the Vedas, performed the pumsavana rites out of affection.

Great festivities followed those rites. Daksa also distributed enough of daksina to the Brahmanas as per their desire.

When Visnu and other gods came to know that the goddess had entered the womb of Virini, then all of them were delighted.

All the gods arrived there and adoring the goddess offering their salutation to her, offered prayer as well.

Thereafter the gods, praising the fortunes of Virini and Daksa Prajapati, went back to their respective places.

After the expiry of nine months, according to the prevailing traditions, the tenth was also over.

O sage! at the time when the stars were favourable, Siva appeared before the mother.

Daksa Prajapati was immensely happy at the birth of the goddess. Because of her possessing sharp shine, he became sure that the goddess had been born.

The rain of flowers was dropped at the time of her birth. The clouds showered the rain. The directions became peaceful.

At that point of time, the musical instruments were played upon. The fire was extinguished. There was rejoicing on all the sides.

Finding the birth of the mother of the world from the womb of Virini, Daksa Prajapati, folding his hands, with his mind filled with devotion offered his salutation to her offering prayer to her at the same time.

Daksa said, “O Mahesani, O Mother of the world, O Eternal goddess, O Great goddess, O Form of truth, O Satya, salutation to you. Be compassionate on me.

The one who is adored by the people of wisdom, well-versed in the Vedas, as Siva, Santa, Mahamaya, Yoganidra and mother of the universe, I offer my salutation to the goddess.

The one who giving birth to Brahma, deputed him for the creation of the universe, I offer my salutation to Mahesvari- the mother of the universe.

The one who entrusted the care of the maintaining of the universe to Visnu, I offer my salutation to such a goddess Mahesvari.

She is the one who entrusted the job of the destruction to Siva, I offer my salutation to such a Mahesvari, the mother of the universe.

She takes to the form of sattva, rajas and tamas, and brings success to all the jobs, she produced all the three gods, salutation to such a goddess called Siva.

O Goddess, a person who adores you in the form of Vidya and avidya he always enjoys all the worldly pleasures.

O Goddess, such of the people, who directly perceive you as the sanctifying deity, will certainly attain salvation, with the discrimination of vidya and avidya.

O Mother of the universe, those who adore you, as Bhavam, Ambika, Jaganmaya and Durga, will always achieve everything.”
