Brahma said, “Siva, the mother of the universe, when so eulogised by the intelligent Daksa, then said to him speaking the words which could not be heard by anyone or even her own mother.

Then Siva the great goddess, cast a spell on everyone present there and spoke words which could be heard by Daksa alone.”

The Goddess said, “O Daksa Prajapati, I had been adored earlier by you for becoming your daughter. Your desire has now been fulfilled. Now you can carry on you penance as you like.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking to Daksa, the goddess then took to the form of an infant girl and started crying besides her mother.

Then listening to the cries of the infant child, the women collected there and the slave giris also arrived.

Looking at the beauty of the virgin, all the women praised her while the people of the city raised the slogans of victory.

Great festivity was observed with song and music. Daksa on the other hand felt delighted on looking at the face of the girl.

Daksa Prajapati, following the family tradition based on the Vedic principles, gave away several types of charities to the Brahmanas.

With the welfare activities, songs and dances were performed in company of the musical instruments.

Hari and other gods also arrived with their attendants and the sages, and joined the festivities.

On seeing the daughter of Daksa, the Goddess, who happened to be the mother of the universe, they offered their salutation and adored her reciting the auspicious mantras.

Having been filled with extreme delight, they shouted the slogans of victory. They particularly praised Daksa and Virini.

At the command of Hari and others, Daksa delightfully named her Uma since she inherited good qualities and was greatly admired.

She was subsequently also given other auspicious names, which could remove all the miseries and misfortunes.

Daksa then offered his salutation with folded hands to Hari, myself (Brahma) and all the gods, besides the sages with devotion.

Thereafter Visnu and other gods, praised the fortunes of Daksa Prajapati and remembering in their hearts- lord Siva, went back to their respective places.

Thereafter the mother Virini performed Samskara for her daughter and then fed her with her chest milk in an appropriate manner.

Daksa and Virini brought up the daughter quite appropriately therefore she kept on growing like the digit of the crescent moon in the bright fortnight.

O Excellent Brahmana, even in her infancy, the noble qualities entered the body of the goddess, like the beautiful digits of the moon.

While she was engaged in various types of sports, among her girl friends, she used to draw pictures of Siva daily.

While Siva, singing songs according to her age, she remembered Siva, the one who subjugated Kamadeva.

The affection of Daksa and Virini for their daughter kept on growing daily, because she was devoted to Siva since her childhood.

She was endowed with all the childhood virtues and well-versed in the household works, Uma, pleased her parents again and again.

## Chapter 15 - Description of Nandyavrata and eulogy of Siva

Brahma said, “O Sage, once I saw Sati, essence of three worlds, seated with her father, along with you

Finding her father offering his salutation to Sati following the worldly conventions, she offered her salutation to us.

After her salutation, when Daksa gave us the seats, then I together with you took our seats. Looking at the humble Sati I said, “The one who desires you and the one whom you desire, you achieve omniscient lord of the universe as your husband.

He is the one who has never accepted another wife, nor does he do so or would do so in future, he is suitable for you. There is none else comparable with him. He shall be your husband.”

Thus speaking, I stayed for long in the abode of Daksa. Thereafter Daksa sent off both myself and Narada. We went to our abdes.

Daksa, on hearing the words of Brahma, felt extremely pleased and reassured, and taking her daughter as Paramesvari, he honoured her.

Uma- who was favourably disposed towards her devotees, had taken to the human form at her own will, during her childhood, displayed sports and passed that age.

She then started moving towards her youthful age, crossing the age of childhood. She possessed all the beautiful limbs because of her tapas.

Then Daksa- the lord of the universe, felt anxious at the sight of the youthful daughter. He thought, “How should the girl be given to Siva.

Sati on the other hand also got anxious to achieve Siva. Realising the mental condition of her father, she went to her mother.

She said to her mother, “I intend to perform tapas in order to achieve Siva as my husband, I seek your permission.” These were the words spoken by Sati Parmesvari to her mother.

Then getting consent of her mother, Sati, with a firm mind, started adoring Siva in her home in order to receive him as her husband.

In the month of Asvin, (September- October), on the Nanda-tithi (i.e. first, sixth and the eleventh day of the lunar) fortnight, she adored Siva with great devotion offering the cooked rice with jaggery, and salt, for a month.

On the fourteenth day of the month of Karttika, she adored and meditated upon Siva offering the sweet pies and pudding.

On the eighth day of Marga-sirsa (November-December) Sati adored Siva with cooked barley and sesamum seeds, spending the days in his devotion.

On the seventh day of the bright half of the month of Pau$a (December-January) Sati remained awake during the night and adored Siva in the morning with cooked rice and Krsara (khicadi).

On the full-moon night of Magha, (January-February) she remained awake during the night, and adored Siva on the banks of the river wearing wet clothes.

She, on the fourteenth day of the dark half of the month of Phalguna (February-March) remained awake during the night and performed special worship of Siva, with wood apple fruits and leaves in a span of every three hours.

On the fourteenth day of the bright half of the month of Caitra (March-April), Siva was worshipped by her with palasa (Butea frondosa) and damana flowers offered during the day and the night. She spent the rest of the month reciting his name.

After adoring him with cooked rice and seasmum seeds, on the third day of the bright half of the month of Magha (January-February) she consumed throughout the rest of the month the products of the cow’s milk.

Then she adored the lord Siva with the offering of cloths and Brhati flowers on the full moon night of the month of Jyestha (May- June) she observed the fast throughout the month.

On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of the month of Asadha (June-July), she clad herself in a black cloth, and adored Rudra, offering Brhati flowers.

On the eighth and the fourteenth days of the month of (July-August) Sravana, she worshipped Siva, offering the yajnopavits and the cloths.

On the thirteenth day of the dark half of Bhadrapada, (August-September) she worshipped Siva, offering various fruits and flowers She took water on the fourteenth day.

She kept strict control over her food and reciting various mantras she worshipped Siva, offering different fruits, flowers and leaves which were quite fresh and readily available.

The goddess took to the human form at will and was always engaged in the worship of Siva for days and months remaining firm in her resolve.

Thus she completed the fast of Nandyavrata concentrating her mind to Siva, she was quite firm in her resolve and did not think of any one else.

O Sage, thereafter, all the gods and sages making me to lead them, together with Visnu went to the place where Sati had been performing tapas.

Reaching there, the gods found Sati engaged in the meditation for Siva and embodied form of success incarnate and had reached the stage of the enlightened seers.

The gods with folded hands, delightfully offered their respect to Sati, bending down their shoulders in respect. Then Visnu and other gods felt delighted.

Thereafter Visnu and other divine sages, getting surprised started praising the tapas of Sati.

Offering their salutation at the feet of Sati, all the gods and sages went to the Kailasa mountain, which was like by Siva.

I (Brahma) accompanied with Sarasvati, Visnu with Laksmi, then went to Siva.

Reaching there, we were surprised at the sight of Siva. Then folding our hands with humility, we started praising Siva, reciting several stotras."

The gods said, “Salutation to you from whom, the mobile and immobile creatures have emerged. Salutation to such of Purusa, who is also known as Mahesa, Paresa and the Great soul.

You are the cause of the entire universe, the cause of absolute consciousness, the excellent one, unblemished, the one beyond Purusa and Prakrti and known as the Supreme Brahman.

The one who creates the universe, by whom the world is illuminated, from whom it was originated, by whom it is sustained, to whom this belongs and the one who controls everything.

The one who is beyond this, and is beyond the great things, the one who is without blemish and observes everyone in his own soul, we offer salutation to the self-born lord.

We seek refuge under his feet, who happens to be the Supreme Brahman, who is the soul of every one, and is the greatest witness with unrestricted vision, and the one who assumes different forms.

Salutation to you whose region is unknown to the gods, rsis, and even the siddhas. Then who also can know about the same.

The great saints, free from all the attachments, make enormous effort becoming desirous of seeing your region and your noble conduct. They take refuge in you.

Though you are free from the blemishes of the birth and death, but you still accept them with the influence of your Maya.

Being the great Isa, you perform miracles salutation to you, you are the Supreme Brahman, and the Supreme saint, salutation to you.

O Lord, you are formless and have the gigantic form as well, you are Supreme, having prowess beyond measure, the lord of the three worlds witness of all and all pervading lord. Salutation to you.

You are the light of the soul, fully endowed with the bliss of liberation, the form of knowledge and all pervasive lord, salutation to you.

Salutation to the lord of salvation, who can be reached only after one’s detachment from the worldly activities or attractions. You are a great Purusa, the great lord, the bestower of all the boons. Salutation to you.

You are Ksetrajna, the form of Soul, cause of all the perceptions, salutation to you. Salutation to you.

You are the presiding deity of all, you are great, you are the basic Prakrti, Purusa, the Supreme Isvara and the bestower of all. Salutation to you.

You have three eyes, five faces, always having the form of lustre, salutation to you. Salutation to you. You observer all the sense organs and the gunas, besides being the causeless. Salutation to you.

You are the cause of the three world as well as the salvation Salutation to you. You are the bestower of moksa and redeem the person who takes refuge in you.

You are the ocean of Vedic and the post- Vedic literature, you are the supreme lord and the refuge of the devotees as well as the virtues. Salutation to you.

O Lord, the heat of consciousness, is talent with the sacrificial churning stick for the production of the fire, you are the form of fire, you are Mahesvara, who is beyond the reach of fools, but reside in the hearts of the people possessing knowledge or wisdom. We always offer salutation to you.

You are the one who shatters the bondages of the people and provide salvation to your noble devotees, you are self illuminated, everlasting, imperishable and are the form of incessant knowledge. Salutation to you.

You are the self contemplator, free from all the deficiencies, possessor of the best of fortunes; who is adored by dharma, artha, kama and moksa and by those who desire the cherished goal. O Lord don’t be harsh on us but be pleased, salutation to you.

The true devotees never desire anything for themselves. They are solely desirous of singing the auspicious glory of your auspicious life.

You are the imperishable Supreme Brahman, with unclear form, you could be achieved by means of adhyatma (or spiritual) knowledge, you are the complete Aksara Brahman and we eulogise you.

You are beyond the perception of the strength of the organs, are without any support, but you yourself are the support of the universe, without any cause, without beginning or the end, subtle, lord of all, we offer our obeisance to you.

The one who has created Visnu and all other gods, all the lokas, besides the mobile and immobile beings, with the difference of the name and merits with his smallest digits, with your invisible influence there appear sparks from fire and the rays from the sun, again and again.

O Lord, you are neither a god nor the demon or asura, neither a human nor the bird or animal or even a Brahmana. You are neither man, nor women nor even a eunuch. You are neither an evil nor a noble person. Therefore you are formless.

Of all the forms which have been noted above, except those, you have the form whatever remains thereof. You are the creator of the universe besides being its preserver and the destroyer, being soul of the universe. We bow in reverence to you.

You are the lord of yoga. The yogins having their minds devoted to yoga adore you in that position. Therefore salutation to you.

O Lord your force is unbearable; you have three Saktis, comparable with the three Vedas. You posses three gunas, you protect those who take refuge in you. You possess immense potentiality. Salutation to you.

O Lord of Durga, such of the people who are involved in the worldly or sensuous pleasures can hardly reach you. But in case they happen to be your devotees, you redeem them as well. Therefore salutation to you possessing the invisible or secret strength. Salutation to you.

The foolish people are unable to recognise. You because of your Maya, you are the greatest of the lords whose greatness cannot be imagined. Salutation to you.”

Brahma said, “All the gods including Visnu and others, after offering prayer to Siva, the great lord, silently stood before the lord bending their shoulders with great devotion.

## Chapter 16 - Brahma and Visnu eulogise Siva

Brahma said, “Listening to the prayer offered by Visnu and other gods, lord Siva, the creator of the universe was immensely pleased.

Then Siva finding that Brahma and other gods had arrived with their wives, asked the cause of their arrival.

Rudra said, “O Brahma, O Visnu, O Gods, O Sages, you speak out fearlessly, the purpose of your arrival here. Tell me correctly.

Having been pleased with your prayer, I would like to listen from you the purpose of your visit to this place.

Brahma said, “I happen to be the grand-sire of the universe, and when I had been so asked by Siva, then O Sage, getting inspired by Visnu, I spoke to Siva.

O God of gods, O Ocean of mercy, O Lord, Mahadeva, you kindly listen to the purpose of our arrival here with the gods and the sages.

O Bull-bannered god, we are desirous of your help. Therefore, we have purposefully arrived for your sake. Without your help the creation of the universe cannot go on.

O Lord Mahesvara, some people desirous of peculiar type of life would be born which could be killed by me. Some of them would be killed by Visnu, while some of them would be killed by you.

O Great Lord, some of the demons have to be killed by the sons born out of your semen, while others could be killed by your Sakti (spouse).

O Siva, only by your grace, the gods can lead the life of comfort. You alone can make the world healthy and fearless.

When you get yourself absorbed in yogical practices, getting always free from attachment or jealousy and you remain compassionate to all, then no one can be killed by you.

O Lord, how could the creation be managed with the killing of, the demons and how could it be maintained. Therefore, O Bull- bannered one, you must daily co-operate for the purpose of creation.

In case the creation, preservation and the destruction of the universe is not carried out simultaneously, then our present forms and those of Maya could never become purposeful.

Inspite of all three of us being one, but we have been separated having individual entity, because of respective duties assigned to each one of us. In case the difference in duties is not established, then the bifurcation of duties would be of no avail.

Lord Mahesvara has taken to three forms, because of his own Maya, inspite of his being one. Even otherwise, O Lord you are free because of your sports.

Visnu emerged out of the left side of Siva, I (Brahma) from the right side, and you emerged out of his heart.

O Eternal one, in this way, we have been divided into three separate forms. In one way, we both are the sons of Siva and Siva (Parvati) and this should be well understood.

O Lord, at your command, both of us got the wives and engaged ourselves in the cause of the universe.

Therefore, you also, for the welfare of the universe and for the comfort of the gods, take a beautiful woman as your spouse.

O Mahesan, I have been reminded of an old story, which you will please listen from me. This had been narrated to us by you before taking to the form of Siva.

You had said, “O Brahma, the best of my form, was born out of your body and would be known as Rudra in the world.

Then Brahma became the creator, Hari the preserver while I taking to the form of my gunas would become Rudra- the destroyer.

Marrying a woman, I shall perform the job of the universe appropriately.” Getting reminded of your promise, you now keep up your words.

O Lord, I am engaged in the task of creation, at your command Lord Visnu preserves the same and you yourself appear as Rudra for the purpose of destruction.

Without you, both of us, inspite of remaining fully engaged in the respective jobs are unable to perform it fully. Therefore in order to perform the tasks relating to the universe, you select a beautiful damsel for yourself.

As Visnu has Laksmi and myself have Savitri as spouse, similarly, O Siva, you have a spouse for yourself.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Brahma, Siva getting pleased, spoke to me in presence of Visnu.”

Siva said, “O Brahma, O Visnu, both of you are dear to me. I feel delighted on meeting you.

Both of you are excellent among the gods and are the lords of the three worlds. Both of you are engaged in the task of the universe therefore, your words are quite important.

O Best of the gods, both of you should listen to me. It would not be proper for me to marry, because I always remain engaged in the performing of the penance. I am a detached recluse, besides being a well known yogi.

The one who is established in the path of retired life, who moves in his own soul, is free from ignorance, shocking and frightful in form, free from aberrations and a non-reveller. Besides I am unclean and inauspicious. Therefore, I should not have a loving wife and what can I do with her.

I feel delightful in following yoga. The persons possessing enough of knowledge have no liking for kama.

For me, marriage is the biggest bondage in the world. Therefore, I feel the least inclined towards that. I am speaking the truth.

When I think towards that side, then there is no selfish motive involved, nor am I inclined towards that. Still I shall accept your words, which would lead to the benefit of the world.

I taking into consideration, the prestige and importance of your words, I shall marry myself accepting your command. This is because I am always subservient to my devotee.

O Visnu, O Brahma, you listen to my vow, I shall accept only that type of wife for myself.

Suggest a woman with comely features and yogic practices who would be able to receive my virile semen in parts.

She must be a yogini by nature when I practice yoga and a loving woman when I am engaged in love sports.

To whom the learned people well-versed in the Vedas, call as the imperishable one, they also meditate upon Siva, the form of the eternal flame.

O Brahma, when I get absorbed in the meditation no one should create obstruction in my task, otherwise she would feel miserable.

Both Brahma and Visnu have been born from the amsa of Siva of the Supreme Brahman. So we are exceedingly fortunate. It is but proper for us to think about him.

It is this worry that has kept me unmarried. O Brahma, born of lotus, therefore get a wife for me who would always follow my activities.

O Brahma, you accept this condition for my sake that in case she would disbelieve my words then I shall disown her.”

Brahma said, “Thus listening to the words of Siva, I together with Visnu, delightfully spoke with humility.

O Master, O Lord, O Mahesan, the type of women you have desired, I would like to speak about the same type of woman, quite lovingly.

Uma, who establishes all the tasks of the world has been born with difficulty in the world. She was born in the same way as Laksmi and Sarasvati were born in earlier times.

Laksmi became the wife of Visnu and Sarasvati became the wife of Brahma. Her third form has appeared for the sake of our third form.

O Lord, Daksa Prajapati has a daughter known by the name of Sati. She happens to be the wife as desired by you, who will do good to all.

O Lord of the gods; she, after having a harsh vow, is performing severe tapas in order to achieve you as a husband.

O Mahesvara, you better proceed to her in order to bestow boon to her. After granting her the desired boon, you better marry her.

O Lord Siva, this is, what is desired by me, Visnu as well as the other gods. You kindly fulfil the same so that we may be able to witness the marriage ceremony, gracefully.

This would be a happy and auspicious occasion in the three worlds. Let all the ailments disappear. There would be no doubt about it.

At the end of the speech, Visnu the killer of demon Madhu, spoke to Siva, who assumes various forms, during his divine sports and to whom the devotees are quite dear.

Visnu said, “O God of gods, O Mahadeva, O Ocean of mercy, O Lord Siva, whatever has been spoken by Brahma, they are undoubtedly my words.

O Siva, being merciful on me, you kindly accept the marriage and cast your benevolent vision over the world.”

Brahma said, “O Sage! thus speaking, wise lord Visnu kept quiet.” Then lord Siva, affectionate towards devotees, said with smile “be it so.”

All of us were pleased at the consent of Siva, and gladly we returned to our abodes with our wives and sages.”

## Chapter 17 - Siva grants boon to Sati

Brahma said, “O Sage, when all the gods so spoke to Sati, she with her heart filled with devotion, and the way she achieved a boon from Siva, you listen from me.

Thereafter, Sati again, adored Siva, the lord of all on the eighth bright day of the month of Asvin.

In this way, after the completion of the Nandyavrata, on the navamitithi on the next day, Siva appeared before her when she was engrossed in meditation.

All his limbs were beautiful, had a fair complexion, five heads, three eyes, wearing crescent over the head, delightful face, blue- neck, four-arms, holding the trident, having the matted locks of hair over the head, displaying varada-mudra, with his body plastered with holy ashes, having beautiful limbs of the body, abode of enormous grace, having beautiful face like the crores of suns, having the lustre of crores of Kamadevas, having the body which attracted the damsels.

Finding such a type of lord Siva before her, Sati lowered her face with shyness and offered her salutation at his feet.

Then lord Siva was desirous of Sati as his wife who had performed vratas, but still he said.

Mahadeva said, “O Daughter of Daksa having performed sever tapas. I feel pleased with your vrata. Therefore you ask for a boon which I shall surely give you.”

Brahma spoke, “Mahadeva, the lord of the universe, even after being aware of her feelings, in order to listen to her words, desired her to ask for a boon.”

She too, who was also highly bashful, could not speak out her mind as it was covered up by shyness.

But on hearing the words of Siva, she felt overwhelmed with love, realising which, lord Siva, who is well disposed towards his devotees, felt extremely happy.

Siva, who was well aware of the feelings of the hearts of the noble people, was overpowered with the devotion of Sati and repeated to ask for boon.”

Having been overpowered with shyness, Sati said to Siva, “O Bestower of boons, you pronounce a boon for me according to your own liking.

Then Siva favourably disposed towards his devotees, said to Sati, before she could complete her sentence. “You become my wife.”

Thus listening to the words spoken and feeling delighted at heart, she kept quiet. She was highly delighted on obtaining the boon stationed in her mind.

She stood before Siva smilingly sweetly, who was filled with love. She displayed her inner-most feelings through several subtle gestures which increased love.

Observing the motions, gestures and feelings, the flavour of love, known as Srngara entered their hearts.

O Divine saint, following the worldly sports in the minds of both of them, the Srngar-rasa started flowing and both of them, appeared graceful like the moon of the Citra constellation.

Sati had the complexion of black collyrium, after achieving Siva, looked beautiful like the line of clouds near the moon.

Thereafter Sati, the delighted daughter of Daksa spoke to Siva who is favourably disposed to His devotees with folded hands.

Sati said, “O God of gods, O Mahadeva, O Lord of the universe, you better accept me from my father, after marriage.”

Brahma said, “Thus listening to the words of Sati, Siva, who is well disposed towards his devotees, accepting her prayer, lovingly looked at Sati.

Sati too, devotedly offering her salutation to Siva, and with his permission, delightfully went to his mother.

Siva on the other hand returning to his asrama could not concentrate his mind in separation from Sati.

Thereafter, O Divine saint, accepting the way of the world, Siva, remembered me in his mind.

Siva the holder of a trident, when so meditated upon me, I at once, inspired with his success, reached before him.

The peak of the Himalaya over which he was seated having been separated from Sati, I arrived there, in the company of Sarasvati, O divine saint, finding my arrival there with Sarasvati lord Siva, having been bound with the love of Siva, spoke to me.

Siva said, “O Brahma, I am presently engaged in the relpish motive of my marriage.

I have developed a feeling of possession in everything connected with self interest.

I have been adored by Sati- the daughter of Daksa with immense devotion. Because of the influence of Nandyavrata I have granted her a boon.

O Brahma, she has accepted me as a husband and I have delightfully accepted her as my wife.

Sati, the daughter of Daksa Prajapati prayed to me, that I should accept her in the presence of her parents.

O Brahma, I have also accepted her request, quite delightfully. She has now returned to her parental home and I have returned here.

Therefore, you at my command, go to the house of Daksa, and request him to offer kanyadana to me.

O Brahma, you are well-versed in all the vidyas. You go to Daksa Prajapati and do something by which my separation from Sati is removed.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, finding Sarasvati seated besides me, Siva started feeling his separation from Sati.

Then I, with his permission, felt contented, and delightful and then spoke to Siva, the lord of the universe.”

Brahma said, “O Lord, O Siva, whatever have you spoken presently, there is my own selfishness as well as those of the gods enshrined in the same.

Though Daksa Prajapati, will give has own daughter to you still I would like to speak to him on your behalf.

Brahma said, “Thus speaking to Siva, the lord of all, I reached the house of Daksa with the fast moving chariot.”

Narada said, “O Destiny, O Intelligent one, O Best among the speakers, what did Daksa do after the return of Sati to her home.”

Brahma said, “After receiving the desired boon performing the tapas, Sati returned to her home and offered her salutation to her parents.

The fact of her pleasing Siva and getting the boon in return was conveyed by her to her parents through her hand-maid.

On hearing the news about Sati’s receiving the boon from Siva, her parents felt delighted and they started celebrating the occasion.

The large hearted Daksa gave away daksina to the Brahmanas, while Virini gave away charities to the blind and the poor people.

Virini on the other hand, embraced her daughter, smelling her head kept on praising her again and again.

After the lapse of sometime, Daksa- the religious soul, thought of ways to give away the daughter to Siva.

“Mahadeva arrived here and then went back, then how shall he arrive to have the daughter?” He thought.

“In case I send some one appropriately to Siva, and in case of his refusal to accept my daughter, my effort would become infructuous. Therefore it would not be proper.

Or otherwise I shall adore Siva with my daughter, as a result of which the task would automatically be established.

When Siva is adored by Sati with devotion, then he would also become desirous to have her as his wife. He has already given a boon to Sati.”

While Daksa Prajapati was so thinking, then I, at the same time, accompanied with Sarasvati, reached the place.

On my arrival, Daksa Prajapati, offering his salutation to me gave me the appropriate seat.

Though Daksa had been worried at that point of time, but still, he feeling delighted on my arrival and enquired me of the reason of my arrival there.”

Daksa said, “O Preceptor of the universe, O Creator of the world, what is the purpose of your arrival here. You kindly speak out the same.

O Creator of the universe, have you arrived here because of your affection for me or due to some other reason? Your presence here has pleased me very much.”

Brahma said, “O Excellent sage, when so asked by my son, delighting him, I spoke to him.”

Brahma said, “O Daksa, you listen about the purpose of my visit here. It is my duty to think of the welfare of your progeny.

Your daughter has pleased lord Siva with her adoration and received a boon, the time for which has arrived.

Siva has sent me quickly to get your daughter for him. On this occasion, whatever has to be done by you, you should do it.

Lord Siva, after blessing your daughter with a boon returned. But ever since, he has not had any mental peace due to separation from your daughter.

The god of love, who, after making all the efforts, could not conquer Siva, the same Siva, having been hurt by the arrows of Kama is presently thinking about Sati, like an ordinary person.

Forgetting about his earlier conduct, he is feeling the absence of Sati in the presence of his attendants.

O Son, whatever had been desired by you in earlier times with Marici and others, is coming out to be true in my case as well.

Your daughter had adored Siva and now Siva is residing in the Himalayas thinking of her and meditating her alone.

As Sati had adored Siva by performing various rites with Sattvic feelings, similarly Siva is adoring her.

Therefore the daughter, who has been produced by you for the sake of Siva, be given to him, feeling successful.

I shall bring him here at your house, with Narada and you give away your daughter Sati to him”

Brahma said, “Listening to my words Daksa, my son, feeling extremely delighted, said, “Whatever has been spoken by you is acceptable to me.

O Sage, thereafter feeling extremely delighted, I delightfully reached the place where, Siva the lord of the universe was seated.

O Narada, after my departure from there, Daksa Prajapati felt successful, with his wife, like the Vase having been filled with nectar.

## Chapter 18 - Marriage of Siva and Sati

Narada said, “O Dear one, on your going to Siva, then how did Siva conduct himself? What did he say to you?”

Brahma said, “Thereafter getting delightful, I went to Himalaya in order to get lord Siva from there.

At my return, the creator of the universe, the bull-emblemed Siva developed a doubt about the acquisition of Sati.

Thereafter, lord Siva, conducting himself like an ordinary person and influenced with the devotion of Sati, said to me.

Siva said, “O Brahma, what did your son Daksa speak to you about the giving away of Sati to me? You tell me lest my heart bursts with passion.

Î Brahma, my mind is dragging me towards Sati forcefully and I am not desirous of any other wife as well.

Î Brahma, I have an inseparable relationship with Sati, therefore you do something by which, I could get her.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the worldly talk of Siva, Î Sage Narada, I reassured Siva appropriately.”

Brahma said, “O Bull bannered Siva, with the words spoken by Daksa to me, you think your task to have been established.

He had said that the daughter Sati had been produced for the sake of Siva, would be given to him by me but I have a desire in this connection.

My daughter had adored for the same purpose. Then I would give my daughter, in case Siva desires her from me.

Î Brahma, let him arrive at my place on an auspicious time and date, then I shall give away my daughter as a charity.

Î Bull-bannered one, these were the words spoken by Daksa to me. Therefore, you reach at his house on an auspicious day, and get Sati from there.”

Brahma said, “Thus listening to my words, Siva according to the worldly tradition, spoke to me smilingly.”

Siva said, “I shall go to his house accompanied with you and Narada, Î Creator of the universe, You better remember Narada.

Î Brahma, you also remember your mind- born sons like Marlci and others. I shall go to Daksa’s place with, you, Narada and your mind born sons besides my ganas.”

Brahma said, At the command of Siva, following the worldly traditions, I remembered Narada, Marlca and my other mind-born sons.

With my remembering them, all my mind- born sons, with you, reached there quite respectfully.

When remembered by Siva, Visnu- Parama-Mahesvara, soon arrived there with his Laksmi and the army, seated over Garuda.

Thereafter on the thirteenth bright day falling on Sunday, during the Purvaphalgunl constellation, Siva started the journey.

Siva looked graceful travelling with Brahma, Visnu, the gods and other sages.

Great festivities were arranged by Devas and the attendants of Siva who were in the enthusiastic mood, on their way.

The elephant, the bull-Nandi, tigers, serpents, digit of the moon, as well as the matted locks of hair, were turned into ornaments, at the instance of Siva.

Thereafter the valorous yogi, accompanied by Nandisvara, Lord Siva accompanied with Visnu and others, reached the place of Daksa Prajapati.

Then the humble Daksa, feeling delightful, welcomed them with his family.

Daksa Prajapati welcomed all the gods, himself. The sages were seated in their due order.

Accompanied with all the gods and the sages, Daksa took Siva in his house.

The delightful Prajapati, observing all the formalities, adored lord Siva.

Thereafter Daksa also adored Brahma, Visnu, the gods, Brahmanas and the ganas quite appropriately.

Daksa also adored the respectable mind- born sons of Brahma, welcoming all of them.

Then Daksa offering his salutation to Brahma, his father lovingly said, “You better perform this marriage.”

Then I delightfully replied to him.” All right, I shall do this job.” Thus speaking the entire task was completed by me.

Thereafter with the strength of the planets, in the auspicious lagna and muhurtta, Daksa gave away his daughter Sati to Siva.

Siva also received the hand of Sati, with all the appropriate marriage rites.

I myself (Brahma) Visnu and other gods and sages, offered their salutation to Siva, praising him at the same time. At that point of time, huge festivities besides dancing and singing were celebrated, which delighted the gods and the sages.

## Chapter 19 - Sports of Sati

Brahma said, “Daksa getting pleased performed kanyddana of his daughter in favour of Siva and also gave him several types of dowry besides daksind to Brahmanas.

Thereafter lord Visnu together with Laksmi spoke to Siva with his hands folded.

Visnu said, “O God of gods, Î Mahadeva, Î Ocean of mercy, you happen to be the father of the entire universe, while Sati is the mother.

You incarnate on earth for the punishing of the wicked people and for the welfare of the noble ones. This is the eternal truth.

Î Siva, with Sati having the complexion of glossy collyrium, you look as graceful as Laksmi looks graceful with me (Visnu).

Now along with Sati, protect the good people and the devas. And bestow auspicous goodness upon the people of this world.

Î Lord, looking at Sati or the one who becomes desirous of him because of her virtues, you must kill him. This is my request.

Brahma said, “At these words of Visnu, the omniscient Siva, smilingly said to Visnu, killer of Madhu demon “Be it so.”

Î Sage, thereafter Visnu, went to his place and celebrated the occasion and he did not reveal his talk to anyone else.

Thereafter, together with Sati, I performed the homa as prescribed in the Grhyavasutras, appropriately.

Then both Siva and Sati feeling pleased, performed the circumambulation of fire making me to officiate as a priest.

Î Narada, a grand function was organised with dance and music, observing which all felt comforted.

At that point of time an astonishing event took place, which I am going to speak out to you.

No one can ever be aware of the illusion of Siva and as such all the gods humans, mobiles and immobiles get fascinated.

Earlier, I had to fascinate Siva, therefore he then fascinated me and Visnu with his illusion.

One who intends to do evil to others, surely he is caught in the ugly situation. Realising this and one should not have evil designs against the other.

When Sati was going round the fire, I sighted both his feet out of the cover of cloth.

Î Narada, with the illusion of Siva, looking at these feet, I became lustful and started looking at the limbs of Sati.

Out of anxiety, the more I looked at her limbs, the more I became lustful.

Î Sage, thus, I, looking at the chaste daughter of Daksa, becoming lustful, became desirous of looking at her face.

Feeling shy, I could not look her face in the presence of Siva and she also out of shyness, could not remove veil from her face.

Thereafter, becoming lustful in order to have a look at the face of Sati, I thought of a way by which huge ball of smoke was created.

For this purpose, enough of the wet wood was dropped in the fire with the little of ghee poured over the same.

As a result of this enough of smoke was created with the wet stuff poured in the fire, which was spread everywhere. The land surrounding the fire altar, was covered with darkness.

Then Siva, who performing several types of sports, covered his eyes with both his hands.

Then, Î Sage, I, being lustful removing the cloth, delightfully looked at the face of Sati.

Î Dear one, I looked at the face of Sati, again and again and found myself helpless in curbing my sensuous desire.

Four drops of semen virile, got ejected and fell on the ground like the dew drops, as a result of my staring at the face of Sati.

Î Sage, I was then stunned into silence and felt surprised. I became suspicious, I covered the semen drops to conceal them from the sight of others.

But lord Siva detected it with his divine sight. The dropping down of the semen infuriated him and he uttered.

Siva said, “O Sinful one, why have to done this deplorable deed? You have looked at my wife with lustful eye at the time of my marriage, why did you do so?

Do you think that Siva is unaware of your misdeed? Which one of the deed in the world is unknown to me?

Whatever mobile or immobile creatures are there in the world, I live in all of them as the oil remains in the sesamum seeds.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, and getting reminded of the words of Visnu, Siva who dearly loved Visnu, lifted his trident and was about to kill Brahma (me).

Î Excellent one, at the lifting of the trident by Siva, to kill me, Marici and others raised hue and cry.

Then all the gods and the sages, felt extremely terrified and started eulogising Siva, who was burning in anger like the fire.

The gods said, “O Lord, Î Great Lord, you protect those who take refuge under you. Î Siva, save us. Î Lord Siva, be pleased.

Î Mahesa, you are the creator of the universe, while Sati happens to be the mother of the universe. Î Lord, Brahma, Visnu and other gods are just your slaves.

You have an astonishing form and sports. Your illusion is quite surprising. Those who are not devoted to you are overpowered with your illusion.”

Then Brahma said, “In this way all the gods and the sages prayed to the angered Siva.

Becoming doubtful, Daksa raised his hands again and again, went close to Siva and said, “Don’t do this.”

Thereafter, when Siva observed Daksa Prajapati to be in front of him, and having been reminded of the words of Visnu, then he spoke unpleasant words to Daksa.”

Siva said, “Visnu- my dearest devotee had just spoken in few words, which had been accepted by me.

He had stated that whosoever would look at Sat! with lustful eye, should be killed by you. Therefore, I shall stand to the truth of the words, I gave to Visnu.

Brahma, looking at Sati with lustful eye, dropped the semen, therefore, I shall surely kill him.”

Then Brahma said, “O Mahadeva, you are the lord of the gods and at the words thus spoken by him all the gods, sages and the humans present started trembling with fear.

Terrific panic was created there. All felt gloomy there and I having been overpowered with the illusion of Siva, became extremely nervous.

When Siva was so getting ready for the killing of Brahma, Visnu, who had been expert in pleasing Siva, offering his salutation to Siva, pleased him.

He offering several types of prayers to Siva, prevented him from killing Brahma and said.

He said, “Î Lord Siva, don’t kill Brahma, the creator of the universe. He has taken refuge with you today, while you love the people, who take refuge with you.

I am your extremely dear devotee, therefore, I am called the king of the devotees. You kindly accept my prayer, be graceful on me.

Î Master, you listen to another request of mine, which may kindly be accepted by you, becoming graceful on me.

Î Siva, this four faced Brahma has been created for the creation of the universe. By killing him, we can find no other creator.

Î Master, with your command, we the three gods are engaged in creation, preservation and the destruction of the universe and we shall do so again and again.

After killing him, who is going to attend the work of creation? Therefore, you being the creator, preserver and the destroyer of the universe, should not kill him.

Î lord, it was by him that Sati, the daughter of Daksa was fixed up as your wife by good means.

Brahma said, “Listening to the prayer of Visnu, Siva with a firm resolve, said to him.

Siva said, “O God of the gods, Î Lord of Rama, Î Visnu, don’t stop me from killing this wicked person.

Your earlier request which had been accepted by me, I shall fulfil the same by killing this wicked Brahma.

Henceforth, I shall engage myself in the creation of mobile and immobile beings and shall produce other creator with my own strength.

By killing Brahma, I shall keep up my words and also create a creator. Excuse me, please don’t stop me from killing him.

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Visnu, about stopping Siva for his action, Visnu smilingly said, “Don’t do this.”

Visnu said, “Î God of destruction, fulfilling of the promise is but proper in you, the great being. But think over, Î Lord, the desire to kill cannot be directed by one’s own self.

Î Siva, we three are not different and are one and the same. Therefore you better think over this factual position.”

Then listening to the words of Visnu who had been extremely dear to him, Siva making his mental position quite clear, spoke to him.

Siva said, “O Visnu, you are the master of all the devotees, how could Brahma become my soul? He appears to be totally separate from me.”

Brahma said, “When Siva spoke thus in the presence of all, then pleasing him, Visnu spoke to graet lord.

Visnu said, “O Lord Parmes'vara, in fact neither you are separate from Brahma nor Brahma is separate from you. Similarly neither I am separate from you nor you are separate from me.

Î All knowledgeable one, Î Paramesvara, Î Sadas'iva, you are well aware of everything, but you still want to listen from my mouth.

Let all the gods and the sages listen to me. I embracing Siva-tattva, with your permission am speaking out this.

Î Lord, the manifest and unmanifest, divisible and indivisible, possessing form and formless brilliance, we are the three parts.

Who are you? Who am I, who is Brahma; these would be useless questions. You are the supreme soul. The universe has been created by you, is preserved by you and is destroyed by you.

You better think of your own self through your own self. Î Divine one, taking up a physical body by your own sports, you happen to be the sole Brahman, while we three in attributive forms are your very parts.

Î Siva, as a body has the limbs like the head, neck and others, similarly, we three happen to be your limbs.

Î Siva, you happen to be the supreme lustre, the firmament, having your own body. You are the primordial being having your own immovable, the unmanifest, endless forms, the eternal one and devoid of attributes- length etc. From this form alone, everything else has emanated.

Brahma said, “O Sage, listening to the words of Visnu, Siva felt pleased and he did not kill me.”

## Chapter 20 - Festivities of Sati’s marriage

Narada said, “O Brahma, Î Lord, you have narrated the surprising type of the benevolent story of Siva.

Î Dear one, what happened thereafter, you kindly carry on the narration of the divine story of Siva and Sati, which relieves one of all the sins.”

Brahma said, “ Siva, who is always kind to his devotees, when failed to kill me, then, all the gods, sages became fearless and comforted.

All of them then lowering their heads, folding their hands started offering their salutation, besides shouting the slogans of the victory of Siva, with devotion.

Î Excellent sage, at that point of time, I feeling fearless and delighted, offered prayers to Siva with great devotion.

Then lord Siva who engages himself in several types of sports, spoke in presence of all.”

Siva said, “O Dear one, Î Brahma, I am quite happy, you be fearless now. At my command, you touch your head with your hands.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Siva who performs several types of sports, I offered my salutation to Siva, touching my head with my hands.

The moment I touched my head with my hands, I became the bull- his vehicle.

I felt ashamed. All the gods, who had been surrounding me looked at this event. Finding myself with the form of a bull, I felt ashamed and sat aside, covering my head.

Then I felt ashamed and offering my salutation to Siva, offered prayer to him begging forgiveness.

I said, “O Lord, you kindly tell me some repetence to free myself from the sin. Even killing is justifiable. May my sin be removed thereby."

When I spoke these words, lord Siva was pleased with me and spoke to me being the one who is benevolent to his devotees.”

Siva said, “In this very form of a bull, which happens to be my vehicle, you perform penance, with a delightful heart, and desire for propitiating me.

You will be known in the world as Rudrasira, and shall bring to success all the tasks of the Brahmanas.

Besides you have dropped your semen here, which is the conduct of the people. Therefore, becoming a human, you wander on earth.

A person, who looking at your this form, will wander on earth, would say, “How has Rudra’s head been fixed over the head of Brahma?”

Whosoever will listen to this event with surprise, he will discard the company of the wife of others and shall achieve salvation.

When the people will discuss about your misconduct, you shall be relieved of the related sin.

Î Brahma, this is the repentence prescribed by me for your sin, by which all the people would laugh at you and talk about your misdeed, denouncing you at the same time.

Becoming lustful when your semen fell on the ground, and had been seen by me, it shall not be retained by anyone.

The four drops of semen which fell on the ground, the similar number of clouds, causing dissolution shall appear in the sky.”

In the meantime, at these words of Siva, in full view of the gods and the sages, an equal number of clouds emanated from the semen of Brahma.

Î Dear one, four types of huge clouds which caused destruction were known as Samavartaka the Avarta, the Puskara and the Drona.

Î Excellent sage, those clouds were resembling and roaring with terrific sound dropped showers at the slightest wish of Siva, and were burst in the sky.

When the clouds started thundering in the sky, then lord Siva, with Sati became calm and peaceful.

Î Excellent sage, thereafter, I becoming fearless, at the command of Siva, completed the remaining rites of the marriage.

Î Excellent sage, at that point of time, all the gods having been filled with pleasure, dropped the rain of flowers over Siva and Sati.

The musical instruments were sounded at that time, besides the singing, while the Brahmanas were reciting the hymns from the Vedas with devotion.

Î Narada, the Apsaras like Rambha and others started dancing and while doing so they performed great festivities with the wives of the gods.

Thereafter lord Parmesvara, observing the people’s traditions, said to me delightfully with folded hands.”

Siva said, “O Brahma, you have well- performed all the rites of the marriage. Since you are the priest, what should I give you as daksina?

Î Brahma, though it is beyond the reach of the people, still you will please speak out. Î Exalted one, there is nothing which cannot be given to you.”

Brahma said, “O Excellent sage, when Siva spoke these words with folded hands, I becoming humble said to Siva repeatedly.”

Brahma said, “O Lord of gods, in case I am suitable enough to receive a boon, and in case you are pleased with me, Î Mahesvara, then you do whatever I want you to do with pleasure.

Î Mahesvara, you in this form, remain present over this pedestal always for the destruction of the sins of the people.

Î Siva, Î God with crescent moon over the head, by this, I could be able to perform tapas making an asrama in your vicinity in order to destroy my sins.

A person who will have an audience with you on the bright thirteenth day of the month of Caitra, with devotion, Î Siva, you shall destroy his sins at the same time. Let his virtues be increased and he should be free from all the ailments.

A woman who is barren, one eyed, ugly or unfortunate, after her visit to this place be freed from all the short-comings.

Brahma said, “Listening to my words which bestow all types of comforts, Siva said delightfully, “All right, be it so.”

“O Brahma, at your words, and also for the welfare of all, I shall be seated at this pedestal with Sati.

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, lord Siva, in his partial form was seated over the pedestal with his wife.

Thereafter getting leave of Daksa Prajapati, Paramesvara- Siva, who is benevolent over his devotees, got ready to get back to his abode with his wife.

In the meantime the humble and wise Daksa, prayed to Siva with folded hands, and eulogised Siva in reverence.

Besides Visnu, with gods and sages also offered prayers to Siva, shouting slogans of his victory.

With the permission of Daksa, both Siva and Sati were mounted over the bull and proceeded towards the peak of Himalaya.

Thereafter Sati mounted over the bull with Siva looked as graceful as the black line with the moon.

After their departure, Visnu and other gods, the great sages like Marlci and others, besides Daksa were overpowered with illusion.

Some people played on the musical instruments, some people sang the glory of Siva and delightfully followed Siva.

Daksa Prajapati and others saw him off upto the half way and overwhelmed with the love of Siva, they returned to their respective homes together with their attendants.

Though, Siva had sent off Visnu and other gods, but out of affection, they went with Siva.

Together with the gods, his attendants, and Sati, his wife, Siva delightfully reached his abode in Himalaya.

Reaching there, Siva bade farewell to all the gods, and the sages with great respect.

Talking with Siva, bowing in reverence to him, offering prayer to him, Visnu and other gods, besides the sages, went to their respective places.

Lord Siva, as well started living with pleasures with Sati, the daughter of Daksa, in Himalaya.

Î Excellent sage, thereafter, Siva, the creator of the universe, together with Sati and his attendants, feeling pleased went to his abode in Kailasa.

I have narrated the story of the marriage of Siva, during the time of Svayambhuva-Manu as had happened earlier.

The one who listens to the story of Siva’s marriage, quite carefully, adoring him at the same time, at the time of marriage, his marriage and all other rites are performed without any obstruction.

By listening to this story, a girl achieves pleasure of having fortunes, excellent humility, noble conduct and chastity, besides getting a son.

## Chapter 21 - Sports of Siva and Sati

Narada said, “Î Dear one, Î Sinless one, listening to your appropriate and astonishing types of words, concerning the auspicious story of Siva and Sati we feel delighted.

Brahma said, “O Excellent sage, Î Noble one, you have inspired me to speak about the story of Siva, further, which I am going to narrate. He is extremely compassionate.

After the marriage of Siva with Sati, the mother of the three worlds, he returned to his place and what happened thereafter, you please listen from me.

Then Siva, accompanied with his ganas, reached his blissful place and got down from Nandi.

Î Narada, Siva, after entering his place with Sati, was immensely delighted, being well-versed in the worldly practices.

Getting Sati, Siva, asked his attendants and Nandi to go to the mountain cave.

Siva, who was well versed with the worldly traditions, spoke to Nandi and other attendants quite sweatly.

Siva said, Î my attendants, with minds respectfully concentrated in thinking upon me, “You should come to me, whenever, I remember you.”

At these words of Vamadeva, the valorous ganas retired to their respective places.

After their departure, when Siva was left alone with Sati, Siva felt extremely delighted enjoying many sports with her.

He sometimes collected some sylvan flowers and made a beautiful garland out of them and put it around the neck of Sati as a substitute for a necklace.

When Sati was appreciating her face by looking into the mirror, Siva arrived from the back side and looked at his own face through the same mirror.

At times, he played with her ear-rings. Sometimes he removed them from the ears of Sati and the next moment, he adorned her ears with the same ear-ornaments.

Sometimes Siva made the red feet of Sati completely red with the application of the red dye.

The words which could be spoken quite loudly in the presence of others, Siva whispered them in her ears with greed to have a look at her face.

Siva never moved away from Sati, but in case he did so, he would return suddenly and close her eyes from behind and while she was thinking about something, else, he would ask her his name.

With the use of his illusion, Siva would sometimes become invisible, and suddenly embrace her making her terrified and agitated.

Sometimes he would draw painting of the buds of lotus flowers resembling the bees over her breasts, with musk which appeared like the golden lotus.

Sometimes he would remove the necklace worn by her and press the breasts with his hands.

Sometimes Siva would remove, the bracelets, bangles as well as the finger-rings from the limbs and then replace then at the proper places, one by one.

Even when she was looking on sometimes he would touch her lofty breasts saying smilingly, “This dark spot on your breast, is your companion of the same colour as it contains the same letters as are found in your name.”

Sometimes when he was exceedingly excited with love, he would exchange love sports with his beloved.

Sometimes Siva brought beautiful lotus and other flowers and decorated them as ornaments over the body of Sati.

Siva who is well disposed with his devotees, accompanied with Sati, kept on sporting in the mountain and bowers.

Siva never went anywhere without Sati, nor did he engage himself in any activity without her. Why to speak much, he never felt comfortable without her.

In this way after roaming about in the mountain bowers of Kailasa, remembering the god of love, both of them reached the Himalaya mountain.

With the arrival of Kamadeva before Siva and coming to know of the desire of Siva, Vasanta too expanded his form.

All the trees and the creepers were sprouted and the black wasps started hovering over them.

With the arrival of the spring season, the pleasing fragrant breeze started flowing.

Like the crescent moon of the evening time, the Palasa- flowers looked beautiful. The flowers blossoming in the trees, appeared like the arrows of the god of love.

The blossoming lotus flowers in the lakes looked quite charming. The fragrant wind-god was getting ready to captivate all.

The Nagakesara trees Mesua-roxburgii) with yellow flowers, resembled the banner of Kamadeva, appeared close to Siva.

The close creeper issued fragrance that filled the air, captivated the passionate people first of all.

The good looking black-wasps, creating humming sound over the mango and Sail trees, appeared like the open conches.

As the minds of the sage become spotless with the light of the knowledge, similarly at that point of time, the spotless clean water appeared beautiful.

The snow was melting with the fall of the sun rays, and had started flowing as a result of which the water of the lakes was getting reduced.

The dew drops on coming in contact with the sun-rays, were turned in vapours, like the hearts of the people, are purified in association with the noble people.

At that point of time, Mahadeva, accompanied with Sati, sported over that mountain for a long time, among the groves, bowers, and streams.

Î Excellent sage, the daughter of Daksa appeared graceful at that point of time, roaming with Siva who too could not have mental peace without her even for a moment.

The goddess Sati felt fully satisfied in the matter of conjugal pleasure and seemed to have entered the body of Siva.

Siva too making the garlands of flowers by himself decorated the limbs of Sati.

Siva appeared to be displaying his competence with diverse conversation, pleasant glances, jovial words, exchange of smiles, by which he was introducing himself to Sati.

Drinking the nectar from her moon like face, Siva stabilised his body. Sometimes, he experienced exhilarating and particularly pleasing state.

Siva appeared to have been bound with the sweet fragrance of the lotus like face of Sati besides her beauty and jovial nature, as a huge elephant is bound with ropes.

Thus in the bowers and caverns of Himalaya, besides the caves, Siva enjoyed conjugal pleasures with Sati- the daughter of Daksa and while doing so, twenty five divine years were passed.

## Chapter 22 - Love sports of Siva and Sati over the Himalaya

Brahma said, “While both Siva and Sati were dwelling over the ridge of the Kailasa mountain, Sati, the daughter of Daksa, said to Siva at the advent of the clouds.

Sati said, “O Lord of gods, Î Siva, my dear husband, Î Bestower of honour, you please listen to my words and do as desired by me.

The unbearable rainy season has arrived. All the ten directions have been covered with the clouds of rain.

The winds are blowing forcefully which are shaking the heart and water drops mixed with the dust of the kadamba tree have started falling.

The clouds are thundering. The streams of water are falling. Whose mind remains undisturbed with the thundering of the clouds with banners of lightening?

Because of the clouds flying in the sky neither the sun nor the moon is visible. The day which is painful for those separated in love, also looks like the night.

Î Siva, the clouds which are thundering with the force of the wind, appear like falling over the heads of the people.

Î Siva, with the force of the wind, the huge trees appear like dancing in the sky. These trees frighten the cowards and delight the passionate people.

The clouds which are black like the collyrium, look graceful with the lines of skylarks flying in the sky, in the same way as the water foams float over the surface of the Yamuna water.

Î Siva, he gold wristlet of my forearm, looks at night like the blazing submarine fire.

Î Siva, presently the new plants are sprouting over Mandracala as well as in the courtyards of our place, what to speak of the other places.

The Himalaya mountain, near the Mandaracal mountain has been surrounded by black, red and white clouds and appears charming like the ocean of milk surrounded by the birds.

Displaying the various types of beauties and surrounded by the Kimsuka (Butea frondosa) trees, having flowers without fragrance, in the same way as Laksmi goes to evil as well as the noble people in Kaliyuga, without any discrimination.

Listening to the thundering sound of the clouds of Mandaracala, the peacocks getting delighted start dancing baring their backs. Their pleasant cackles, and outstretched tails display the delight of their hearts.

The sweet and pleasing sound of cataka (a kind of Cuckoo birds) is being heard everywhere. The continuous fall of rain is causing trouble to the travellers.

Look at the wickedness displayed by the clouds, their dropping the hail stones over the peacocks and the cataka birds are causing pain to them.

On finding the distress from their friend the sun, the swans leave for the distant place i.e. the lake of Manasa on the mountain top.

In the difficult times, even the crows, Cakravak (Indian red flagged partridge) also make their nests. How could you remain peaceful without a home.

Î Siva, I feel extremely frightened today. Therefore you please arrange for the building' of a house for me.

You can make a house at Kailasa, Himalaya, or Kas'I, for living over the earth.”

Brahma said, “Having thus been advised by Sati, Siva laughed again and again and the place was illuminated with the crescent moon lodged over the head of Siva.

Thereafter, Siva who had been well aware of all the secrets, said to Sati in order to please her.

Siva said, “O Beloved, by dwelling in my heart, the place where I am going to build a house for you, would be beyond the reach of the clouds.

These clouds reach the middle regions of the Himalaya even in the rainy season.

Î Goddess, these clouds can never go above the middle region of Kailasa. They usually come only upto the foot of Kailasa.

The clouds like Puskaravartaka and others can reach upto the roots of the rose-apple tree.

Thus I have mentioned about the best of the mountains. Now you tell me quickly, as to where do you want to live?

The Anilavrnda birds of the Himalaya having golden feathers, living in the Himalaya, sing with high and sweet tones, will please you at the time of your sports.

The Siddhas beauties there, will please you offering the gem studded seats at their own sweet will. They will also offer you various types of flowers.

The damsels of the Nagar, the mountains and Kinnaries would themselves help you at the time of your roaming about.

The beautiful divine damsels, observing your beautiful face and beauty, thinking their own beauty to be of no consequence would always stare at you.

Menaka the wife of Himalaya the king of mountains, whose beauty is well-known in the three worlds, would delight you very much with entreaties.

The honourable ladies of the household of Himalaya, would cause enormous delight to your gracious self. They would provide you useful advice, though \>ou heardly need any, with pleasure daily.

Î Beloved one, do you intend to go to a place filled with sweet notes of the cuckoos, and the place having the charms of the spring season?

Or would you like to go to Himalaya, the king of the mountains filled with lakes, of cool water and the blossoming lotus flowers?

Reaching there, you would come across kalpavrksa (wish fulfilling tree), grassy lands, several types of flowers, elephants, horses and herds of cows quite delightfully.

In the Himalaya even the wild and ferocious animals are calm. It is the place of several sages and ascetics. It is the abode of the gods and one finds plenty of deer moving about here and there.

It has the ramparts of glittering crystals, gold and silver. It has many lakes like the Manas and others.

The buds and fully-blown lotuses with golden stalks studded with gems are found in abundance. Besides crocodiles, sharks and tortoise abound in the lakes.

Î Goddess of the gods, you can find enough of blue lotuses, emitting sweet fragrance. There are grassy lands over the banks of the lakes, besides the trees which are quite big and small. The saffron flowers, increase the fragrance of the lake waters with which the lakes are full.

The Apricot trees with their shaking branches, appear like dancing or otherwise removing the god of love. These lakes look beautiful with cranes and intoxicated Cakravaka (ruddy-goose) pairs of birds which appear quite fine.

The place is filled with sweet humming sound of the black-wasps which are blissful, increase the passions and the sound of the birds is echoing there. The guardian of the quarters like Indra, Kubera, Yama, Nirriti, Agni and Varuna as well as Marut and the supreme lord Isa (frequently visit the place). The abodes of all the devas are located at the peak of the Meru mountain together with the abodes of the guardian of quarters. The beautiful celestial damsels like Rambha, Saci, Menaka and other apsaras can also be found there.

Do you want to live at Mahagiri, which is the best of all the mountains, which is exceedingly beautiful, and seems as the essence of all the mountains?

The goddess Indrani, with all the apsaras would be at your service daily.

Or would you like to live over Kailasa around which the city of Kubera is lodged?

Or would you like to live at a place where the auspicious and clean water of the Ganga flows, like the full moon, or in caves where the Brahmana girls sing the beautiful and sweet songs?

This place is filled with various types of deer, having hundreds of blossomed lotus flowers, possessing all the virtues and the padarthas, and which is more beautiful than the Sumeru mountain?

Which place, out of those spoken by me above, is liked by you. You tell me. I shall at once, build an abode for you there.”

Brahma said, “After these words of Siva, Sat! slowly mentioned about the place where she wanted to live.”

Sati said, “I would like to live with you in Himalaya, therefore, you kindly have the house built here.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Sati, Siva was delighted and he accompanied with Sati, went to the peak of the Himalaya mountain.

The place where the women of the siddhas are lodged which is beyond the reach of the birds even, where there are enough of lakes filled with lotus flowers, the place which looked pleasant with the different types of flowers. Siva having the temperament of the rising sun sat at that place with Sati.

The mountain was bright like the crystal or mica, having enough of grassy land besides the trees. There were several types of lakes and flowers.

The trees were laden with fruits over which the black wasps were issuing the humming sound. The white as well as the blue lotus flowers were blossoming there.

The intoxicated cakra-vaka (ruddy-birds), kadambas, swans, geese, the intoxicated cranes, and peacocks were found there.

The people, with the sweet voice of the cuckoos, reverberated there. Several types of semi-divine beings like Asvamukhas, Siddhas, Guhyakas and apsaras, roamed about at that place.

The Vidyadharls and Kinnaris were also roaming about at that place, besides the mountain damsels and girls.

The divine damsels played on their lutes, tambourine and drums, dancing with enthusiasm. Thus the mountain had enough of beautiful women, charming lakes, fragrant flowers and the groves of full-blown flowers.

In the place which was pleasant like the heaven, Siva dwelt there for ten thousand divine years delightfully with Sati.

Siva sometimes went to some other place and sometimes at the peak of the Sumeru mountain, which was surrounded by the gods and goddesses.

Sometimes he went to the Islands, orchards, forest and earth and returning from there he lived with Sati comfortably roaming about in the forest.

Siva was so much absorbed in the love of Sati that he discarded yajnas, or Vedas or the penances. Sati stood into the face of Siva, throughout the day and night, while lord Siva did so in the face of Sati.

Thus Sati spent her time by looking at the face of Siva and Mahadeva also looked the face of Sati always at everywhere.

Thus with their mutual association developed the tree of love pouring the water of emotions.

## Chapter 23 - Influence of devotion

Brahma said, “Then Sati enjoying all the conjugal pleasures fully, felt extremely satisfied but gradually became disinterested in the love-sports.

Once Sati, with devotion and obeisance when lonely with Siva offered her salutation to him.

Finding that lord Siva was quite happy at that time, she, the daughter of Daksa humbly folded her hands.

Sati said- Î God of gods, Î Mahadeva, Î Ocean of mercy, Î Lord, you redeem the down trodden besides being a great yogi. You kindly be compassionate on me.

Î Master, you are the supreme Purusa beyond sattva, rajas and tamas. You are with and without gunas, unblemished and the great lord.

I am graceful to become your wife sporting with you. Î Lord you became my husband because you love your devotees.

Î Lord you have enjoyed the conjugal pleasures with me for long and I am quite happy about the same. My mind has been detached from that side.

Î Lord, Î Lord of the gods, I am now desirous of learning the supreme tattva from you, by which a person could cross, quite easily the ocean of the universe.

By following which, a person, achieving the supreme stage need not have to be reborn on earth, kindly narrate the best of that tattvas

Brahma said, Î Excellent sage, Sati asked the question with utmost devotion from Siva for the redemption of the people of the universe.”

Then Siva, who appears in his own form at will, and whose mind was engrossed in the yogic practices, spoke to Sati.

Siva said, “O Goddess Sati, listen to me. I shall explain the great principle, by which a remorseful person is liberated.

Î Great Goddess, by your spotless wisdom you consider Brahman to be the supreme tattva. None else is comparable with the same.

Î Beloved, the said tattva is seldom known to the people. I am just a slave and the Brahman is the greatest of the great.

The devotion bestows the reward of pleasure and liberation. The devotion also is achieved only by my grace, which is of nine types.

There is hardly any difference between devotion and the perfect knowledge. A person who is engrossed in devotion, enjoys perpetual happiness. A person opposing the devotion can never be comfortable.

Î goddess, I am always obedient to my devotees, as a result of which I do not hesitate to visit the abodes of the out-castes or those having no caste.

Î goddess, the devotion is of two types, viz.: attributive and attributeless. One of them is conventional while the other is natural. The first one is excellent, while the latter is the ordinary one (or in other words perpetual and non-perpetual). The perpetual one is further sub-divided into six parts. The people with learnings further classify it into enjoined and non-enjoined. Thus the devotions are many fold which have been defined elsewhere.

Î Dear, Î Daughter of Daksa, the sages have defined nine parts of the devotion, which I am going to speak out and you listen to the same with devotion.

Î Goddess, these nine sub-divisions include listening, eulogising, remembering, serving, complete surrender, worshipping, salutation, friendliness and dedication. Î Siva, their further sub-divisions have also been stated.

Î Goddess, you better listen to the characteristics of these nine parts of the devotion separately. By concentrating the mind in my devotion, it provides the pleasures as well as liberation.

To listen to the recitation of the divine story, seated with a concentrated mind, delightfully, is called sravana or listening.

To remember in one’s mind, the story of my birth and other activities and to repeat them lovingly, or eulogising me is called kirtana (or eulogising).

Î Goddess, considering me always to be an all-pervading and an eternal, when one becomes fearless, it is called Smarana (or remembering).

The servce rendered to the god-head starting from the early morning with the concentrating of the mind, becoming fearless with delight, of the lord, is called serving.

With the complete surrender of one self in the service of a deity, who is worthy of being served, and serving with all the sense organs with the hearty sense of elation, amounts to surrendering.

The one who always serves me like a slave, with favourable mind, offering the sixteen types of service to me, in accordance with one’s capacity is called worshipping or arcana.

While repeating mantras in the mind and touching the earth with eight limbs is called vandana or salutation.

The one who feels that whatever good or bad is done by the lord is for his benefit and this type of feeling is the characteristic sign of friendliness.

When a person dedicates everything to the god-head including the body and all the passions, retaining nothing for himself, is called dedication (or atmasamarpana).

These nine parts of my devotion bestow perfect knowledge, worldly pleasures as well as the salvation and are quite pleasing to me.

There are several parts to these nine types of devotion. The offering of the leaves of wood-apple tree can be included in the same and should himself be thought about by the devotee.

Î Beloved one, my devotion performed in this manner with various adjuncts and subdivisions is treated to be the best. It contributes to the increase in the perfect knowledge and detachment. The liberation is also slave to it. This is the best path.

It produces the fruits of all the rites forever and this devotion is dear to me like you. A person, whose mind is filled with my devotion, he remains extremely dear to me.

There is no other pleasant path in the world, except the devotion. Î Goddess of the gods, the devotion is quite important in all the four yugas, but in the age of Kali, it is of special importance.

The knowledge (jnana) and detachment (vairagya) have grown old and have lost their lustre, during kaliyuga, besides having been decayed and worn out, since the people who could understand them can rarely be found.

Of all the four yugas, devotion bestows the immediate and visible benefits and because of its influence, I remain subservient to my devotees.

The people who are always engaged in my devotion, I also help them. I am the remover of the obstructions. I happen to be the enemy of the person who causes obstructions. I happen to be the enemy of the person who causes obstruction in the activities of my devotees.

Î Goddess, for helping my devotee, I, getting angered, had reduced Kala to ashes who had been guarding me.

Î Goddess, for the sake of my devotee, I became furious with sun also once and conquered him as well, holding a trident in my hand.

Î Goddess, for the sake of my devotee, I disowned Ravana, with his family and also did not help him.

Î Goddess for the sake of my devotee, I had the stubborn Vyasa driven out of Kasi through Nandi.

Î Goddess of the gods, what is use of speaking more, I am always subservient to the devotion and the devotees. There is no doubt about it.”

Brahma said, “Thus listening to the glory of the devotion, Sati- the daughter of Daksa feeling immensely delighted in her mind, offered her salutation to Siva.

Î Excellent sage, she again enquired about the subject, as explained in the scriptures which provides comforts to all the liberate people.

She also enquired about the subjects like yantras, mantras and sastras, with particular reference to their glory, besides other religious matters.

Siva was also delighted at the question of Sati, who continued discussion for the liberation of the people.

Siva then spoke on yantras, s'astras, and their five adjuncts with sacred bearing on the subject with greatness and the glory.

Î Excellent sage, he told her the ancient stories, the greatness of the votaries, the duties of people of the different castes, and stages in life and the duties of the kings.

He also explained the duties of the sons, wives etc. and their greatness, the imperishable system of varnas and asramas, the medical and astral lores which are beneficial to the worldly people.

Out of compassion for her, he also spoke out on the science of palmistry and several other lores.

In this way, lord Siva and Sati who bestow comforts to all three worlds, and are omniscient and appear on the personification of noble qualities, sported over the mountain Kailas'a in the Himalaya and other places.

## Chapter 24 - Sati’s doubt about Rama’s divinity

Narada said, “O Brahma, Î Destiny, lord of the people, Î Immensely intelligent one, you are benevolent to all, you have narrated the excellent glory of Siva and the beautiful Sati, which bestows benevolence.

Now you kindly enlighten us about the further glory of Siva and Sati. What did Siva and Sati do further, residing on that mountain?

Brahma said, “O Excellent sage, you lovingly listen from me, the story of Sati and Siva. Both of them sported always like humans.

Î Excellent sage, according to a tradition, it is stated by the wise people, that the great goddess Sati had to face separation from her husband.

Î Sages, Sakti and Isa always remains together like the word and its meaning, then how could they be really separated?

Or otherwise Siva and Sakti, had sportive interest and all their relative activities would be quite proper, because these activities were based over the human behaviour or tradition.

Then Sati who was forsaken by Siva, at the time of her father’s yajna, ended her life in her father’s yajna because of the disrespect shown by her father to Siva.
