Both the man and the woman, reciting the names of Siva and Siva throughout the day and night, started propitiating on them with devotion.

Mena, used to adore Siva and Siva with devotion. She gave away charities to the Brahmanas, regularly in order to please them.

With the desire of getting a child she daily worshipped Siva, for twenty seven years starting from the month of Caitra (March- April).

Observing a fast on the eighth day of the lunar fortnight she offered charitable gifts of sweets, oblation of rice cakes, puddings and fragrant flowers on the ninth day.

She made the clay idols of the goddess, and adored her offering various items of food, over the banks of the Ganga in Ausadhiprastha.

On certain days she observed complete fast, while on a few days she observed the sacred rites. On some days she observed vratas inhaling the wind alone, while on certain days she consumed water alone.

With her mind devoted to Siva, Mena performed tapas with utmost devotion for twenty seven years.

At the end of twenty seven years, the mother of the universe, Uma-the beloved of Siva, was immensely pleased with Mena.

Showering her compassion over Mena, and getting pleased with her devotion, Paramesvari appeared before her.

She possessed the body with divine limbs, surrounded with the lustrous zone, the goddess spoke to Mena smilingly.”

The goddess said, “O Enormously Chaste lady, you ask for a boon you desire. Î wife of Himacala, I am extremely happy with you.

Î Mena, the way you have adored me by means of tapas, vratas, meditation etc., I shall bestow everything to you which is desired by you.”

Thereafter Menaka, finding the goddess Kalika standing before her, offering her salutation to her said.”

Menaka said, “O Goddess Kalika, your form has been perceived by me directly, just now. Be pleased with me. I intend to offer prayer to you.”

Brahma said, “When so requested by Mena, the goddess, Uma- the enchantress of all, embraced Mena, who was immensely delighted.

Achieving great knowledge, Mena, eulogised Siva, who had appeared in person before her, speaking sweet words which pleased her.

Mena said, “I bow in reverence to the great goddess, who fulfils all the desires. She is Mahamaya, sustainer of the universe, Candika, preserver of all the lokas, salutation to you.

She is always blissful, Maya, Yoganidra, mother of the universe, decorated with the garland of flowers, and having the siddha form, salutation to you.

I bow in reverence to the grandmother, who bestows delight always, who destroys the miseries of all her devotees, you are the bestower of wisdom to the women and the living beings upto the end of the kalpa.

You are the cause of shattering all the bondages of ascetics. How can the persons with little wisdom like me, describe your influence? You are the violence mentioned in the Atharvaveda. You possess powerful means. Fulfil my desire.

You bestow the living beings with the prowess of permanent and impermanent nature. But you happen to be the eternal force of all. You are the eternal force. When the time comes you are associated with yoga and become the woman of great ability.

You are the cause of the creation of the world besides being its sustainer. You are the eternal, the great Prakrti, and even Brahman is brought under control by you. You are of noble nature, Î mother, be pleased with me.

You are the strength of burning in the fire, you are the force of the sun rays, besides being the pleasing rays of the moon. Therefore, Î powerful one, salutation to you. I offer prayer to Candi.

You are the form of love among the women, to the person of the perfect self control, you manifest yourself as eternal. You pervade in the universe as desire, with Visnu you are his Ṅaóṁ, and the same with Siva.

O Goddess, you take to any form at will and engage your self in creation, sustaining as well as destruction. You are the cause in the gods to appear as Brahma, Visnu and Siva. Therefore, you be pleased with me. I offer my salutation to you.’

Brahma said, “Thus Mena, praised Kalika- Durga and thereafter the goddess said, “You ask for a boon.”

The goddess Uma said, “O wife of Himacala, you are dearer to me than my life. I shall surely grant you whatever is desired by you. There is nothing with me which I cannot give you. You ask for a boon.”

Listening to the words of Mahesani, Mena, the wife of Himacala was pleased and said.

Mena said, “O Wise Siva, Î Mahesvari, Î Jagadambika, in case I am suitable enough to ask for a boon, then I ask for a boon.

Î Mother of the universe, first of all, I should have a thousand virtuous, powerful sons with long life.

Thereafter I would desire to have a daughter who should be virtuous, beautiful, pleasing both the races, and adorable by all the three lokas.

Î Siva, this daughter of mine, should be able to establish all the tasks of the gods, and should be the wife of Siva. Î Mother of the universe, you perform such a type of divine sport.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Mena, the delightful goddess spoke, fulfilling her desire.”

The goddess said, “You will have a hundred powerful sons, but one of them shall be immensely powerful.

Getting pleased with your devotion I shall myself be born as your daughter. Having been adored and served by the gods, I shall accomplish all their tasks.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, Siva-Kalika, who is the base of the universe, disappeared from the place in full view of Mena.

Î Dear one, Mena too getting the desired boons from Mahesani, felt immensely delighted as a result of which her pain for the performing of tapas was removed.

Offering her salutation to that direction, feeling pleased, reciting the word Jaya, she returned to her abode.

By looking at the delightful face of Mena, Himalaya well realised the truth, still she repeated the news of her achieving the boons from the goddess.

The lord of mountains felt pleased listening to the news from Mena and praised his wife who was engaged in the devotion of Siva.

Î Sage, in due course of time, Mena, conceived and the pregnancy went on developing.

In due course of time she produced the mountain Mainaka who in due course of time became the beloved of the Naga damsels and subsequently became friendly with the lord of ocean.

Î Divine sage, when Indra, the slayer of Vrtra, became angry and cut off the wings of the flying mountains, Mainaka was saved from the attack from the Vajra of Indra.

Out of the hundred mountain sons born to Mena, Mainaka was the most powerful one.

At that point of time huge festivities were celebrated in the city of Himacala, as a result of which the couple was extremely pleased and their miseries were over.

Then they distributed charities to the beggars and the Brahmana. Then the devotion of Mena and Himacala, at the feet of Siva and Siva kept on growing.

## Chapter 6 - Birth of Parvati

Brahma said, “Thus, both the husband and wife with their minds filled with devotion and reverence, started reciting the names of Siva and Siva, for the establishment of the task of the gods.

Then Candika who had laid down her life in the yajna of her father, desired to be born from the womb of the wife of Himalaya.

In order to prove the truth of her words, Mahesvari who fulfils all the desires, entered the mind of the king of mountains in her full form.

Soon thereafter, he appeared quite charming. Then Himacala possessed the lustre of the fire and great joy, with resplendent brilliance, had the lofty mind.

During the auspicious time Himacala established the amsa of Siva by means of a samadhi in the womb of his beloved.

Then Mena, the wife of Himacala, also with the grace of the compassionate goddess, established the tejas of her husband to be the abode of the universe, gaining resplendence, which looked more graceful.

Delighting her husband, she bore the signs of pregnancy, which was indicative of the delight of her husband and served as an auspicious cause for the future bliss of the gods.

She was so weak that she could not adorn herself with ornaments. Her face faded out like the lodhara flowers. She looked like the night with scanty stars and the moon on the wane.

Kissing her face in seclusion, emitting the fragrance of the earth, the king of mountains was never satisfied and his love kept on increasing.

Since she did not reveal her desired things to the king, therefore he enquired about the same from her handmaids again and again.

Whatever things of the mountain were desired by her, she suddenly found them present before her. Because there was nothing in the three worlds which the lord of mountains could not procure for her even from the heaven.

Passing through the early stage of pregnancy, her limbs developed more and more. Thereafter Mena appeared like the fresh creeper with tender leaves.

Himacala considered that his pregnant wife carried a treasure in her womb hidden like the fire hidden under the earth.

The love he had with his beloved, the way he had earned the riches, besides gaining the knowledge of the scriptures, he performed all the ceremonies of her conception.

He found his beloved reaching the tenth month of pregnancy, like the clouds about to drop the rain. The physicians were present in the labour room.

Finding his beloved with auspicious limbs, the king of the mountains was immensely pleased, since the goddess with immense splendour had been lodged in her womb.

Î Sage, at that point of time Visnu and other gods, besides the sages offered prayer to goddess who was lodged in the womb of Menaka.

The gods said, “O Durga, Î Virtuous one, Î Intelligent one, Î Mother of the universe, Î Mahesvari, Observer of truthful vratas, engaged in truth, speaking the tenth in all the three times, the form of birth, victory to you.

You are always truthful, lover of truth, born of truth, having the truthful mouth and true eyes, all of us have arrived to take refuge with you.

Î Mahesani- the beloved of Siva, you are the remover of the miseries of the gods, you are the mother of the three worlds, Î Sarvani, all pervading and well disposed towards the devotees.

Î Mahesvari, manifest yourself and perform the task of the gods, Î goddess, by your grace, all of us shall feel protected.

The people desirous of comforts always achieve the best of comforts from you. Nothing in the three worlds looks so graceful as you are.”

Brahma said, “Thus the gods eulogised Mahesani variously who was lodged in the womb. Thereafter they went back to this respective abodes.

After the passing of the ninth month, and at the end of the tenth month, Kalika- Jagadamba became desirous of coming out of the womb.

All the constellations, planets, and stars, were quite peaceful at that time. The sky was quite clear all the directions were illuminated.

The forests, villages and the entire land with the ocean became calm and auspicious. The lotuses were blossoming in the tanks, rivers and the step-wells were filled with the blossoming lotus flowers.

Î Excellent sage, the cool and fragrant winds started blowing slowly. The noble people were delighted while the wicked people felt panicky.

The gods arriving in the sky started playing on the big drums. The Gandharvas started singing, besides raining the flowers.

The Vidyadhara damsels, and the apsaras started dancing with delight, the gods at that point of time celebrated a huge festival.

At that point of time Siva, having the form of supreme sakti, manifested herself before Menaka in her true form.

It was the spring season, the month of Caitra (March-April) ninth day of the moon, Mrgasira constellation, at the time of Midnight, she appeared like the Ganga in the lunar region.

From the womb of Mena, she was born in the same way, as Laksmi emerged out of the ocean.

Siva felt pleased at his birth. The auspicious and fragrant wind started blowing slowly at that time.

At that point of time the rain of water and flowers, fell and the clouds started thundering.

With her birth the city of Himacala was filled with all the riches and all the miseries were removed.

Visnu and other gods reached there on that occasion, and had an audience with the mother of the universe, which delighted them all.

All of them eulogised the goddess as Siva, Ṁmba, Kalika, beloved of Siva, having the divine form, Ṅṁhamaóṁ as well as the one, who is the dweller of the Sivaloka.

The gods said, “O Mother of the universe, Î Great goddess, bestower of all types of success, you perform all the tasks of the gods. Therefore, we offer our salutation to you.

You are compassionate on the devotees, bestow welfare on the gods. You have fulfilled the desire of Mena. Now you also fulfil the desire of Siva.”

Brahma said, “Then Visnu and other gods offering prayer to the goddess and bowing in reverence to her, besides immensely praising her returned to their respective abodes.

Î Narada, then having an audience with the goddess Bhagavati also known as Syama, Mena was very much pleased.

Thereafter witnessing the divine form of the goddess, the wife of Himacala was bestowed with divine knowledge. Learning about the truth of the Supreme goddess, feeling delighted she started eulogising her.”

Mena said, “O Jagadamba, Î Mahesani, you have been quite merciful by appearing in my house.

Î Siva, you are the foremost of all the Saktis, you are mother of the three worlds, beloved of Siva and adored by the gods.

Î Mahesani, you better get yourself established on my dhyanam in this form. Now you take to the simple form of my daughter.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of the wife of Himacala, Siva was pleased and she said to Mena.

The goddess said, “O Mena, in earlier times you had served me with devotion. Getting pleased with your devotion, I have arrived here to grant a boon to you.

When I desired you to ask for a boon, then listening to my words, you asked for a boon and said, “O Mahadevi, you become my daughter for the benefit of the gods."

By giving the boon accordingly, I left for my place. Î Beloved of Himacala, I became your daughter suiting to the times.

In case I took to the divine form, it was just to remind you of the earlier event, otherwise you would not have been able even to recognise me.

Both of you, treating me as Bhagavati or your daughter, lovingly, would achieve my supreme position.

I shall perform the tasks of the gods, with my divine sports. I shall redeem the noble people, becoming the wife of Siva.”

Thus speaking, Siva- the mother of the universe, kept quiet. Thereafter in full view of her mother, she became an infant.

## Chapter 7 - Childhood sports of Parvati

Brahma said, “The goddess of immense lustre assumed the form of a baby child in front of Mena and began to cry in accordance with the ways of the world.

O Sage, with the lustre of the goddess emerging out of her body, the lights of the lamps burning in the chamber, were faded out.

Listening to her cries, all the women of the household, feeling delighted arrived there.

The messenger of the inner apartment, went to the king and conveyed the news of the birth of Parvati, who had incarnated for the purpose of the gods.

The messenger of the inner apartment who conveyed the news of the birth of Parvati, was entitled to receive everything except the royal umbrella.

The mountain king accompanied with the priest as well as the Brahmanas went to see the girl who was self illumining.

She had the reflection of the blue lotus flowers, looking quite charming with beautiful complexion. The mountain king was immensely pleased by looking at her.

The men and the women of the town were also delighted by looking at her. Great festivities were held at that time.

The welfare songs were sung and the female dancers started dancing. The lord of mountains performed the post-natal sacred rites and distributed charities among the Brahmanas.

Reaching the royal gate, Himacala celebrated great festivities. With a delightful mind he distributed charities to the beggars in form of riches.

Thereafter in the auspicious time, Himacala, in the company of the sages, gave the daughter the pleasant name of Kali.

Then he lovingly gave away to the Brahmanas, enormous riches in charities. Several festivities with music were performed.

After holding the celebrations, looking at Kali again and again, Himacala, the father of many sons, felt delighted looking at his daughter.

Then Siva started growing in the house of Himalaya, as the river Ganga grows in the rainy season, or the moon light in the winter season.

Thus the goddess Kalika, with her limbs resembling the moon daily looked charming like the digit of the moon.

The relatives, out of family tradition called her Parvati. She possessed the qualities like good conduct and behaviour.

When the mother disapproved of her performing tapas, she came to be known as Kalika. Î Sage, the same Kalika subsequently came to be known as Uma.

Thus Himalaya never felt satisfied by looking at the virtuous Parvati, inspite of his having many sons.

Î Excellent sage, inspite of there being enough of flowers during the spring season, the group of black wasps has a special attraction for mango blossom.

With the birth of the daughter, Himalaya was purified looking graceful as a learned man is purified with the auspicious speech looking graceful.

As the lamp of the house is appreciated with the rising flames of light, as the path of nobility is adored by the Ganga, similarly the lord of mountains was praised because of his daughter Parvati.

During her childhood, the goddess often played over the sandy banks of the Ganga, with her playmates with dolls and the balls.

Î Sage, thereafter, the goddess, at the time of studies devoted herself for the same task, getting education from her preceptor.

She achieved the lores of the earlier birth in the same way as if all the learnings of her previous birth had returned to her, or as the flock of swans, returns to the Ganga during the autumn season or the brilliant lustre manifests itself in the medicinal herbs during the night.

Î Sage, in this way I have narrated the divine sports of the goddess Siva. Now I shall narrate another one of her divine play. You listen to the same, quite lovingly.

## Chapter 8 - Conversations between Narada and Himalaya

Brahma said, “Once, you, having been well-versed about the knowledge of Siva, best among those knowing about the sports of Siva, having been inspired by Siva, lovingly went to the house of Himacala.

O Sage Narada, the mountain king, finding you there, offered his salutation to you, adoring you at the same time. Then he summoned his daughter and made her bow in reverence to you.

Î Excellent sage, then Himacala, with folded hands, bowing his head, offering his salutation to you said.

Himalaya said, “O Sage Narada- the best among the sons of Brahma, Î Learned one, Î Lord, you are omniscient, always anxious in doing good to others, besides being merciful.

You kindly speak out, reading her horoscope about her good and bad things of future. To whom shall my daughter marry in future?”

Brahma said, “O Excellent sage, when so questioned by Himacala, then you read the hand of Kalika and also looked at her limbs.

Î Dear one, then you said to the lord of mountains, because you are learned, good in speech and possessed all the knowledge.”

Narada said, “O Mena, your daughter, is going to grow like the digit of the moon. Î Lord of the mountains, she possesses all the auspicious symptoms and resembles the first digit of the moon.

She would provide comfort to her husband, and add to the glory of her parents. She would be the greatest of the chaste ladies and would be always blissful.

Î Himalaya, all the auspicious symbols are found in the hand of your daughter, but one line is quite abnormal. Listen to the effect of the same.

Her husband would be an ascetic, naked, nirguna (having no qualities), free from lust without parents, deprived of honour, and his dress and his manners would be inauspicious.”

Brahma said, “Thus listening to the words of Narada, they took them to be true as a result of which both Himalaya and Mena felt distressed.

On the other hand, Siva-Jagadambika, listening to the words of Narada felt pleased and said, “O Sage, finding Siva with these symptoms, she felt pleased at heart.

Thinking that the words of Narada can never be false, she devoted her mind at the feet of Siva.

Î Narada, then the lord of mountains, feeling distressed, said to you.” What should I do. I have been extremely distressed on hearing your words.”

On hearing the words of Himvan, you having the eloquent speech, pleased Himvan with your sweet words which were quite auspicious.

Narada said, “O Lord of the mountain, listen to my words which cannot be otherwise. The lines of the palm are drawn by Brahma, which are always permanent.

Î Mountain lord, her husband would be exactly as has been described by me. There is no doubt about it. You listen to the remedy lovingly which would make you comfortable.

This type of groom is none else than lord Siva. All the evil symptoms pointed out by me, are found in Siva alone and are treated as the auspicious ones.

The all powerful lord’s blemishes are not the cause for misery, but the same in an incompetent person, turn pleasant. The sun, the moon, the fire and the Ganga could be quoted as examples.

Therefore you should give away Siva to Siva alone. This is because Siva is the god of gods, and has to be served always. He is unblemished, lord and indestructible.

Siva can be pleased quickly, who would surely accept Siva. In case Siva, performs penance in order to get him, that would be the best.

Siva, who is the lord of all, is competent enough to do everything. He can even destroy vajra. Brahma is also subservient to him. He is the god of destruction.”

Brahma said, “O Knower of Brahman, Î Excellent sage, Î Dear one, thus speaking, you pleased the lord of mountains, and said to him again, “O Lord of the mountains, she is about to become the wife of Siva, and would be favourite to him. She is immensely chaste, of simple nature and is the one who increases the pleasure of the parents.

She will attract the mind of Siva towards herself with the performing of tapas. Siva too will marry Parvati and no one else.

The love comparable to these two had never happened in the past, nor is it found presently, nor would it be in future.

Î Lord of the mountain, both of them would perform the spoilt tasks of the gods again and again.

Î Himacala, with this daughter of yours, the lord Siva would be known as Ardhanarisvara. This would not be their first union, but it is being repeated again.

With the influence of her tapas, she would become half the body of Siva with delight.

By performing tapas for Siva, she will achieve the lustre of gold, earning the title of Svarna-gauri. Your daughter will become more beautiful like the lightening.

Your daughter will be adored by Brahma, Visnu and all the gods, and will be known by the name of Gauri as well.

Î Lord of mountains, you cannot give this girl in marriage to anyone else. This is a secret which should not be disclosed by you even to the gods.

Î Divine sage Narada, thus listening to your words, Himalaya, who was quite efficient in speech, said to you.”

Himalaya said, “Î Learned Narada, I have a humble request for you, which you hear lovingly.

It is heard that Siva, controlling all his senses, getting out of the sight of gods, performs severe penance.

Having fixed his mind in the supreme Brahma, how would he be able to divert his mind from the path of meditation? Î Divine sage, I have this serious doubt in my mind.

The Supreme Brahman, which is great and imperishable, resembles and streak of the lamp. It is known as Sadasiva and is unblemished. It is beyond Brahma, How shall be discord his form?

It is both full and devoid qualities. It has no special traits or desires. It sees everything within but not the outwardly.

This is what the kinnaras tell me about him, who come here often. How could there words be false?

He is particularly known by the name of Íṁrṁ, who had taken a pledge with Sati, which you please listen from me.

He had pledged before Sati, that except you, I shall not accept anyone else as my wife. I am speaking the truth.

"In this way he had taken a vow before Sati. How can he take another wife after her death?”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, Himacala kept silent before you. Î Divine sage, then you revealed the secret to him.”

Narada said, “O Immensely intelligent lord of mountains, have no worry. Your daughter presently known as Kali in her earlier birth was the daughter of Daksa.

She was the known as Sati, who was always auspicious and the wife of Siva.

Having found her own as well as the humiliation of Siva at the yajna of Daksa, getting enraged, Sati ended her life.

The same Sati has been born in your house known as Parvati, who will become the wife of Siva, undoubtedly.

Î Sage, in this way you narrated to Himacala, the story of the earlier birth of Parvati, which is quite delightful.”

On hearing the story of the earlier birth of Parvati, his daughter, from the mouth of Narada, the doubts in the minds of Himacala and Mena were removed.

Listening to the story of her earlier birth from the mouth of Narada, Parvati, lowering her head in shyness, started smiling serenely.

Then the parents, touching their daughter with their hands, kissing her head, made her sit by their side.

Î Sage, then looking at Kali who was seated there both Giriraja and Mena, pleasing their sons you again said.

“Î Lord of the mountains, the lion throne of this girl would be the left thigh of the lord.

By achieving the left thigh of Siva as her permanent seat, your daughter will reach where no eye or mind of anyone can reach.”

Brahma said, “O Narada, thus you, after going to Himalaya and speaking benevolent words, you at once returned to the heaven. Himalaya also getting pleased, returned to his abode which was filled with all types of riches.

## Chapter 9 - Performing of penance of Parvati at the advice of her parents and appearing of Siva before her

Narada said, “0 Brahma, Î Dear one, Î Fortunate among the devotees of Siva, Î Intelligent one, being merciful on me, you have narrated the wonderful story of Sati to me, thereby enhancing my pleasure.

Î Brahma, when, I, having the divine vision, had gone to my abode, what happened thereafter? Please narrate the same to me.”

Brahma said, “O Sage, after your departure for the heaven, some time passed. Then Mena once went to the lord of mountains and offered her salutation to him.

Then she seated besides Himacala and spoke to him with all humility.

Mena said, “O Lord, because of the nature of a woman, I could not well understand the talk of Narada. Therefore, you better marry Parvati to a beautiful groom.

For Parvati, a groom of a high family, possessing best of the symptom will be required. The marriage performed with such a groom will bestow all the pleasures.

This daughter of mine is dearer to me them my life even. Therefore you search for a suitable groom for her. I offer my salutation to you. After a suitable match, she will also be comfortable.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, the eyes of Mena were filled with tears and she fell over the feet of her husband, who lifting her up said.

Himalaya said, “O Goddess Mena, I am going to speak out the reality to you, You better free your mind from the confusion, because the words of Narada cannot be otherwise.

In case you really love your daughter, then you tell her lovingly that she should, with a concentrated mind perform worship for achieving Siva.

Î Mena, in case Siva gets pleased, then he will marry Kali and the auspicious marriage will be performed. The inauspicious feature which had been pointed out by Narada would also disappear.

When Siva is there all the inauspicious things would become auspicious. Therefore you advise your daughter to perform tapas, urgently.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Himalaya, Mena delightfully went to her daughter, and advised her to perform tapas.

Looking at the tender limbs of her daughter, the heart of Mena, felt painful and the tears started flowing from her eyes.

Still, Mena, could not advise her daughter to perform tapas. On the other hand Parvati could well understand the feelings of her mother.

Thereafter the omniscient Paramesvari, Kalika, assuring her mother, started saying again and again.

Parvati said, “O Intelligent mother, you better listen to me. To night, in the early hours, I witnessed a dream, which I am going to speak out to you.

An ascetic Brahmana, lovingly with compassion, advised me to perform severe penance for Siva.”

Brahma said, “On learning about the dream of Parvati, Mena, called for her husband and repeated to him, the details of the dream of her daughter.

Learning from his wife about the dream of her daughter, Himacala happily spoke to his wife.

Giriraja said, “O Beloved, at the end of last night, I had also witnessed a dream, which I am going to speak out. You better listen to me.

A great ascetic, resembling Narada, arrived for performing tapas near my town.

I also went there with my daughter. I realised that the groom for my daughter, as pointed out by Narada was Siva alone.

I asked my daughter to serve that sage, but he refused to accept her in his service.

A great debate took place (between her and Siva) over the Sankhya and Vedanata philosophies. Thereafter at his command, my daughter started serving him there.

She started serving him, with a desire in her mind to achieve Siva. Î Mena, I have repeated to you whatever had been witnessed by me.

Î Dear one let us wait for the result of this dream. You better accept my advice if you think it proper

Brahma said, “O Excellent sage, “Thus speaking, Himalaya with a spotless heart, with Mena, patiently started waiting for the result of the dream.

After the above discussion, some time passed. In the meantime, lord Siva, the goal of the saintly people, the cause of the protection and pleasure, wandering here and there in his flutter and excitement due to his separation from Sati, pleasantly arrived there with a few of his ganas, for the purpose of the performing of penance. Lord Siva was immensely agitated because of his love for Sati, who had been separated from him.

He performed his tapas there, Parvati engaged herself in his service continuously together with two of her maids.

For the establishment of their tasks, the gods had deputed Kamadeva to overpower Siva, with his arrows, but the lord remained unaffected and could not be swayed by Êaḍṁ.

He burnt Kamadeva with his third eye, remembering my words, he himself disappeared from the place.

After sometime lord Siva, shattered the pride of Girija, but was adored by her again, performing great tapas.

But according to the worldly practices, lord Visnu pleasing Siva, performed his marriage with Kali.

A huge function was organised at that time. Thus, Î Dear one, I have narrated the divine story of the Supreme Brahman Siva, what more do you want to listen from me?

## Chapter 10 - Birth of Mars and his raising to the status of a planet by the grace of Siva.

Narada said, “O Brahma, the disciple of Visnu and devotee of Siva, you kindly narrate the story of the sports of Siva in detail.

What was the performance of Siva in separation from Sati. When did he reach the Himalaya mountain for the sake of the performing of tapas.

What was the cause of a discussion between Siva and Siva and how was the god of love destroyed? How did Parvati achieves Siva after performing of the tapas.

Besides these, there are other several blissful stories of Siva, which, Î Brahma. You please tell me.”

Suta said, “Listening to these words of Narada, Brahma, concentrating his mind at the feet of Siva, lovingly said to Narada.”

Brahma said, “O Best of the devotees of Siva, Î Divine sage Narada, Siva, who is auspicious, best in increasing the devotion. You listen to the glory of Siva, respectfully.

Having been grieved with the separation of his beloved Sati. Feeling painful at the separation of his beloved Sati, who was dearer to him than his life, was continuously remembered by him.

While so remembering her, he started highlighting the virtues of Sati to his ganas, displaying his worldly form.

Then he, shedding his household position, discarded clothes, Then lord Siva, who was the best in divine sports wandered in the universe.

When he could not find her, then lord Siva, who bestows welfare over his devotees, returned to Himalaya.

He controlled his mind making enormous efforts, took to meditation which destroys all the miseries, displaying his imperishable nature.

In this way Siva, the lord of Maya, who is beyond the three gunas was established in the samadhi, being the Supreme Brahman.

I am now going to tell you the way the samadhi was given up after the hundreds of years.

While performing the tapas a drop of sweat fell from the head of Siva on earth, from which a child was born.

Î Sage, the child had four arms and red complexion. He was quite beautiful to look at, possessed the divine beauty, illustrious and was unbearable for the enemies.

He started crying like an ordinary child before Siva.

The goddess earth, getting frightened from Siva, taking to the form of a woman, appeared there.

She at once lifted up the child, placed it in her lap and started feeding the child with her own as well as the cow’s milk.

She kissed his face out of affection, she started fondling him like her own son. In reality the mother earth, started doing good to Siva.

Siva was well aware of the fact, that she was earth, then the lord who is the cause of protection, enjoyment and playful, witnessing her activities, felt pleased and pleasingly said to her.

Siva said, “O Earth, you are graceful, you bring up this son of mine, who has been born from you with the drop of my sweat. Therefore, he shall be the most illustrious one, out of all the illustrious people.

Î Earth, though this child born out of my sweat would be quite dear to me, still he will be known by your name and shall be free from all the three types of distresses.

Your child will be the bestower of lands, and shall possess all the good qualities and shall also make me happy. Therefore, you accept him with pleasure.”

Brahma said, “After saying this, he stopped and he was somewhat relieved of the pangs of separation, because, inspite of his being unblemished, and because of his being dear to the noble people, he practiced the worldly traditions.

Thereafter the goddess Earth, at the advice of Siva, returned to her abode, feeling extremely comfortable.

By the grace of the lord of the universe, the son of the Earth, found a place among the nine planets and he proceed on to the divine loka, beyond the region of Venus.

Î Sage, thus I have told you the story of Siva and his separation from Sati. Now listen to the story of his performing the tapas.

Brahma said, “Then Siva, the creator of the universe, and the lord of all, kept quiet, thus speaking. Thereafter, the lord of mountains lovingly spoke to Siva.

Himalaya said, “O Lord of the universe, I have adored you with welcome words. You happen to be the Supreme lord. What can I ask from you when you are lodged in my own kingdom?

Î Narada, “She had the slender waist curly locks of hair, which were shining. She had three lines over the belly and her feet resembled the red lotus flowers, with comely appearance.

Brahma said, Listening to the words of the lord of the mountain thus spoken by him, Siva, the god of gods, shedding away his meditation, spoke to him.

Himacala said, “ Siva, why should I not come with this girl? Is she not fit enough to serve you? I am unaware of the reason for the same. You kindly tell me.”

Brahma said, “Then the bull-bannered Siva smilingly, pointing out particularly the worldly conduct of the fake ascetics, said to Himalaya.”

Siva said, “This auspicious and slender bodied maiden of comely hips and the face resembling the moon, should not be brought near me. I forbid you again and again.

Î Mountain, I am a yogi who is never affected by illusion. Therefore a woman thirst on me, would be of no avail to me.

Î Himvan, you are the refuge of the great ascetics, don’t insist on this, again. You are yourself well-versed in the Vedic religion and the foremost among the learned people.

Î Lord of the mountain, with her association, my mind would soon become lustful, resulting in the destruction of my vairagya or detachment, besides the perishing of my penance.

Therefore, Î Lord of the mountains, the ascetics should not come in contact with the women, who are the roots of all the passions and result in the destruction of the divine knowledge as well as vairagya”.

Brahma said, “Thereafter, Siva, speaking many such things with Himalaya, kept quiet.

Listening to the words of ascetic Siva, and finding her father getting surprised, Bhavani, offering salutation to Siva, then spoke clear words.

## Chapter 13 - Talk between Siva and Parvati

Bhavani said, “O Best of the Yogis, Î Lord, Î Wise one, you listen to the reply from me of what you have spoken to the lord of mountain.

Therefore you cannot say anything or do anything. You just think over in your mind because by so speaking, doing the other activities etc. are nothing but Prakrti.

Î Siva, even after having been absorbed by Prakrti, you are unable to recognise your own form and in case you truly know yourself, then why are you performing tapas.

Î Yogisvara, what is the use of my entering into arguments with you. The people with wisdom say that without perception, inference has no authority at all.

Î Lord of the Yogis, what is the use of speaking much, you listen to my excellent words. I happen to be your Prakrti while you are Purusa. I am speaking the truth, there is no doubt about it.

By my grace, you become virtuous and beautiful. Without me, you are incompetent and devoid of attributes. You cannot perform any activity.

Since you are always subservient to Prakrti, you remain active and perform all the activities. How can you be separated from me.

Brahma said, “The lord, who is compassionate to the devotees besides being delightful to them, thus speaking, then spoke to the lord of mountains.

## Chapter 14 - Birth of Taraka and Vajranga- their penance

Narada said, “ Î Disciple of Visnu and the great devotee of Siva, Î Brahma, you have correctly stated that the life story of Siva and Siva which is quite an excellent one.

Î Brahma, who was Tarakasura who tortured the gods? Whose son was he, whose story is connected with Siva? You please tell me the same story.

How did Siva who had controlled all the organs of senses, reduced Kamadeva to ashes.

Î Brahma, you narrate the relevant story to me.

For achieving which Parvati, performed the tapas. How could Parvati, the eternal force, achieve Siva as her husband?

O Immensely learned one, you kindly narrate the entire story to your son who is extremely faithful.”

Brahma said, “O Excellent son, Î Learned one, having controlled all your senses, I concentrating my mind on Siva shall narrate the story to you, which you please listen.

First of all Î Narada, you listen about the birth of Tarakasura, for killing whom the gods, taking shelter under Siva, made all the efforts.

I had a son named Marici, who had thirteen wives and were the daughters of Daksa Prajapati.

His eldest wife was Diti, who gave birth to two sons. The elder was named as Hiranyakasipu, while the younger one was Hiranyaksa.

Both the horrible Daityas were killed By Visnu, incarnating as Narasimha and Varaha, as a result of which the gods became fearless and comfortable.

Diti felt painful and distressed at the death of both of them and she took refuge with Kasyapa. Then serving her husband with devotion, the chaste lady was conceived.

Learning about it, the powerful Indra, availing of an opportunity, he entered her womb, cut off her womb into pieces.

But with the influence of vrata, Diti was performing, the pregnancy could not be destroyed. On the other hand when Diti was asleep forty nine sons were born to her.

All these sons were known as Martus, who, soon after their birth went to the heaven. All of them were then owned by Indra.

Feeling painful of her performance, Diti again went to her husband, and by rendering again her service to him, she pleased Kasyapa again.

Kasyapa said, “Purifying yourself, you meditate for Brahma for ten thousand years, after which an immensely strong son would be born to you.

Brahma said, “Then Aditi with enormous faith, performed and completed the tapas. Then after her union with her husband, she gave birth to a powerful son.

That son of Diti resembled the gods and was known as Vajranga. Ever since his birth, he had a body akin to his own name. He was quite strong and glorious.

At the command of his mother, he captured Indra and punished him and tortured the gods.

Diti felt pleased at the miserable condition of Indra. The gods like Indra and others had to bear the fruit of their activities.

Then I at once went to Kasyapa and speaking sweet words, freed the gods from the bondages.

Vajranga having extremely auspicious wisdom, who was spotless, delightful at heart and a devotee of Siva, releasing the gods spoke respectfully.

Vajranga said, “The selfish Indra is quit wicked and killer of the sons of my mother. He has today reaped the reward of his misdeeds. Let him rule his own kingdom.

Î Brahma, I have done all this at the command of my mother. I am not at all interested in the comforts of any loka.

Î Brahma, you are well-versed in the knowledge of Vedas and sastras. Bestow the knowledge of the tattvas to me as a result of which I could become unblemished, and delightful with spotless wisdom.

Î Narada, on hearing this, I told him, “Your thoughts are quite sattvika which constitute, the essence of the philosophy, I shall lovingly create a lady with exquisite beauty for you.

A woman was then created by me, and giving her the name of Varangi, I gave her to Vajranga as his wife. Thereafter Vajranga and his father Kasyapa delightfully left for their abodes.

Thereafter the demon Vajranga shedding away the demonic ways embracing the Sattvika traditions, doing away with the feelings of enmity against anyone, became comfortable.

But Varangi could not develop the Sattvik feeling in her mind. She, becoming passionate, quite faithfully served her husband variously.

Thus with the service rendered by her so faithfully with devotion, Mahaprabhu Vajranga was pleased and said to her.

Vajranga said, “O beloved, what do you want?” On hearing this, she lowering her head expressed her desire to her husband.”

Varangi said, “O Dear husband, in case you are pleased with me, then let me have a son, who could trouble Indra, after conquering the three worlds.”

Brahma said, “On hearing the words of his beloved, Vajranga was surprised and getting upset, he being a well-read person, Sattvika by nature, devoid of enmity against anyone, thought in his mind.

“My wife wants to pick up a row with the gods, which is not liked by me. What should I do? Where should I go? What should I do to save my honour and reputation?

In case the desire of my wife is fulfilled, then all the three lokas would be in distress, including the gods and the sages.

On the other hand in case the desire of my wife is not fulfilled I am sure to be consigned to the hell. In both the cases righteousness will be lost. I am well aware of it.”

Î Narada, thus the mind of Vajranga was confused and using his wisdom, he started thinking as to what would be proper or improper.

Î Narada, with the will of Siva, he accepted the words of his wife and said to her, “Be it so.”

For that purpose, he performed another very severe tapas with enormous efforts, propiating for me for a number of years.

Observing his hard tapas, I went to him for bestowing a boon on him. With a delightful mind I told him to “ask for a boon.”

Vajranga saw me in the sky in a pleasant mood. Then offering prayer to me, and bowing in reverence to me, he asked for a boon which was desired by his wife.”

Vajranga said, “O Lord, you bless me with a boon of getting a son, who should be faithful to his mother, besides being glorious, powerful fully competent and ocean of penance.

Brahma said, “O Narada, on hearing his words, I spoke out. “Be it so”, and then devoting my mind to Siva, returned to my abode.

## Chapter 15 - Taraka and his penance

Brahma said, “Thereafter, in ancient times, Varangi became pregnant. With its lustre, the pregnancy developed in her womb for many years.

Then after completion of the period a son, having a huge body, possessing enormous strength, illumining the directions was born to her.

With the birth of the son to Varangi who was inimical to the gods, several evil omens and disturbance’s started appearing on earth.

Î Narada, the phenomena of the three types indicative of the great calamity, terrifying the earth, occurred in the sky, earth and the nether world. I shall explain them all.

With the thundering sound, thunderbolts fell on earth with comets; shooting meteors rose up causing miseries to the world.

The earth started shaking with mountains and the directions started burning. All the oceans and the rivers were agitated.

The thundering and terrific sounds were heard. The wind with biting touch started blowing. The dust storms started blowing with forceful winds causing the uprooting of the trees.

Î Great Brahmana, Rahu and Ketu started attacking the sun and the moon again and again. Î Narada, horrible symptoms indicative of danger and vanishing of pleasures, appeared.

At that point of time, the terrible sound resembling the rumbling sound of the chariot was heard from creeks and the caves in the mountains.

The jackals and the owls, started howling, vomiting fire from their mouths. The she jackals were howling in the villages in an inauspicious manner which was indicative of misfortune.

The dogs lifting up their mouths, were barking here and there in diverse manner producing lamenting sound.

The sun besides the planets like Mars as well as the Saturn became furious. The herds of mad asses, scratching the earth with their hoofs ran here and there, braying loudly.

Terrified from the braying asses, the birds flew from their nests in panic. In their excitement they fluttered honked and cranked. They could not find peace anywhere.

The animals in their sheds and the beasts in the forest, rushed about here and there in fright as if they were beaten and driven out, passing urine and dung.

The cows were also frightened, dropping blood instead of the milk from their udders.Due to fright, they started dropping tears from their eyes. The horrible clouds started dropping the rain of puss.

The images of the gods desirous of flying started crying. The trees began uprooting without the wind the planets started fighting in the sky.

Î Narada, many calamities started falling at that time, which were taken by the ignorant people as the destruction at the time of dissolution.

Thereafter Prajapati Kasyapa thought over the matter and gave the enormously strong demon the name of Taraka.

The immensely strong warrior, displaying his strength and prowess, like the solid mountain of stone, kept on growing.

Thereafter possessing enormous strength and prowess, Taraka begged of his mother permission to perform penance.

Thereafter confusing even the illusory people, Taraka possessing enormous illusion, getting permission from his mother, started performing penance, for the conquering of all the gods.

Taraka who had been obedient to his preceptor, reached Madhubana and addressing Brahma, he started severe tapas.

Standing on one foot, raising up his hand fixing his gaze at the sun, with a concentrated mind, he performed penance for a hundred years.

Thereafter for a hundred years, the lord of the demons, known as Taraka performed the penance resting on a single big toe.

Then for a hundred years he performed the penance, consuming the water and for a further hundred years he lived without water even. For another hundred years, he lived on inhaling the air, alone. For another hundred years, he spent time standing in the water while for an other hundred years, he performed tapas standing on the ground.

Then he spent a hundred years standing in the fire flames, for a hundred years he performed tapas lowering his head and for another hundred years he stood on palm of the hand.

O Narada, for a hundred he held the branch of a tree with his food, hanging himself upside down and inhaling the smoke of yajna by the mouth.

By his own sweet will, the lord of the demons, for the fulfilment of his desire performed hard tapas, which was painful even to the listeners.

Thus performing the tapas a huge mass of light emerged out of his head and spread all round, causing great havoc.

With the said mass of light, the entire heaven, started burning to ashes. Î Narada, all the gods and the sages, around felt miserable.

Indra, the lord of the gods was much more frightened with the same. He thought, “The one who is performing penance today would surely usurp my kingdom.

This master mind shall in a moment destroy the entire cosmos.” All those who thought similarly could not decide about the future course of action.

All the gods and the sages consulted among themselves, and getting immensely agitated they came to me, with their plight.

They bowed to me, eulogising me, with folded hands, in reverence and explained everything to me being distressed in their minds.

With my thinking deeply over their plight, I reached at a definite conclusion, on the subject. I visited the place where the demon was performing penance with the intention of granting him a boon.

O Narada, I asked him, “You ask for a boon. You have performed a hard penance. Therefore, you can be granted everything.”

Thus listening to my words, Tarakasura, offered his salutation to me and offering prayer to me, asked for a very harsh boon.”

Tarakasura said, “O Brahma, you are the granter of the boon. When you are pleased, with me ready to grant a boon, then there is nothing that cannot be achieved by me. Therefore, I ask for a boon from you.

Î Lord of the gods, in case you are really pleased with me, and intend to grant me a boon, then, you kindly give me two boons.

Î Lord in the universe created by you, there should be no one comparable to my strength and power.

When Karttikeya, born out of the semen of Siva, shoots the arrows at me only then I should meet my death.”

Î Narada, the said Daitya, thus spoke to me. Granting him his desired boon, I returned to my abode quickly.

The demon also getting the favourable boons, delightfully went to Sonitapur.

At my command, Sukracarya- the preceptor of the Daityas, established him as the lord of the three worlds.

Then the great Daitya became the lord of the three worlds and started ruling them, causing pain to all the mobile and immobile living beings.

Then Tarakasura started ruling the three worlds appropriately. He sustained the people causing misery to the gods.

Then Tarakasura, accepted the gems given to him by the panicky Indra and Lokapalas getting frightened from him, which were themselves offered by them.

Getting frightened, Indra, handed over the elephant Airavata to the demon lord, while Kubera handed over all the treasures.

Varuna gave away the white horses. The ascetics gave away the auspicious cow Kamadhenu. Frightened from the Daitya Indra also gave away the Uccaisrava horse to him.

Whatever a precious article was found by Taraka he seized it at once. In this way all the three worlds were deprived of the valuables and previous things.

Î Sage, the ocean gave away the precious gems out of fear. In his kingdom the earth produced the crops without tilling. The desires of all the people were fulfilled.

The sun caused that much of the heart which did not harm anyone. The moon always appeared with lustre and the wind always blew favourably.

The wicked demon had usurped the entire riches of the gods as well as the manes.

Exercising his control over all the lokas he himself became Indra. He then became the undisputed lord and ruled the universe with complete self control.

All the gods were removed from the important positions and in their places, the demons were established.

56\. Î Narada, then the gods finding themselves in miserable condition, arrived to take refuge with me.

## Chapter 16 - Brahma assures gods frightened by Taraka

Brahma said, “Thereafter the gods having been tortured by the Tarakasura, went to Brahma and started eulogising him with devotion.

I, on my part, listening to the realistic prayer of the gods, spoke to them delightfully.

"All of you are most welcome, are you performing your duty without any obstruction? You better speak out the purpose of your visit.”

Thus listening to my words, the gods having been frightened by Taraka, bowed their heads in reverence to me and spoke.

The gods said, “O Brahma, Tarakasura, has become proud, after achieving the boons from you. He has forcibly removed us from our position, and has usurped them for himself.

Are you not aware of it? You kindly remove the miseries faced by us urgently. We take refuge in you.

He troubles us throughout the day and night wherever we live. Wherever we rush for rescue, we find Taraka there.

Î Lord of the universe, the trouble we had to face from Taraka, has made our position quite miserable and we are upset.

All the gods including Agni, Yama, Varuna, Yayu, besides the lords of all the directions have been overpowered by him.

Kuber, together with all his attendants is serving the great Daitya. They (the gods) are not at all free.

In this way torturing the gods he has overpowered them. All are in service with him dancing to his tune.

All the beautiful damsels and the apsaras have been abducted by the powerful Taraka.

Presently, neither the yajnas are being performed, nor are the ascetics performing the tapas. No charitable or virtuous activities are being performed in the universe.

Kraunca-Danava, his army commander is extremely sinful. He has now gone to the nether worlds and is harassing the people there.

Î Brahma, the merciless Tarakasura has forcibly usurped the three worlds from us.

Î Lord of the universe, we have been turned out of the heaven by Tarakasura. Now we shall go to the place which you may propose.

You are our guide, ruler, sustainer as well as the protector. Burning from the fire of Taraka’s anger, we have been upset.

The harsh steps taken by us against him have been made infructuous by him as the medicinal herbs of high potency are rendered ineffective in serious ailments.

We had hoped for victory from the Sudarsana cakra of Visnu, which touching his neck was turned into a flower, becoming useless.”

Brahma said, “O Narada, listening to these words of the gods, I spoke to them, the words which suned the occasion.

Taraka has become powerful because of my words. Therefore, it would not be proper for me to kill him.

The one who had been instrumental in making him so powerful, it would not be proper for him to kill Taraka. Because even the poisonous tree planted by a person, cannot be cut and felled by the same person.

Siva is the most suitable person to accomplish your task. But even he will not be able to do anything remedial in this case without inspiration.

Tarakasura would himself be destroyed because of his own sins. The way it would be done, shall be spoken by me.

Tarakasura is invincible because of my boon, from myself, Visnu or even Siva. No other god can also kill him.

Î Gods, only a son born of the semen of Siva can kill Taraka and none else.

Î Gods, you follow the remedy being suggested by me. This task would be established shortly by the grace of Siva.

Sati, the daughter of Daksa Prajapati, after putting an end to her body, has been reborn from the womb of Mena. This fact is well known to you all.

Siva is surely going to marry her. Î Gods, all of you should make efforts in that direction.

You do something to ensure the discharge of the semen of Siva into Parvati, the daughter of Menaka.

Because Siva is a great yogi, who makes his semen to flow upwards. There is no other woman in the world, except Parvati, who can make him discharge the semen downwards out of the body. No other woman can do so.

The daughter of Giriraja is quite youthful presently and is engaged in the service of Siva.

The said Siva or Kali, at the command of her father is forcibly engaged in the service of Siva with two of her maids, who is performing penance.

Siva, inspite of Parvati, the beauty of the three worlds serving him, is engaged in penance and his mind is not at all shaken even for a moment.

You should all make efforts by which, Siva should be able to accept her as his wife. You should do so quite quickly.

On the other hand, I shall go to the place of Taraka and stop him forcibly (from following the evil path). Î Gods, you can now go back to your respective places.”

Thus speaking to the gods, I at once went to Tarakasura and lovingly spoke to him.”

Brahma said, “You are ruling over the heaven, which is the abode of all the lustre. Now you are becoming desirous of much more, than what you had sought for from me at the time of penance.

I never granted you the boon to become the lord of the heaven. Therefore, you giving up the heaven should concentrate on earth.

O Lord of the Daityas, all the performance in the heaven is suited to the gods. There is no doubt about it.

I being the lord of all, advising the demon, devoting my mind at Siva and Siva, disappeared.

As a result of this Tarakasura on the other hand, leaving the heaven, then started living in the city of Sonitpura, on earth, ruling his kingdom.

Listening to my words, all the gods, bowing in reverence to me, accompanied with Indra, lovingly went to the heaven.

Reaching there and consulting each other, the gods in a body lovingly spoke to Indra.

The gods said, “O Lord you should do something to carryout the suggestions of Brahma and see that Siva is attracted towards Siva.”

Brahma said, “After explaining everything to the lord, all the gods returned to their respective abodes quite delightfully.”

## Chapter 17 - Discussion between Indra and Kamadeva

After the gods left the place of Indra, he who had been terrorised by Tarakasura, remembered Kamadeva.

At once the god of love, beloved of Rati, conqueror of the three worlds, filled with arrogance, reached there with Rati.

O Narada, he stood before Indra, offering his salutation to him and enthusiastically spoke to him.

Kamadeva said, “What is the task you intend to get performed by me? What for have you remembered me? You tell me correctly. I have arrived here to perform the same.”

Brahma said, “Indra, the god of gods, listening to the words of Kamadeva, praising him lovingly said to him, “You have done well.”

Indra said, “O Kama, you are indeed blessed, because you are ready to perform the job which is on hand with me. Therefore you are graceful.

You listen to my words, which I am going to speak out to you. My job is equally your job as well.

I have many great friends, but none of them is comparable with you.

There are two ways of my victory viz.: yourself and my vajra. The vajra has become useless, but you can never become useless.

Who can be dearer than the person, from whom one derives benefit. Therefore, being my great friend you must accomplish my task.

Due to the move of the times an enormous misery has be fallen on me, which cannot be removed by any one except you.

A donor can be tested at the time of famine, the warrior’s test is the battle field, the test of a friend is at the time of adversity and the test of the woman is at the time of poverty or the financial crises.

Truth and humility can be tested at the time of calamity. A real friend can be tested at the time of distress and also is based on what he does in the absence. This is not otherwise. It is the truth.

Î Friend, your friendship is going to be put to test, since an adversity has be fallen on me which cannot be removed by any one else.

This task is not for the sake of my pleasure, but it would undoubtedly be the task of all the gods.

Brahma said, “On listening to the words of Indra, Kamadeva smiled and lovingly spoke.”

Kamadeva said, “Why do you speak like this. I give you no reply, the fake as well as real benefactors can be well understood. One has not to speak anything here.

One who speaks much at the time of misery, what can he do in reality? Î Master, still, I am going to speak out something, which you please listen.

The one who is performing severe tapas to pull your leg, irrespective of his being friend or a foe, I am sure to destroy his penance.

With the side glance of the best of damsels, I shall destroy the same in a moment, whether he is a god, a rsi or a Daitya. The humans are of no consequence for me.

With a friend like me with you, Vajra and other weapons are of no use for you.

I can, undoubtedly, make Brahma, Visnu and Siva to go astray and others are of no consequence.

The five flowery sweet arrows are of mine, my bow is of three types and its string is covered with the black wasps.

The army of damsels, and the spring season, my friend, are the five great forces of mine, while the moon is my friend.

The love sentiment is the chief of my forces. The gestures and emotions are my soldiers. All of them are soft and gentle Î Indra, I am also of the same sort.

Whosoever is useful for a particular purpose, he should be entrusted with the same job. You should therefore entrust me with the job which is suitable for me.”

Brahma said, “On hearing the words of Kamadeva, Indra was immensely pleased and he bowing in reverence to Kamadeva, who delights the damsels, said to him.” Indra said, “O Dear Kamadeva, you are surely competent to carryout the task which is engaging my mind. It is beyond the capacity of anyone else to do so.

O Kamadeva, my friend, I am speaking to you truthfully, the reason for which I intended to meet you.

A great demon named Taraka, after getting the boons from Brahma, has become invincible and is troubling one and all.

He had distressed all the living beings. The gods and the rsis are feeling painful because of him.

All the gods have fought with him according to the capacity of each one of them. The weapons of all of them have proved useless on him.

The noose of Varuna, broke while fighting with him. The Sudarsana-cakra when used by Visnu on him over his neck, was blunted.

According to Brahma, the death of the wicked Taraka has been destined by the child born out of the semen of Siva.

This task has to be well-done by you and only then you would be known as my best friend. By performing this task of mine by you, I myself as well as the gods would become pleased and comfortable.

I think this task is beneficial to all. Therefore, keeping the dharma of a friend in your mind, carryout this job.

Siva is presently engaged in performing tapas over the Himalaya mountain. He is free Paramesvara and has no desires for anything.

I have come to know that Parvati, with the permission of her father, along with her two maids, is serving Siva.

Î Kamadeva, you therefore move in such a way that Siva develops a desire in him to get Parvati as his wife. You act quickly.

You would, by so doing become successful in your life and you will be free from all the miseries. You will surely gain everlasting glory in the world.”

Brahma said, “At these words of Indra, the delighted Kamadeva, assured Indra that he would surely do the job.”

Thus speaking to him and having been overpowered by the illusion of Siva, Kamadeva said, “I shall obey your command.”

Thereafter accompanied with his wife and Vasanta (spring season) Kamadeva reached the place where the Yogesvara Siva was engaged in the great penance.

## Chapter 18 - Disturbance created by Kamadeva

Brahma said, “Influenced with the illusion of Siva, the arrogant Kamadeva, started spreading first of all the spring season which attracts the minds of all.

Î Narada, the place where Siva was performing tapas was overpowered with the enchanting beauty of the spring season and the medicinal plants were found everywhere.

O Great sage, with the influence of Kamadeva, all the trees and creepers in the forest, blossomed.

The mango trees started sprouting, besides the Asoka trees. Their fragrance was increasing the passions.

The lotus flowers were surrounded by black wasps, increasing the passions.

The sweet cooing of the Cuckoo birds heightened the emotions, of love. They were unique and pleasing to the mind.

O Sage, the blackwasps started issuing humming sound, attracting the minds of all towards themselves, increasing the passions at the same time.

The beautiful moonlight was spread on all the four comers. It served as a female messenger between the male and female lovers.

The moonlight appeared to be inspiring the people and was inducing the reticent haughty persons to love. It pleased the persons, who had been separated from their beloveds.

In this way the spreading of the spring season, which increased the passions, became unbearable for the forest dwelling sages.

O Sage, even the insentient beings were filled with love, then what to speak of the condition of the sentiment ones?

In this way the spring season displayed the unbearable influence on all the living beings. As a result of this passions were aroused in the minds of all the living beings.

Observing the untimely influence of the spring season, Siva, who had taken to the human body by sports alone, felt surprised.

Siva, who removed the miseries of all, controlled himself, started performing more hard penance.

With the spread of the spring season, everywhere, Kamadeva, accompanied with Rati who stood on his left side, with the arrow of mango blossom, in his hand.

Exercising his control he started spreading his influence. Finding Rati with Kamadeva, who would not be enchanted.

Thus they started their dalliance. The sentiments of love and the appealing gestures too accompanied him and he reached before Siva.

Kama who usually remains in the mind, manifested himself outside. However, he could not find out a weak spot whereby he could enter the body of Siva.

Failing to get an entry into the body of Siva, he was distressed and frightened.

Who can gain access to Siva, having three eyes, issuing the flames of fire and engrossed in meditation.

In the meantime, Parvati with her maids carrying several types of flowers arrived there for adoring Siva.

The type of great beauty as is mentioned in the world, Parvati surely possessed much more beauty then that.

When she adorned her body with the seasonal flowers, then her beauty could not be described even in a hundred years.

On reaching of Parvati before Siva, then for a moment he sat there leaving the tapas.

Finding the weak point, Kamadeva who was present in the vicinity, shot an arrow named Harsana which delighted Siva.

At that point of time Parvati went to Siva with emotions of love accompanied with spring.

In order to make the desire of Siva vigilant, Kamadeva, carefully shot a flowery arrow over Siva.

As per the usual practice, of Parvati’s coming to Siva, similarly, she arrived on that day too and adoring him, offering her salutation to Siva, she took her seat before him.

For the first time Siva, had a careful look at her limbs, while Parvati, feeling shy started squeezing her limbs out of the womanly modesty.

Remembering the boon granted to her earlier by Brahma, Î Sage, Siva also started praising her limbs’ beauty.”

Siva said, “Is it the face or the moon? Are these the eyes or the blue lotus flowers? Are these the eyebrows or the bow of Kamadeva?

Has she the lips or the wood-apple fruit? Is it the nose or the beak of the parrot. Her voice resembles the cooing by the Cuckoo. What to speak of the waist, it looks like the altar of yajna.

What could be said about her gait and beauty? What can be said about the flowers and the costumes worn on the body.

The entire beauty of the universe has been placed at one place. All her limbs are extremely beautiful, there is no doubt about it.

Parvati with astonishing beauty is quite graceful. A damsel comparable with her beauty cannot be found in the three worlds.

She, possessing the astonishing limbs is the treasure of beauty, she can enchant even the sages and increases the comforts.”

Brahma said, “Praising the beauty of her limbs, again and again, then recollecting the boon of Brahma, he stopped.

When Siva put her hand within her garment, then Parvati, because of woman’s modesty, went away.

Î Sage, then Parvati, observing her own limbs, lovingly looking at Siva, Parvati, felt delighted in her mind.

Observing these movements and gestures of Parvati, Siva felt fascinated. Then Lord Siva, indulging in the great divine sport and spoke.

“When I feel so much delighted, merely by looking at her, then how much pleasure shall I derive by embracing her?”

Thus thinking for a moment, praising Parvati, the enlightened Siva, woke up and he said, “What is this surprising and wonderful situation? How is it that I have been deluded and fascinated. Though I happen to be the lord and master, still I have been overpowered by Kama.

When I being a lord would be desirous of touching the limbs of others, then what would be beyond the petty people.

Thus developing vairagya, Siva stopped sitting over a couch. Because the lord Siva cannot have a down fall.

## Chapter 19 - Destruction of Kamadeva

Narada said, “O Fortunate Brahma, what happened thereafter, you kindly narrate the story which relieves one of all the sins.

Brahma said, “I am going to narrate the delightful sports of Siva who is blissful, because of my love for you.

Finding the obstruction in the patience, Mahesvara, the great yogi, thought in his mind and then felt immensely surprised.

Siva said, “While performing the excellent tapas, why has the obstruction been created. Who, the degraded person has, perturbed my mind.

I have praised the other man’s woman and this act is deplorable. I have thus spoilt the rules of the virtues and transgressed the limits prescribed in the Vedas.”

Brahma said, “Siva the great yogi, is the refuge of the noble people, therefore, thus thinking, becoming doubtful, he started looking here and there.

Then he spotted to his left the arrogant and foolish Kamadeva, who placing the arrow over the bow was about to shoot the arrow.

Witnessing Kamadeva in that condition, Î Narada, Siva, at once was enraged.

Î Narada, Kamadeva, while staying in the sky, shot his infallible arrow over Siva.

The infallible arrow, shot at Siva, became futile, without displaying its might. It calmed down. At this Siva was enraged.

Finding the arrow shot by Kamadeva, getting infructuous, Kamadeva was terrified and started shaking looking at Siva.

Getting frightened, and becoming unsuccessful in his efforts, he started remembering Indra and other gods.

Î Narada, having been remembered by Kama, Indra and other gods arrived there and bowed in reverence to Siva, eulogising him at the same time.

While the gods were so eulogising, Siva opened his third eye, which had been fixed in the middle of the forehead. At once the fire flame emerged from the same, which started rising up words like the fire of the time of dissolution.

It first rose to the sky and then fell down rolling on earth all around.

Before the gods could beg forgiveness from Siva, for Kama, the fire reduced Kamadeva to ashes. (P1 30)

In this way, the valorous Kamadeva, was burnt out as a result of which all the gods felt grieved and started crying getting upset. They lamented saying, “What has happened.” Then they cried loudly.

Feeling grieved Parvati, together with her maids, lost the lustre of her body. Then she, together with her maids returned to her abode.

After some time, Rati, the wife of Kamadeva, fell down there unconscious. With the grief of the death of her husband, she fell down on the ground like a dead person.

After regaining her senses, Rati was extremely upset, she started lamenting variously.

Rati said, “What should I do? Where should I go? The gods have killed my husband after calling him.

Alas, Î My lord Kamadeva, you are dearer to me than my life. Î Bestower of happiness, what is it that has happened here. Î My dear?”

Brahma said, “Thus Rati, lamenting variously and crying at the same time, uttering pitious words, she beat her head with her hands, kicked with her legs and pulled up her hair.

Listening to her lamenting, all the forest dwellers present there, felt grieved, besides the trees and the plants.

In the mean time Indra and other gods, arrived there and remembering the name of Siva, started consoling Rati.

The gods said, “Keep some ashes of Kama carefully. Shed away the panic. You will surely regain your husband.

There is none in the world to give the happiness and misery. One has to face all this because of his deeds. Don’t think the gods to be the cause of the death of your husband.”

Brahma said, “In this way consoling Rati, all the gods then went to Siva. Pleasing Siva they spoke with devotion.”

The gods said, “O Siva, Î Lord, you are favourably disposed towards the people who take refuge with you, Î Lord, kindly listen to our auspicious words.

You kindly think of the job of Kamadeva. Î Mahesvara, he did not do this for his own selfish end in view.

O Lord, the god have been troubled by the wicked Tarakasura and as such the gods were instrumental in the present activity of Kamadeva.

Î Lord, this lonely Rati, is presently lamenting. You kindly console her.

Î Siva, by thus getting enraged do you intend to create dissolution? By killing Kamadeva, you have killed the gods.

Witnessing the grief of Rati, all the gods, are behaving as if dead. Therefore, you remove the grief of Rati.”

Brahma said, “Thus hearing the words of the gods, lord Siva felt pleased and started saying to all the gods.

Siva said, “O Gods and Rsis, you listen to my words carefully with respect. Whatever has happened out of my fury cannot be altered.

The lord Kamadeva shall remain, without a body till lord Krsna- the husband of Rukmini, incarnates on earth.

Living in Dvaraka, when Krsna, shall produce the sons, then Rukmini would give birth to Kama.

He would surely be known by the name of Pradyumna. Soon after his birth that son would be kidnapped by Sambhasura.

Sambhara, the best of Danavas, after kidnapping Krsna’s son and foolishly taking him to be dead, would throw him in the ocean and then return to his abode.

Î Rati, you shall stay in the city till then, where you will get back your husband.

Then Kamadeva, killing Sambhasura in the battle, shall achieve his wife Rati and get delighted. The gods too will rejoice.

Î Gods, carrying the riches of Sambhasura and his wife, Pradyumna shall return to his abode, My words are true.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Siva, the gods heaved a sigh of relief and lowering their heads, folding their hands, they offered their salutation to the lord and spoke.”

The gods said, “O God of gods, Î Mahadeva, Î Ocean of mercy, Î Lord, you save the life of Rati, by brining back Î Kamadeva to life.”

Brahma said, “Thus listening to the words of the gods, Siva, the ocean of mercy, the lord of all, Paramesvara, felt delighted and said.

Siva said, “O Gods, I now feel pleased. During the intervening period, I shall bring Kamadeva back to life. He turning as my gana shall roam about on earth.

Î Gods, don’t reveal this episode to anyone else. All of you should go back to your respective places and I shall remove the miseries of all.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, Siva, disappeared from the place while the gods were eulogising him. All the gods were pleased and were relieved of the surprise.

Î Sage, then the gods, assuring Rati with the words of Siva, getting permission from Siva, returned to their respective places.

Rati, the wife of Kamadeva, then proceeded on the town of Sambhara and Sage, kept on waiting there for the time indicated by Siva.

## Chapter 20 - The story of oceanic fire

Narada said, “O Brahma, where did the flame of fire emerging from the eye of lord Siva, vanish? You kindly narrate the relevant story of Siva.

Brahma said, “When Kamadeva was burnt out with the fire flames emerging out of the third eye of Siva, then the fire uselessly spread on four sides.

All the mobile and immobile beings of the three worlds, created hue and cry. Î Narada, all the gods and the sages rushed to take refuge with me.

Getting upset and distressed, all of them started eulogising me with folded hands. They narrated the pain of their sufferings to me.

Listening to their words, concentrating my mind on Siva, understanding the reason therefore, I went to that place in order to protect the three worlds.

The fire which burnt Kamadeva, was spreading with great force. By the grace of Siva, I extinguished that fire.

The flame that had emerged out of the anger of Siva, which was ready to burn the three lokas, Î Intelligent one was subsided by me.

At the desire of Siva, I carried that submarine fire to the ocean for the welfare of the universe.

Î Sage, finding my arrival there, the ocean took to a human form and with folded hands he appeared before me.

The said human offered his salutation to me with folded hands, eulogising me at the same time, he said to me.

The ocean said, “O Brahma, the lord of the universe, what for have your arrived here? You get me your command taking me to be our servant.”

Thereafter, listening to the words of the ocean, reciting the name of Siva, I spoke to him for the welfare of the people.”

Brahma said, 'O Dear one, Î Immensely intelligent one, Î Ocean, doing good to the entire universe, inspired by the grace of Siva, I am talking to you lovingly.

This the enormous anger of Siva, known as marine fire, after burning Kamadeva, is presently engaged in the destruction of the universe.

At the desire of Siva, these painful gods have requested me. I at once arrived there and suppressed the fire.

Then it took to the form of a mare and I have arrived here with the same. Ocean of mercy, the base of all the waters, I therefore give you a command.

This is the rage of Siva, in the form of a mare, issuing the flames of fire, should be borne by you till the time of dissolution.

Î Ocean, you can free the astonishing lustre of Siva, after I return and start living here.

It will live on, daily consuming your water. You rear it well, lest it drowns or is deformed.”

These were the words spoken by me to the ocean, who atonce accepted them, though in fact none else could contain the fire emerging out of the rage of Siva.

Therefore the fire in the form of a mare entered the ocean and started consuming the ocean itself. It started blazing with all its shooting flames.

Î Sage, then, with my mind filled with delight, I returned to my abode. On the other hand, the ocean in a divine form also disappeared from the scene.

The entire universe felt comfortable by this, getting free from the terror of Siva. Î Great sage, all the gods and the ascetics, felt comfortable thereafter.

## Chapter 21 - Narada’s advice to Parvati

Narada said, “O Dear Brahma, Î Disciple of Visnu, Î Great intellect, Î Creator of the three worlds, there is a wonderful story of Siva that has been narrated.

When Kama had been so reduced to ashes with the opening of the third eye of Siva, and after the said fire entered the ocean, what happened thereafter? You kindly tell me.

What did Parvati, the daughter of Himalaya do? Î Ocean of mercy, where did she go with her maids?
