With her mind filled with affection, Mena praised her fortunes again and again.

Mena said, “I have become graceful with the birth of Parvati. Girija too has become graceful and all my belongings have become graceful.

Whatever the best of gods have been witnessed by me, their lord will be the lord of my daughter.

Can the fortunes of my daughter be described in a hundred years? When she has a look at her master then what is to be spoken about her?”

Brahma said, “When Mena spoke so lovingly, by that time, Rudra with a terrific form arrived there.

O Dear one, his *ganas,* were also of astonishing types and could shatter the pride of Mena. Because of his illusion he displayed his umblemished and unconnected form.

O Sage Narada, at the sight of Siva, so arriving, you lovingly pointed out to her the bridegroom Siva, and spoke to her.

Narada said, “This is Siva, O Comely damsel, you look at him. it was for him that Parvati performed hard *tapas* in the forest.”

Brahma said, “At these words of Narada, Mena looked delightfully at Siva appearing in an astonishing form with his *ganas.*

At the same time the immensely surprising army of Siva’s *ganas* also arrived, comprising of the ghosts, goblins and several others.

Some of them had the form of storm, some of them resembled the banners, creating hissing sound, some had crooked faces, while others were deformed.

Some of them looked awful with overgrown beards and moustaches. Some were lame, blind while others were holding *danda* and *pasa.* Some of them carried clubs in their hands.

Some rode over the Vehicles facing backwards, some of them were blowing horns, some played on small double drums and *Gomukhas.*

Some of them had no faces at all, some of them had many faces, some of them had no hands, some had deformed hands while others had many hands.

Some had no eyes, some had many eyes, some were without heads, some had deformed heads. Some had no ears, some had many ears. Some of them could take to many forms.

Thus the deformed type of *ganas,* who were immensely valorous, were beyond counting and terrible at the same time.

O Sage, you while pointing out towards the *ganas,* said to Mena, “O Beautiful one, these are the *ganas* of Siva.”

O Sage, looking at the innumerable ghosts and goblins, Mena felt frightened.

These deformed *ganas* were surrounding Siva from all the sides, who was seated over the virtuous Nandi, having five faces, three eyes, applying ashes over the body, having the matted locks of hair, with crescent moon over the head, ten hands, carrying a skull, clad in tiger skin over the body, carrying the excellent bow- Pinaka.

He held a trident, was having odd eyes, ugly features utterly dishevelled hair and was untidy. He was wearing the elephant hide, looking at whom the mother of Siva was frightened.

She was taken a back, and while shaking, confused, Mena was told by you, “This is Siva,” pointing out towards him.

Listening to your words, Mena, felt painful and fell down on earth, like the creeper shattered by the wind storm.

Then she uttered, “What is all this? I have been cheated for being too ambitious. This deformity is of what use to me?” Saying this, Menaka fell down on earth, unconsciousness.

Her maids tried in various ways (to bring her back to consciousness) and kept on attending on her. Then slowly, the beloved of the mountains, regained consciousness.

## Chapter 44 - Mena regains consciousness

Brahma said, “Mena, the beloved of Himalaya, after regaining her senses, started lamenting, rebuking everyone.

Becoming upset she denounced her sons, then her daughter, showering abuses on them.

Mena said, “O Sage you had earlier stated that Siva will marry Siva. Thereafter she was assigned job of to perform *tapas* by Himavat.

Its disastrous fruit has become visible. O Evil minded sage and the degraded one, you have completely cheated me.

Then she performed the *tapas* which was harder than the one performed by the sages. The result has been achieved which is painful even to the onlookers.

What should I do? Where should I go? Who would remove the pain of my heart. My race and life have been destroyed.

Where have the divine sages gone? I would like to pull out their beards and moustaches. Where is the mischievous woman Arundhati, who had herself arrived here, by the crime of whom, my everything has been lost.” Thus speaking, she scolded and rebuked her daughter using harsh words.

She said, “O Wicked daughter, why did you indulge in activities, which have caused pain to me. O Wicked girl you have got glass in exchange for gold.

You have plastered mud discarding the sandal paste. Making the swan to fly away you have reared the crow.

You have consumed the water of the well leaving the sacred river water. Setting aside the sun, you have achieved the fire fly, making all the efforts.

Leaving the rice you have eaten the husk. Throwing away the *ghee* you have consumed the caster oil.

Stopping the serving of the lion, you served a jackal. Leaving the listening of the sacred lore of the Supreme Brahman, you have heard the base ballards.

O Daughter, throwing away the auspicious ashes of the *yajna,* you have picked up the unholy ashes of the funeral pyre.

Leaving aside the best gods like Visnu and others, you have made such enormous efforts just to achieve the evil minded Siva.

Disgrace to your wisdom, beauty, conduct, your advice as well as your maids.

O Daughter, disgrace to both of us who have given birth to you. Disgrace to you, O Narada, besides the seven sages.

Disgrace to your race, the performance, and whatever has been done by you. You have burnt the house. Only I have now to meet my end.

The lord of Parvati should not come to me, nor should the seven sages show their faces to me.

What has been done by all of them, why did I not remain barren? Or why did I not abort?

Otherwise, why have I or my daughter not died? Why was she not been eaten by the demons?

I shall cut off your head. What is the use of this body? Where shall I go leaving you here?

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, Mena fell down fainted on the ground. Getting upset by grief and anger, she did not return to her husband.

O Excellent sage, at that point of time tumultuous sound of distress was heard. All the gods reached there one after the other.

O Divine sage, first of all, I myself reached there. Looking at me you addressed me thus.

Narada said, “You have not witnessed the beautiful and real form of Siva. He had taken to this form only playfully.

Therefore, O Chaste lady, shedding the anger, be healthy. Setting aside stubbornness, engage yourself for arranging of the mamage and give Siva to Siva.”

Brahma said, “Listening to your words, Mena said, “O Wicked and degraded one, you get up and leave the place.”

At these words of Mena, Indra and other Dikpalas arrived there and said.

The gods said, “O Mena, the daughter of Pitrs, be pleased and listen to my words. He is Siva himself, who bestows the greatest happiness to others.

Observing the hard *tapas* of your daughter, Siva, who is well-disposed towards his devotees granted a boon to her.”

Brahma said, “Thereafter Mena lamented for long and said to the gods, “I do not have to give my daughter in marriage to Siva, who is in hostile form.

Why have you all conspired to spoil the beauty of my daughter?

O Excellent sage, when she thus spoke, Vasistha and other sages arrived who said.

Saptarsis said, “O Daughter of the manes, wife of Giriraja, we have arrived for the performing of the marriage whatever has been spoken by you cannot be taken to be otherwise.”

Brahma said, “The biggest gain is that we could have an audience with Siva.

At these words of Brahma, she negativated him, because she was overpowered by ignorance. Therefore she is anger said to the sages.”

Mena said, “I can kill my daughter with a weapon than give her to Siva and never try to come near me.”

Brahma said, Î Sage, thus speaking, she kept quiet and became completely upset, lamenting at the same time. With this news, there was a complete disturbance everywhere.

Then Himalaya becoming nervous, arrived to reveal, lovingly a secret to her.

Himalaya said, “O Dear, you listen to my words. Why are you getting i upset with those who have come in our house. Then why are you denouncing those who have arrived here (at our own invitation)?

You are not aware of Siva. You have become upset looking at his horrible face. He actually takes to many forms.

I am aware of Siva pretty-well. He feeds all. He is more respectable of the respected people. He can shower mercy as well as punish the people.

O Mena, with auspicious character, O Beloved, don’t be stubborn. Stop grieving. O Damsel with auspicious *vrata*, you get up at once and do your job.

In case Siva has arrived at the gate in a terrific form, then he must be teasing you with the hideous form.

We had agreed to give away our daughter to him keeping in view his great glory. O Dear, you move accordingly.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking mountai-king kept quiet. On hearing thus, Mena, the mother of Siva said, to Himalaya.

Mena said, “Listening to my words, you do what I want you to do. Tying a noose around her neck, throw Parvati downwards. I am not at all inclined to give away Parvati to Hara. Or O Lord you mercifully drown her in the ocean. O Giriraja you would be happy thereafter. O Lord in case you give away Parvati to terrific Siva, then I shall surely end my life.”

Brahma said, “When Mena stubbornly spoke these words, then Parvati herself arrived there and spoke the pleasant words.”

Parvati said, “O Mother, your thoughts have been perverted. You depend on virtue alone. Then why are you forsaking virtue.

This Siva has none else greater than him. He is the one who has been described in the Vedas, where his form is quite pleasant.

Siva is Mahesa, the lord of all the gods, self-illumining and can take to many forms. O Mother, Even Brahma and Visnu serve him.

He is the support of all. He is the creator and the destroyer of all. He is free from blemish, the lord of the three gods. He is indestructible and eternal.

He is the one for whose sake all the gods have arrived. What could be more pleasing than this?

Making all the efforts, you should get up and make your life a success. Give me away to Siva and make you household purposeful.

O Mother, you give me to Siva, the supreme lord. O Mother, I am speaking to you. You must accept my request.

In case you do not give me over to Siva, then I shall not marry any one else. The share of a lion cannot be usurped by a jackal.

O Mother, with my mind, speech an actions, I have accepted Siva as my husband. Now you can do whatever you like.”

Brahma said, “Thus listening to the words of Parvati, Mena, the wife of Giriraja, lamenting variously, getting enraged, caught hold of Parvati, and thrashed her with fists, elbows, grinding her teeth. She was greatly agitated and furious.

O Dear one, O Sage, you and other sages who were there, separated Parvati from her mother, and took her away.

Mena then rebuked them all, again and again and hurled harsh abuses on them.”

Mena said, “You will see how shall I treat Parvati having evil designs. I shall either give her the deadly poison or push her down in the deep well.

Or I shall cut her into many pieces, with weapons and the arrows, or shall drown her in the deep ocean.

Or other wise I shall put an end to my body, but I shall never give away my daughter Durga to that terrible Sambhu.

What a terrific groom has been achieved by the wicked girl. She has made a fun of myself as well as the race of Himalaya.

He (Siva) has no kith and kinds, *gotra* or the parents. He has no house to live in, neither the beauty nor cleverness.

He has no costumes, no ornaments, no associates, nor a good vehicle. He has not the youthful age, nor the riches.

He possesses no wisdom, nor purity. He has a body which teases others. On what grounds should I give away my auspicious daughter to him?”

Brahma said, “At that point of time, having been overpowered with anger and grief, she started crying aloud.

Then I at once reached before her and recited the Supreme *tattva* of Siva, which could remove the ignorance at once.

Brahma said, “O Mena, you listen to my auspicious words lovingly, listening to which your evil wisdom would disappear.

Siva is the creator of the world, preserver and the destroyer. You are unaware of his form. Then why do you feel grieved.

He has many forms and many names. The lord always is engaged in his sports. He is the lord of all the master of *Maya* and he himself is free from doubtful alternatives.

O Mena, thus thinking, you should shed away the stubbornness of ignorance which is going to destroy the entire task, give away Siva to Siva.”

When I thus spoke to her, she lamenting again and again, leaving aside shame, then said to me.”

Mena said, “O Brahma, why are you making the beauty of Parvati as useless? It would be better to kill Siva yourself.

Don’t repeat the word that Siva should be given to Siva. Nor shall I give Siva to Siva, since my daughter is dearer to me than my life.”

Brahma said, “O Excellent sage, when she spoke like this, the *Siddhas* like Sanaka suddenly arrived there and spoke to her.”

The *Siddha* said, “Lord Siva who provides comforts to all, very kindly appeared before your daughter.”

Brahma said, “Then lamenting again and again, Mena said to the Siddhas, “I shall not give my daughter to Siva with a terrific form.

All of you- the Siddhas, are bent upon spoiling her beauty.”

O Sage, when she so spoke to the *Siddhas*, I myself, the gods, the *Siddhas* and the humans were all surprised.

Listening about her stubbornness lord Visnu at once arrived there and spoke to her.

Lord Visnu said, “You are the dearest and the most virtuous daughter of the manes, besides being the wife of Himalaya and you belong to the excellent Brahmana race.

Accordingly you have the helpers in the world. You are graceful no doubt about it. What can I speak to you. You are the base of *dharma.* Then why do you intend to shed away the *dharma*?

The gods, *Rsis,* Brahma and myself, in case have spoken any improper words, then you can blame us. (otherwise think over these words).

You are not aware of Siva, he is with and without attributes. He is with and without form. In whatever form, he might appear, he serves the noble people being their only abode.

Parvati- who is Isvari, or the *Mula-Prakrti* has been created by him alone. Near her the primordial being has also been created.

At the same time, myself and Brahma, incarnated on earth. With our virtues, Siva, who is benevolent to the people has also incarnated.

Thereafter, all that is visible like gods and the Vedas were created including the mobiles and immobiles, were created by Siva himself.

Who can describe about his form? Who knows him also? I myself and even Brahma is not truly aware of him.

Whatever from Brahman to the pillar is visible in the world, has the form of Siva. There is no doubt about it.

Thus he has incarnated in the world in this form. In case he has arrived at your door it is all because of the penance of Siva.

Therefore, O Wife of Himalaya, you should shed away the grief and be devoted to Siva. By doing so, you will feel blissful and all your miseries will be removed.”

Brahma said, “O Sage, at the words of Visnu, Mena’s mind calmed down a bit.

But she did not agree to give away her daughter to Siva, because she was overpowered with the illusion of Siva.

Then Mena, the wife of Himalaya and mother of Giriraja said to Visnu.

Mena said, “In case Siva takes to beautiful form, then I shall give away my daughter to him otherwise not. This is my firm resolve.

Brahma said, “Mena, with her firm resolve, kept quiet after thus speaking, because she had been overpowered with the illusion of Siva.

## Chapter 45 - Siva assumes the pleasant form and people’s delight

Brahma said, “O Sage, in the meantime, at the instance of lord Visnu, you went to lord Siva to appease him.

Reaching there, you, with a desire to perform the task of the gods, eulogised Siva and convinced him.

Listening to the words of Narada, he took to his divine form, displayed his compassion for all.

Then finding Siva having a body more beautiful than the god of love, you felt immensely delighted.

Feeling delighted, you eulogised Siva with several *stotras.* Then you returned from that place where Mena and the people of his community were seated.

Having been filled with love and delight, you said to Mena- the wife of Himalaya.”

Narada said, “O Broad eyed one, look at the best form of Siva. The compassionate Siva, has become merciful on us.”

Brahma said, “Listening to these words, Mena, the wife of Himalaya, feeling surprised looked at that form of Siva with delight.

He looked resplendent like the crores of suns, with beautiful limbs, excellent costumes and adorned with several ornaments.

He had a delightful heart, smiling face, looking extremely beautiful, fair complexioned, illustrious and decorated with a crescent moon.

All the gods like Visnu, Surya, the moon and others were holding umbrella over his head.

He was adorned with all the ornaments. - Siva looked charming in all respects and the glamour of his vehicle- the bull, was beyond description.

The Ganga and the Yamuna were moving the fly-whisks over Siva. All the *siddhis* were dancing before him.

Visnu, Indra and other gods, besides myself (Brahma), appeared clad in the best of costumes. Thereafter we engaged ourselves, in the service of Siva.

Thereafter we engaged ourselves, in the service of Siva. At that point of time, the delighted *ganas* of Siva, adorned with all the ornaments, shouting the slogans of victory, were moving ahead.

The Siddhas, sages the gods and the other people also, moved along Siva, delightfully, in the marriage party.

All of them were moving on along with their wives, filled with anxiety, reciting the name of Siva, with the marriage party.

They, together with *apsaras* like Visvavasu, were moving on reciting the glory of Siva.

O Great sage, when Siva arrived at the entrance gate of Himalaya, huge festivities were created.

O Sage, who can describe the exquisite splendour of the supreme lord at that time.

Sage, looking at Siva in this manner, Mena, for moment was non-plussed. Then she spoke lovingly.

Mena said, “Quite graceful is my daughter, who performed hard *tapas,* as a result of which, O Siva you have arrived at my house.

I had earlier denounced Siva, let the lord of Siva forgive me and be pleased with me.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, the beloved of Himalaya, started adoring Candrasekhara, with folded hands. Then she felt shameful and offered her salutation to him.

The damsels of the city, leaving aside their household work, came out to have a look at Siva.

Some woman was carrying the powder for taking bath, in her hand, some out of curiosity, were out to have a look at Siva, the husband of Siva.

Some woman was serving her husband, she leaving that, accompanied with a maid, came out to have a look at Siva, carrying the fly- whisk in her hand.

Some one else suckling her child with the breast, left him dissatisfied and eagerly came out, to have a look at the lord.

Some one moved out adorning herself with the waist band, while the other put on the clothes in the reverse manner.

The other left her husband who was eating food and rushed to have a look at Siva with enthusiasm and greed.

A damsel applied collyrium in one eye, and rushed to have a look at the groom of Parvati, carrying the collyrium in her hand.

A damsel applying paint at his feet, but learning about the arrival of the marriage party, leaving the painting of her feet, rushed to see the lord of Parvati.

Thus many of the women arrived there leaving their house-hold jobs for looking at Siva and were greatly fascinated.

Thereafter, all of them were disturbed with love and felt delighted with the look at Siva and carrying his image in their hearts said.

Damsels of the city said, “The eyes of the women living in the city of Himalaya have become successful. Whosoever has looked at his face, her life has become successful.

Only her life and the performance has been successful, whosoever, has looked at the lord who is the destroyer of the sins.

Parvati has achieved all the success, by performing penance for Siva. By achieving Siva as her husband she has become graceful and fully contented.

Had Brahma not united Siva and Siva, his effort for the creation of the universe would have become infructuous.

He, by uniting this couple, has done a good job. With this all the tasks have been established.

It is beyond the reach of an ordinary person to have an audience with Siva, without performing of *tapas.*

But we have become graceful today, by having an audience with Siva. As Laksmi achieved Narayana earlier, similarly Parvati looked graceful by achieving Siva.

As Sarasvati achieved Brahma, similarly, Parvati after achieving Siva, has become embellished.

All of us- the men and the women are blessed, by having a look at Siva, the lord of Parvati.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, all the people adored Siva, with sandal paste and the raw rice grains. They also showered the fried rice grain on him.

All the ladies felt delighted with Mena and were seated there, praising the fortunes of both Mena and Himalaya.

O Sage, listening to the stories of the damsels, lord Siva with Brahma were pleased.

## Chapter 46 - Arrival of the Bridegroom

Brahma said, “Siva moved on delightfully in the company of his goblins and the *ganas* besides the gods and others, and reached the abode of Himalaya, quite enthusiastically.

Mena the unique beloved of Himalaya, got up from her seat and went into the inner apartments along with other women.

She is the company of the other ladies, carried the plate of *arati* in order to perform the *arati* of Siva with the lights.

Then Mena lovingly looked at Siva, who was being served by all the gods, and was the lord of Girija.

He had five beautiful faces of the complexion of *Campaka* flowers. He had three eyes, and wore a serene smile over the face. He was adorned with the gold ornaments studded with gems.

He was wearing a garland of jasmine flowers besides the gem studded crown. His neck was adorned with the necklace and the arms with the armlets.

He was bedecked in bangles. He was shining well with the two clothes of great value, fine texture and unrivalled beauty and purified in fire.

His body was applied with sandal and *aguru* pastes, besides musk and saffron. The mirror of gems was held by him in his hands while the eyes were painted with collyrium.

Siva thus had such a resplendence, and appeared extremely beautiful and youthful, besides having been adorned with all the ornaments.

He appeared beautiful to the ladies. His faces had the resplendence of crores of moons, having a body far better than the crores of Kamadevas besides the beautiful limbs.

Seeing the lord thus, as her son-in-law, the grief of Mena’s mind disappeared and she felt delightful.

She praised her fortunes and felicitated herself, Parvati, her husband and the other kiths and kins. She felt delighted again and again.

Looking at her son-in-law, delightfully with his beaming face, the chaste lady performed his *arati (Nirajana)* she kept on gazing at her son-in-law for long.

Having been reminded of the words spoken by Girija, she felt surprised and she started thinking.

Whatever Parvati had spoken about the beauty of Siva, I find him far more beautiful than that.

Presently, the beauty of Siva is beyond description. Thus feeling surprised, Mena, went to her abode.

The damsels praised Parvati saying, “She is quite fortunate. Some of the ladies called her as a goddess Bhagavti.

“We have never seen such a groom at the time of *kanyadana.* Therefore the goddess Girija is quite graceful.” These were the words spoken by some of the girls.

At that point of time, the Gandharvas started singing and the *apsaras* started dancing. All the gods felt delighted looking at such a face of Siva.

The musicians started sweetly playing on the sweet tunes displaying their proficiency with respect.

Himalaya performed jubilantly the same rites accompanied with the other women.

At the same time the maid servants, took Parvati out in order to worship the family deity.

In the mean time the ladies of the inner apartment of Himalaya, took Durga for the adoration of the family deity, out side the house.

The gods stared at her who had the limbs like blue collyrium and appeared graceful with her limbs bedecked with ornaments.

She respectfully looked at the three eyed lord, escaping the eyes of others. She appeared quite beautiful with a serene smile worn over her face. He plaits of hair were thickly grown and looked beautiful.

She had exquisite decorative lines over her body. She wore a *tilakam* of musk and saffron. A necklace studded with gems adorned her breast. The bangles and bracelets of gems were shining brilliantly. The lines of her teeth sparkled like the diamonds. Her lips which were naturally red like the wood-apple fruit and red lac was applied over the same. She held a mirror made of gems in her hand. A toy lotus also adorned her. Her body was smeared with the paste of sandal wood, *aguru,* musk and saffron. Her feet and soles were naturally red. The anklets which issued the tinkling sound, enhanced her beauty.

Looking at the primordial goddess, the mother of the Universe with the gods and others bowed down their heads in reverence.

The delightful Siva looked at her with side glances. Siva at that time looking at the figure of Parvati, was relieved of the fever of separation.

By fixing gaze over Siva, he forgot everything. His hair stood an ends all over the body, since he continued to gaze at her with delight.

Parvati then went out of the town to worship the family deity and returned to her parent’s home, together with the Brahmana woman.

Siva on his part, accompanied with Brahma, Visnu and other gods went to their respective places as prescribed by Himalaya.

Reaching there, all of them were engaged in serving Siva. Himalaya on his part honoured Siva, offering various types of fortunes to him.

## Chapter 47 - Siva’s ceremonious entry into the inner apartments of Himalaya

Brahma said, “Thereafter, Himalaya, performed the *yajnopavita* ceremony of Siva and Durga, enthusiastically, with the reciting of the Vedic hymns.

Then at the request of Giriraja Himalaya, Visnu, the gods and the sages entered the place.

Following the traditional as well as the Vedic path, Siva was adorned with the ornaments given by Siva.

She was first made to take her bath, then the wives of Brahmanas as well as her maids, performed her *arati.*

She was made to wear two new garments, which beautified her. At that point of time, the daughter of Himalaya appeared as the wife of Siva.

Then she wore a divine bodice decorated with various gems. The goddess then started shining more and more.

A necklace studded with divine gems, was worn by her, besides the precious gold bangles.

The lovely lady, the daughter of mountain and the mother of the three worlds, while staying there meditated on Siva alone, shining at the same time.

Both the sides, having been filled with delight, celebrated the occasion and the gifts were distributed by them to the Brahmanas cannot be described.

On that occasion, others were also bestowed with the gifts. The festivities included the playing of the musical instruments.

Thereafter, I myself, Visnu and other gods started celebrating the occasion.

Bowing in reverence with devotion to Siva, and devoting the mind at the lotus like feet of Siva, with the permission of Himakaya, all those present there took their respective seats.

In the meantime, Garga, who was well- versed in astrology, said to Himalaya.

Garga said, “O Himacala, O King, O Lord, O Father of Kali, get Siva inside for the performing of the *kanyadana* ceremony.”

Brahma said, “Giriraja, learning about the time of the performing of *kanyadana,* from the sage Garga, was delighted.

The mountains, the Brahmanas and others were lovingly deputed to get Siva at the place (of marriage).

The mountains and the Brahmanas, carrying the welfare- materials in their hands, reached the place where Siva was lodged.

At that point of time the musical instruments were played upon, accompanied with dancing and great festivities were held.

Listening to the sound of the music, all the devotees of Siva as well the gods and the sages, got up.

Feeling delighted, they talked among themselves, “Possibly the mountains are arriving to get Siva back with them.

It appears, that because of our great fortune, the time of *panigrahana* is arriving.

All of us are especially graceful to have an opportunity to witness the marriage of Siva and Siva.

Brahma said, “ While this type of talk was going on, the courtiers of Parvataraja, arrived there respectfully.

After reaching there they prayed to Visnu and other gods, to move, because the time for performing of the *kanyadana* ceremony had reached.

O Sage, Listening to their words, Visnu and other gods feeling delightful shouting the slogans of victory, reached the abode of Himalaya.

They felt delightful at the marriage of Kali, but they did not reveal their happiness.

The trident bearer lord Siva, the carrier of trident, who bestowed welfare to the universe, took his bath with the application of the auspicious material over his body.

Then he was clad in beautiful garments, by all, while the lokapalas, made him amount over his bull Nandi.

Making Siva to move in the fore-front, all of them moved anxiously with delight towards the house of Himalaya.

The Brahmanas sent by Himavat and the other excellent mountains taking to divine forms, enthusiastically went ahead of Siva.

A *Chatra* was held over the head of Siva and fly-whisks were being moved on him and as such, Siva looked quite graceful.

At that point of time, I (Brahma) Visnu, Indra and Lokapalas, looked graceful while moving ahead.

At the time of those celebrations, the conches were blown, while the kettle drums, big drums, double drums, *gomukhas* and other musical instruments were played upon.

The singers were singing the welfare songs. The damsels were dancing variously.

Accompanied with all of them, lord Siva, the supreme soul, and well wisher of the universe, assuming the entire strength, being served by all the gods with devotion, accepting showering of the flowers, reached there.

Lord Siva, entered the *yajna-mandapa* with honour, where he was eulogised variously. The best of the mountains, made Siva descend from the bull and took him to his abode with great pomp and show.

At the arrival of Siva, with gods at his home, Himalaya appropriately offered his salutation to him, performing his *arati.*

Himalaya, then bowing in reverence with great enthusiasm, praising his fortunes, honoured all.

Himalaya, offering *padya* and *arghya* etc. to the chief gods like Visnu, Siva and others, took them inside his abode.

Brahma, Visnu, Siva and other prominent gods were made to occupy the gem-studded thrones.

Then Mena, together with her maids, the Brahmana women, and the women whose husbands were alive, delightfully, performed *arati* of Siva.

The necessary rites like the offering of the *madhuparka* etc. to Siva, the Supreme Soul, were pleasantly performed by the priests, who were well-versed in the science of rituals.

O Sage, then I inspired the priest to perform the welfare ceremony, who did so accordingly.

Then Himalaya lovingly entered his abode and took myself Visnu and Siva to the place where Parvati, adorned with all the ornaments, having slender waist was gracefully seated.

Waiting for the appropriate *lagna,* best ritual to the marriage, Brhaspati and others became delightful.

Garga- the priest, was seated in the place where the water clock was placed. The *Omkara-mantra* was repeated during the intervals before the *lagna.*

Then Garga- the priest, reciting the *punyaka-mantra,* lifted the hand full of rice grains and handing them over to Parvati and made her shower them over Siva.

Then Siva was appropriately adored by sweet faced Parvati delightfully with the offering of the rice grains mixed with curd and *darbha* water.

Siva, for gaining whom, She had performed hard *tapas*, looking at him while performing his adoration, appeared extremely graceful.

O Sage, then I spoke to the priest Garga and other sages. “Let Siva also adore Siva according to the worldly tradition.

In this way both Parvati and Paramesvara looked graceful by adoring each other.

Then both of them displaying the glory of the three worlds, and looking at each other, were offered *arati* by Laksmi and other ladies.

The Brahmana women as well as the women of the city performed the *arati* with pleasure, looking at both Siva and Parvati.”

## Chapter 48 - The marriage of Siva and Parvati

Brahma said, “At that time, having been inspired by Gargacarya- the priest, both Himalaya and Mena got ready for the performing of the *kanyadana* ceremony.

The virtuous Mena, carrying the golden pitcher filled with water arrived and stood to the left of Himalaya.

Then the delightful Himalaya, together with the priest, wooed the groom, offering *padya,* costumes, sandal paste and ornaments.

Then at the arrival of the due time, Himalaya asked the Brahmanas to start speaking out the *Samkalpa-mantra,* narrating the time *tithi* and constellation etc.”

After saying, “Be it so.” The excellent Brahmanas, who were well aware of the proper time, announced about the time and date etc.

At the inspiration from the heart of Siva, Himalaya smilingly said to Siva, the creator of the universe.

“O Siva, you kindly reveal your *gotra,* race, name, Veda and *sastra* etc. Don’t delay.”

Brahma said, “Listening to these words of Himalaya, Siva having a charming face, became sad and turned his face away. Siva who is devoid of sorrow, attained a pitiable look. \*

When lord Siva, was unable to speak out anything as was witnessed by the gods, sages, Gandharvas, Yaksas, *Siddhas,* O Narada, you acted in a jovial manner, to help him.

O Narada, you had been well-versed in the *Brahma-tattva* and you, at the inspiration of Siva, played on your flute.

But Giriraja stubbornly stopped you from doing so. Besides Brahma, Visnu, the gods, sages and others also stopped you from doing so.

But because of the will of Siva, you did not stop, Then Himalaya asked you not to play on the *vina.*

O Well-versed divine sage, they stopped you forcibly, then recalling the name of Siva in your mind, you spoke.

Narada said, “You are a big fool. You are not aware of anything. You are absolutely ignorant about Siva.

You have asked Siva about his *gotra*? To ask this question at the moment would be like joking.

No one, even Brahma, Visnu and others are aware about his *gotra,* race and name etc., O Mountain, what to speak of others.

O Mountain, Siva, in whom crores of Brahmas are absorbed in a day is being witnessed by you because of the *tapas* of Siva.

He is the Supreme Brahman, formless, without attributes, beyond *Prakrti,* unblemished, lord of *Maya,* and greater than the greatest.

He is independent, well-disposed towards his devotees. He is without *gotra,* race and name. By his own will he is with attributes, having beautiful body and having many names.

Irrespective of his being with or without *gotra,* with or without race, but he has become your son-in-law, from today onwards, because of the *tapas* performed by Parvati.

With this divine sport, Siva has deluded the entire universe comprising of mobile and immobile creatures. O Excellent mountain, even the wisest of the men are not fully aware of him.

The top of the phallic column of lord Siva could not be visualised by Brahma. His foot could not be visualised by Visnu who went to the nether world and he was immensely surprised.

O Giriraja, what else has to be spoken in this regard? It is quite difficult to know about the illusion of Siva. He controls all the three *lokas,* besides, Brahma, Visnu and other gods.

O Father of Siva, you carefully think over the matter. Do not think anything otherwise about a groom like this.”

Brahma said, “O Sage, as desired by Siva, you again, pleased Himalaya with you talk and spoke again.

Narada said, “O Dear one, O Great mountain, O Father of Siva, you listen to my words, listening by which you give over your daughter to lord Siva.

Lord Siva, actually speaking, has the *gotra* in the form of a divine sound (*nada*) and the family of Siva is his divine form, who assumes forms in his divine sports.

Siva is identical with *nada* while *nada* is identical with Siva. There is no difference between *nada* and Siva.

O Lord of mountains, *nada* is prior to Siva in his sportive or attributive form. *Nada* is the most excellent of all.

Therefore, O Himacala, I have played upon my *Vina,* as mentally desired by Siva.

Brahma said, “O Sage Giriraja felt happy on listening to your words and the doubt of his mind was cleared.

Thereafter, Visnu and other gods surprisingly uttered, “Well-done, well-done.”

All the learned people who had assembled there, feeling delighted said, “Look here, how deep is lord Siva?

At his command the vast universe was created, who is greater than the greatest, has an independent movement and who could be known with the utmost devotion. We have today been able to have a look at such a type of Siva.

At that point of time Meru and other mountains were agitated and at the same time they spoke to Himavat, the lord of the mountains.”

The mountains said, “O Giriraja, be firm on your words to give away your daughter to Siva, otherwise the appropriate time would be lost in controversies. We are speaking the truth. Give away you daughter in marriage to Siva.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of his friends, and inspired by the destiny Himalaya gave away his daughter to Siva.

He said, “O Lord of all, O Paramesvara, I give away my daughter to you, you kindly accept her as the form of *Maya.*

Thus Parvati- the mother of the three worlds, was given away by Himalaya, with the reciting of the *mantras* to Siva.

Thereafter, Himalaya, placed the hand of Siva, over the hand of Siva and was so delighted, as if he had crossed the ocean of his desire.

Himalaya, reciting the Vedic hymns, gave away the lotus like of Siva to lord Siva, who was pleasantly and gracefully accepted by Siva.

O Sage, Siva, while touching the earth, displayed the worldly tradition, saying the hymn *Kamasya kodaka.*

At that point of time huge celebrations were made, besides the shouting of the slogans of victory over the earth and the sky.

Feeling delightful all started saying “Well- done, well-done.” Some people offered their salutation, the Gandharvas were singing, and the *asparas* were dancing.

All the people of Himalaya felt delighted in their minds and the welfare celebrations were organised everywhere.

I myself, Visnu, Indra, all the gods, were immensely delighted and the faces of all of them (blossomed like the lotus flowers).

Thereafter Himalaya, the lord of mountains feeling pleased gave away the articles of gifts to Siva in a befitting manner.

Then all the kiths and kins of Himalaya, with utmost devotion, gave away several articles in dowry.

O Excellent sage, Himalaya also gave to the newly weds, monetary presents as prescribed in the scriptures.

Several types of gems, besides the gem studded costumes and ornaments were also given to them.

They were also given a lakh of cows, caparisoned horses, a lakh of slave girls, well-decorated with the best of ornaments and costumes, who loved Parvati.

A crore each of elephants and horses were given, which were decorated with gold and gems.

In this way, by giving his daughter Girija to Siva, appropriately, Himalaya felt successful in his life.

Thereafter Himalaya, eulogised Siva, with folded hands and all humility, reciting the *Mahyandina stotra* from *Yajurveda.*

Then Himalaya, who had been well-versed in the Vedas, spoke to the excellent sages, who started performing *abhiseka* of Siva reciting the Vedic hymns.

They also started sprinkling of water, mentioned the name of each and every god. At that point of time, O Sage, great celebration was being made which delighted all.”

## Chapter 49 - Delusion of Brahma

Brahma said, “Thereafter, at my command, the Brahmanas consecrated the fire. The making Parvati to sit in the lap of Siva and the lord started performing *homa.*

Siva was making offerings in the sacred fire with the reciting of the hymns from the *Rgveda, Yajurveda* and *Samaveda.* Mainaka- the brother of Kali was giving handfuls of fried grains.

Thereafter both Siva and Kali, following the worldly tradition went round the sacred fire altar.

At that point of time, the lord of Girija played an astonishing sport, which is being spoken by me, O Sage, because of my love for you.

At that point of time, I, having been influenced with the delusion of Siva, could witness the reflection of the beautiful moon like face of the goddess.

O Divine sage, with the mere sight of the same, I became lustful.

Having been thus filled with passion, I started gazing at her limbs again and again as a result of which my semen ejected and fell on the ground.

I (Brahma) with the fall of my semen on the ground, felt ashamed. O Sage, I pressed my penis secretly with my feet hiding the semen at the same time.

O Narada, when Siva came to know about it he became furious and in rage, got ready to kill me (Brahma).

O Narada, at that point of time, a great disturbance was created. All those present there started shaking. Visnu also was upset and frightened.

O Sage, then Visnu and other gods, offered prayer to lord Siva, who was blazing and who was ready to kill me.

The gods said, “O Lord of the gods, O pervader of the universe, O Sadasiva, you are the lord of the universe, O Lord of the world, or the very world itself be pleased with me.

You are the supreme soul, the supreme lord and the cause of all the emotions. You are fee from malice, free from wastage, eternal, free from suspicions and doubt. You are undying and the great lord.

Your origin, middle and the end is unknown. You are beyond the inside and out. You are imperishable, truth, Brahma and form of consciousness.

The sages desirous of salvation, having the firm resolve, meditate and adore your lotus like feet. You disown attachments on both the sides.

You are the Supreme Brahman. You are the nectar, devoid of grief, totally without attributes, blissful, stable, free from blemishes, and even beyond the soul.

You alone are the cause of the creation, sustenance and the destruction of the universe. You are indifferent. Everyone has

You are beyond description. You are eternal and have the form of the electric flames. Salutation to lord Siva who is the god of *Agni-varna.*

You have resplendence of crores of lightenings. You have eight images and are always present in this world. Salutation to you.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of the gods, lord Siva, who is graceful to his devotees, felt pleased and made me fearless, granting protection to me.

O Dear one, thereafter Visnu besides other gods and sages smilingly celebrated the occasion.

O Dear one, with the rubbing of my semen again and again, it was reduced into several particles, which gave birth to the sages known as Balakhilyas. They were illuming with the own lustre.

O Sage, all those sages, came to me lovingly calling me, “O Dear one, O Dear one”

Influenced with the desire of the lord Siva, Narada, spoke in anger to the sages named Balakhilyas.

Narada said, “All of you should go to the Gandhamadana mountain, don’t stop here, because you people are no more required here.

Going there, you perform penances and by so doing you would become excellent sages and pupils of Surya. I am thus, speaking at the command of Siva.

Brahma said, “At these words of the sage Narada, all the Balakhilyas, proceed on towards the Gandhamadana mountain, bowing in reverence to Siva.

O Excellent sage, thereafter Visnu and other gods reassured me and at the inspiration of the great sages I was rid of the panic.

At that point of time, I offered prayer to Siva, who is well-disposed towards his devotees, lord of all, who establishes the tasks of all and shatters the pride of the wicked people.

I prayed, “O God of gods, O Mahadeva, O Ocean of compassion, O Lord you are the creator of all, you are feeder of all besides being the destroyer.

As the bulls are tied with the rope, similarly, at your will, this mobile and immobile world is maintained. I have fully realised this.”

Thus speaking I offered my salutation to him with folded hands. Thereafter, Visnu and all other gods also eulogised Siva.

Listening to my humble prayer as well as that of Visnu and other gods, lord Siva was pleased.

O Sage, getting pleased, he freed me from fear as a result of which all were pleased and delighted.

## Chapter 50 - The fun and jokes

Brahma said, “O Narada, then I completed the remaining ceremonies of the marriage of Siva and Siva, in association with the sages.

The *Abhiseka* of his head was ceremoniously performed and both of them were made to see the Pole Star Dhruva, with respect.

Thereafter the ceremony of the *hrdayalambhana* was performed, followed by *Svastivacana.*

At the command of the Brahmanas, Siva applied Vermillion over the head of Parvati, as a result of which she attained the divine lustre.

Then at the command of Brahmanas, both Siva and Parvati were seated over a single *asana,* displaying the divine grace which delighted their devotees.

O Sage, then both of them having been seated over their respective *asanas,* at my command, performed the ceremony of *Samsrava-prasana* (licking of the remains of libation).

In this way the marriage according to the *yajna-vidhi* was completed, he gave away in charity cows to the *acarya* appropriately and gave away to others, several articles as the charities for welfare.

The Brahmana priests were thereafter given a hundred gold coins each. He also gave away to the people, crores of gems and several other articles in charity.

At that point of time, all the gods, besides the mobile and immobile beings were delighted at heart and the slogans of victory were shouted.

Welfare sounds were produced on all the sides. Various types of the musical instruments were played upon, the pleasant sound of which delighted all.

Visnu, together with me, besides the gods, sages and other people, with the permission of Himalaya then left for their respective abodes.

Then the ladies of the city of mountain, took Siva and Parvati to the place of Kubera or *Kokabara.*

All the damsels reaching there, adored the family deity with reverence and blissful festivities were celebrated all-round, with enthusiasm.

Then all the ladies took the newly weds Siva and Parvati to a decorated house, where they performed all the worldly rites.

Thereafter the damsels of the city of Giriraja, getting free from the welfare ceremonies took the bride and groom to their abode.

Shouting the slogans of victory, they untied the knot of the garments of the bride and the bridegroom. They were smiling at that time looking with side glances, and the hair of their bodies stood at ends.

Reaching their own respective houses, all the ladies looking at lord Siva, were extremely fascinated, praising their fortunes, thinking of Siva.

Siva looked extremely beautiful with the best of costumes, and could fascinate the minds of young damsels, besides being youthful.

He was wearing a smile over the delightful face, looked beautiful with his side glances, and was clad in gem-studded silken clothes.

At that point of time, sixteen divine damsels arrived there in order to have a look at Siva and Parvati.

They included Sarasvati, Laksmi, Savitri, Ganga, Aditi, Indrani, Lopamudra, Arundhati, Ahalya, Tulasi, Svaha, Rohini, Sanjana, Vasundhara and Rati.

Besides these there were charming and attractive virgins of the gods, Nagas, and the sages, who could count them?

Siva was seated over the gem-studded seat provided by them. Then all the damsels, jokingly spoke sweet words to Siva.

Sarasvati said, “O Mahadeva, you have achieve the chaste Sati who is dearer to you than your life. O Passionate one, you better forget all the miseries, by looking at her lotus like face.

Spend your time by embracing Sati. Thanks to my fervent wish, there will be no separation at any time between you both.

Laksmi said, “Discarding shyness, you better always hold Sati against your chest. Where is the shyness now, when your life was going to depart without her.”

Savitri said, “O Siva, you should henceforth, take your food, after feeding Sati. Don’t make her suffer in any way. You offer her the betel respectfully, after washing your face.”

Ganga said, “You decorate the hair of your wife with the comb of gold. There is no greater pleasure for a damsel, than this.”

Aditi said, “O Siva, you give wafer to Parvati for rinsing her mouth, after she finishes her food because it is difficult to achieve the love of the husband and wife.”

Indrani said, “The one for whom you had been lamenting, wandered here and there, getting confused, now you embrace your beloved Siva against ”your chest. Where lies the shyness in it?”

Lopamudra said, “O Siva, this is the tradition. After finishing dinner, one should go to bed after offering a betel to the wife.”

Arundhati said, “Mena did not want to give Parvati to you. It is I who could convince her in the matter and you have got her. You better get united with her.”

Ahalya said, “Shedding away the old age, you become extremely youthful, to enable Mena to respect you.”

Tulasi said, “O Lord, initially you disowned Sati, then burnt Kamadeva. Then why did you send Vasistha to the abode of Himalaya?”

Svaha said, “O Mahadeva, don’t feel disturbed. This is the usual conduct of the women during the time of marriage and they keep on joking.”

Rohini said, “O Lord well-versed in the art of making love, you fulfil the desire of Parvati. O Passionate one, you yourself cross the ocean of love of your beloved.”

Prthvi said, “O Lord, you are well-versed in reading the feelings of the passionate women. O Siva, who does not always protect, one’s own lord?”

Satarupa said, “The hungry man does not feel satisfied without eating the sweet and hearty food. O Siva, you better do everything to please a woman.”

Sanjana said, “Now Siva and Parvati should be sent to a lonely place. After making the bed for them. Then giving betel to them keep the lamp of gems, close by.”

Brahma said, “On hearing the words of the divine women, lord Siva, who was free from all the blemishes, was the preceptor of the best of the *yogis,* spoke himself to them.”

Siva said, “Don’t talk like this, you are the mothers of the universe. How could your son be so fickle minded?”

Brahma said, “Hearing the words of Siva, the wives of the gods felt ashamed. They became excited and looked like painted figures in the pictures.

Then lord Siva, consuming the sweets and performing *acamana* felt extremely delighted in the company of his wife. Both of then chewed the betel with camphor.

## Chapter 51 - Revival of Kamadeva

Brahma said, “At that point of time Rati, finding the appropriate moment, spoke to lord Siva, who is compassionate on the miserable people, with a delightful heart.”

Rati said, “O Lord, after accepting Parvati, you have achieved the fortune, which is difficult to achieve. You reduced my husband to ashes uselessly.

Kindly restore my husband back to me who had been the lord of my life. Please remove my distress, caused by separation.

All the people are happy in the celebration of this marriage. O Siva, I happen to be the only exception, having been deprived of my husband.

O God, O Siva, be pleased with me and restore my husband to me. O Friend of the down trodden, O Supreme lord, you make your words truthful.

Who is there in this mobile and immobile world, to relieve me of my misery? Realising this be compassionate on me. O Lord, on the occasion of the blissful marriage ceremony, being compassionate over the depressed people, you kindly provide me also an opportunity to be happy.

It is only after the bringing back to life my husband, that you can purposefully enjoy the company of your beloved Parvati.

You are the Supreme Lord, therefore, you are competent enough to do everything. O Lord of all, what more can I speak, you bring my husband back to life again.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, she placed the ashes of Kamadeva, bound is a cloth, before Siva. Then she started crying before Siva saying, “O Lord, O Lord.”

Listening to the cries of Rati all the goddesses like Sarasvati and others also started weeping. Feeling painful they said.

The goddesses said, “You are known to be well-disposed towards your devotees. You are friendly to the depressed people, you are the ocean of compassion. Salutation to you. You kindly please Rati by bringing Kama back to life.

Brahma said, “On hearing this, Siva, the Ocean of mercy, was pleased and he at once showered his compassion, on her.

With the casting of the gaze of Siva over the ashes, Kamadeva, having the same form, costumes, symptums, and beauty appeared from the ashes.

He had the same smile over his face, the same size, holding a bow and arrow in his hands, looking at her husband in that form, Rati bowed in reverence to Siva.

Siva, who restored the life of Kamadeva the husband of Rati, who feeling successful in her desire, offered with folded hands, her prayer to lord Siva.

Listening to the prayer of Kamadeva and Rati, Siva was pleased with his heart melting with pity and said.

Siva said, “O Self bom Kama, I am pleased with the prayer of both of you. You better ask for a boon. I shall grant you whatever is desired by you.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Siva, Kamadeva felt delightful and with folded hands, he spoke in choked voice.”

Kamadeva said, “O Mahadeva- the god of gods, the ocean of mercy, of Lord, in case you are really pleased with me, then make me delightful.

O Lord, you kindly forgive me for my earlier fault. Let me have love for your devotees as well as devotion to you.”

Brahma said, “Listening to the words of Kamadeva, Siva- the ocean of mercy smilingly accepted his prayer.”

Siva said, “O Intelligent Kama, I am pleased with you. Don’t be afraid. You go and stand besides Visnu.”

Brahma said, “On hearing these words of Siva, Kamadeva, offering his salutation to the lord, circumambulating him, offered prayer to him. Then he went to Visnu and offering his salutation to him as well as the other gods with folded hands and then he took his seat.

Talking to Kamadeva, all the gods blessed him. Besides Visnu and other gods, with their minds devoted to Siva said to Kama.

The gods said, “You were burnt by Siva, who with his compassion has brought you back to life.

There is none in the world to cause pleasure or pain to anyone, because a person has to reap the reward of his own actions. A person is (bom), brought up, married and enters into the mother’s womb. Who can stop it?”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking and honouring him, Visnu and all the gods who were successful in their task, stayed there with pleasure.

Kamadeva also feeling pleased, lived there. At that point of time the words like victory, salutation and well-done, were heard.

Then Siva reaching his abode, making Parvati to take her seat to her left, made her eat the sweets.

Then Siva who was engaged in performing the local traditions, completing the formalities there, then taking permission from Mena and Himalaya, went to the place of the bride’s house.

O Sage, reaching there, huge celebrations were made. With the reciting of the Vedic *mantras* four types of musical instruments were played upon.

Reaching from there at his own place, Siva, offered his salutation to Brahma, Visnu and the sages, while the gods reciprocated to the lord Siva.

The Vedic hymns, relating to victory, salutation, removal of obstructions, were recited there.

At that point of time, Brahma, Visnu, Indra, all the gods, besides the ***Siddhas,*** demi-gods, and the Nagas eulogised Siva separately.

The gods said, “O Lord, you are the base of all the *lokas,* having the name victory (*Jaya),* Mahesvara, Rudra, Mahadeva, Visvambhara, and O Lord, victory to you.

O Husband of Kali, O Lord, Increaser of bliss, Tryambaka, the lord of *Maya,* O Omniscient one, victory to you.

You are without attributes, selfless, devoid of cause, O Omnipresent, O Playful sport of all, the one who can assume all the forms, salutation to you.

O Lord, granter of the noble desires to your devotees, O Merciful one, O form of bliss, the one who could assume any form at will, you can assume any form, be victorious, be victorious. O Kind, O All souled one, friend of the distressed and, abode of mercy, O Lord of illusion, free from blemishes, your body is beyond the speech and the mind.”

Brahma said, “Visnu and other gods, thus lovingly offered prayer to Siva- the lord of Parvati.

O Narada, Siva, who had assumed the human body playfully, showered boons and honoured to all those present there.

O Dear one, then Visnu and other gods, took leave of Siva delightfully, and returned to their respective abodes. All of them were duly honoured and their faces beamed with pleasure.”

## Chapter 52 - Serving of feast to the marriage party and retiring of Siva to the bed

1\. Brahma said, “O Dear one, the extremely and fortunate and intelligent Giriraja Himalaya, decorated his courtyard for serving food to the people of the marriage party.

The place was broomed and cleaned and plastered (with cow dung). Several types of fragrances were sprinkled there, for making it attractive.

Thereafter, Himalaya invited all the gods and others who had accompanied Siva, delightfully for the taking of food, through his sons and the mountains.

Listening to the invitation of Himalaya, all the gods including Visnu and other gods, besides Siva went for taking food.

Himalaya, feeling overjoyed made special seating arrangements for Siva, Visnu and other gods, quite respectfully, inside the house and made them occupy the excellent seats.

Several types of dishes were served and then Himalaya, with folded hands, spoke in humble tone. “You kindly have your food.”

When the gods like Visnu and others were so honoured, then they started taking their food, placing Siva in the forefront.

Then all of them collectively, having been seated in lines, smilingly started taking their food individually.

Nandi, Bhrngi, Virabhadra and their *ganas* were seated separately. All of them kept on taking their food with great curiosity.

Indra and other gods, besides the Lokapalas, appeared well-decorated and kept on taking food cutting jokes mutually.

All the sages, Brahmanas, and the *Rsis* like Bhrgu, sat in separate lines and started consuming food lovingly.

Thereafter, the *ganas* of Candi, after finishing their food started joking with one another joyfully.

In this way Visnu and other gods after taking food, rinsing the mouths and washing the hands, lovingly retired to their respective *asramas.*

At the command of Mena, the chaste women, offering prayers to Siva with devotion, led him to a decorated apartment.

Getting seated over the decorated gem- studded lion-throne, Siva glanced at the charming beauty of the place.

The palace was illumined by hundreds of burning lamps of gems. All the vases kept therein were studded with gems and the place was decorated with jewels and the diamonds.

The house looked charming with mirrors of gems. The white fly-whisks had been placed there. It was decorated with the garlands of jewels and diamonds.

It was quite charming, beautiful, decorated with numerous paintings made with enormous imaginations.

The influence of that place had increased after the boon of Siva. It appeared like the Sivaloka itself.

The place issued several types of fragrance. The sandal and *aguru* pastes were kept there. The bed of the flowers had been arranged.

Visvakarma had arranged several paintings in the same. Several diamond garlands had been arranged therein.

At that place the pleasant Vaikuntha had been built there. At places Brahmaloka and at places besides the cities for Lokaplas had also been made.

At places, the mount Kailasa, the abode of Indra and Sivaloka at the top were shown.

Observing the surprising types of abode in this way, Siva was pleased, praising Giriraja Himalaya.

Then Lord Siva went to sleep with pleasure over the comfortable gem-studded bed.

Himalaya arranged for the food of all his relative and friends, who had been invited by him, and then he finished the other tasks.

On the one hand Himalaya was engaged in old jobs in the palace while on the other hand Siva was sleeping. In this way the night was over, and the time of dawn arrived.

All the people, with enthusiasm and courage, played on several types of musical instruments.

All the gods including Visnu and others woke up. Reciting the names of their family deities, all of them got ready.

Keeping their vehicles ready all of them got ready to proceed on journey to Kailasa. Then they deputed Dharma to Siva.

At the command of lord Visnu, the *yogi* arrived in the cottage of Siva, spoke to him, who was the lord of *yogis.*

Dharma said, O Lord of the *Pramathas.* You may face welfare. You get up, get up, and grace all the people in the inner- apartment.”

Brahma said, “Thus listening to the words of Dharmaraja, Siva laughed. He looked at Dharmaraja with a compassionate eye and left the bed.

Then he spoke to Dharmaraja, smilingly. “You can go. I shall follow you shortly”.

At these words of Siva, Dharmaraja went back to the inner- apartments. Lord Siva was also ready to go there.

On learning this, the entire group of ladies reached there with enthusiasm and with their minds devoted at the feet of Siva, they started singing the welfare songs.

Then Siva, who had been well-versed with the tradition, performing the essentials of the early morning, went to the inner apartment, with the permission of Himalaya.

O Sage, huge celebrations were held at that time, in which besides the reciting of the Vedic hymns, the four types of musical instruments were also played upon.

Reaching his place Siva, offered his salutation to sages, Brahma and Visnu. Other gods bowed before him in reverence.

At that point of time, slogans of victory, and the auspicious sound of the Vedic *mantras* was heard. There was a huge tumult.

## Chapter 53 - Siva’s return after marriage

Brahma said, “Thereafter all the gods like Visnu and others, besides the sages, finishing their essential assignments, got ready to go to the house of Himalaya.

Then Himalaya, after taking bath, adored his family god, called the relatives in the city, delightfully went to the inner apartment.

Adoring Siva, he, they said, “You stay here in my abode with the members of the marriage party for a few more days.

With my meeting with you, I have become graceful as well as successful, because you arrived in my abode with all the gods.”

In this way Himalaya spoke variously and offering his salutation with folded hands, he invited them as well as Siva.

Thereafter Siva accompanied with Visnu and other gods, besides the sages they reached in the abode of Himalaya and said.

The gods said, “O Excellent mountain, you are graceful, you possess great glory. There is no auspicious person, comparable to you in the three worlds.

Because, lord Siva, who is the only support of the noble people, the Supreme Brahman and the one who is well-disposed towards his devotees, has kindly arrived with his devotees.

O Giriraja, you got a place for us to stay which is quite beautiful. You honoured us all appropriately and served us the unique type of food which was beyond description.

10\. Such type of hospitality would not be a surprise at a place, where the goddess Siva- Ambika is present. Everything has been completed and we are graceful today, by arriving here.”

Brahma said, “In this way, they started praising one another. Several types of celebrations were made. Sound of the shouting of victory as well as the reciting the Vedic *mantras* was heard.

The welfare songs were sung. The *apsaras* started dancing. The bards started singing the praises. All of them were well rewarded with riches.

Then Himalaya took Siva to his home, various types of food was served and jubilant celebrations were held.

For the purpose of serving food, delightfully Siva was made to accompany them with his kiths and kins.

The feet of Siva, Visnu, myself (Brahma) and other gods besides the sages were washed.

Besides the feet of those people, present in the *mandapa* were also washed and they were made to sit at the appropriate places.

The juicy items of food were then served by Himalaya to them. Then Brahma, Visnu, and all others took food with Siva.

Then the ladies of the city indulged in the customary utterance of foul and abusive words, while laughing, jingling and peeping at all of them.

O Narada, they took their food and water, washed the hands, rinsed the mouths, taking leave of Himalaya, went back to their respective places.

O Sage, in this way, even on the third day, Giriraja, honoured all by presenting them with gifts etc.

On the arrival of the fourth day, they performed the ceremony of *Caturthi-karma* in an appropriate manner without which the marriage ceremony would have been incomplete.

At that point of time several types of celebrations, shouts of appreciation, slogans of victory, the dance and the musical performances were held.

On the fifth day, all the gods delightfully, went to Himalaya and prayed him for the grant of leave.

On hearing this, Himalaya spoke to the gods with folded hands, “You stay here with me, for some time more.”

Thus speaking, Himalaya made, the gods, Siva, Visnu and myself (Brahma) to keep on staying there for several days.

In this way when they lived there for long, then the gods sent *Saptarsis* to Himalaya.

Talking appropriately to Mena and Himalaya, they convinced them and praising Siva, they explained the *Siva-tattva* to him.

O Sage, with their arguments, Siva agreed to proceed on the journey. Then Siva went to Giriraja accompanied with Siva.

When Siva, the lord of the gods was about to leave, then Mena started crying aloud and she spoke to the lord of compassion.

Mena said, “O Compassionate one, kindly protect my Siva. You kindly ignore a thousand faults of Parvati.

This daughter of mine is devoted at your feet for many births. Except you, she does not think of any one else while sleeping or awake.

O Conqueror of the death, getting absorbed in your devotion, delightfully shedding tears from her eyes, she becomes emotional. On hearing your denouncement, she becomes silent as though dead.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking, Menaka, dedicating her daughter to Siva, became unconscious in his presence.

Thereafter advising Mena appropriately, taking leave from her and Himalaya, holding enormous celebrations, accompanied with the gods, Siva started for the journey.

Wishing well of Himalaya, all the gods making Siva as the leader, proceeded on the journey, silently.

In the orchard outside the city of Himalaya all the gods waited for the arrival of Siva and Parvati.

O Excellent sage, the journey of the marriage party of Siva has been described. Now you listen to the separation as well as the celebration of the journey of Siva.

## Chapter 54 - The departure of the marriage party- duties of a chaste wife defined

Brahma said, “Then the seven sages spoke to the lord of the mountain, “Make arrangements for the departure of your daughter today itself.”

O Great sage, on hearing this, Himalaya, realising the separation of Siva from her parents, felt painful for a long time, realising the separation of Parvati from them.

After some time he became conscious, and accepting the proposal, he sent a message to Mena.

O Sage, listening to the message of Himalaya, Mena, who was engrossed in the thought of the pleasure and the pain, got ready to send off Parvati.

O Sage, Mena the wife of Himalaya observed all the formalities prescribed in the Vedas as well as the family traditions, holding celebrations.

Girija was with the permission of the king decorated with gem-studded gold ornaments and the silken garments of twelve types.

As per the desire of Mena, each and every chaste Brahmana woman, instructed Parvati in the duties of the chaste wife.

The Brahmana lady said, “O Parvati, listen to my words, with love, which are the cause of righteousness being blissful in this as well as the other world. It makes the listener comfortable. Therefore you lovingly listen to my world.

A chaste lady is always graceful, no other woman is adored before her. She purifies all the *lokas* and destroys all the sins.

O Siva, a damsel who serves her husband like the god, she, enjoying all the comforts in this world and ultimately achieves *moksa* with her husband.

Savitri, Lopamudra, Arundhati, Sandilya, Satarupa, Anusuya, Laksmi, Svadha, Sati, Sanjna, Sumati, Sraddha, Mena and Svaha, are all the chaste ladies. There are many others the names of whom have not been mentioned for fear of making lengthy the list of their chastity.

Lord Siva is compassionate to the depressed, worthy of adoration and the goal of the good, should be served by you always.

The duties of the chaste lady are very vast, which have been defined in the Vedas and other scriptures. There is no other *vrata* so admirable than this.

A chaste woman would take food after her husband has taken food. She should stand up when Siva is standing.

She should go to sleep after her husband does so but she has to wake up before her husband wakes up. She should always work for the welfare of her husband.

Î Siva, you should never go before Siva without adorning yourself with ornaments. She should not wear the ornaments when the husband is away (or is out of town).

A chaste lady should never call the name of her husband. She should not be angry when the husband is annoyed and even when she is belaboured, she should express happiness saying, “O Lord, beat me, beat me more.”

When she is called, she should at once attend on him leaving aside all the jobs, and should come to her husband with folded hands, offering her salutation to him.

She should not stand at the gate for long and should not visit the house of others (alone). She should not reveal the secrets of the house-hold to others.

The material for adoration should be kept ready without being asked to do so. She should wait for the time, what is to be done and what is not to be done.

Without the permission of the husband, she should not proceed on pilgrimage. The cultural celebrations should not proceed from a distance.

A woman desirous of proceeding on pilgrimage should sip the water with which the feet of her husband are washed, because the said water represents the water of all the *tirthas* and holy spots. There is no doubt about it.

The chaste woman should consume the left overs of food of her husband besides the sweets etc. taking them to be the auspicious *prasada* of the lord.

She should not take food, without serving the gods, Pitrs, the guests, the servants, cows and saintly mendicants.

She should be efficient in collecting the material for use in the house-hold. She should always be pleasing in her mind, should not spend more than the income and should always be engaged in the service of her husband. Such a type of woman is indeed a goddess.

A chaste women should not perform any *vrata,* fasting etc. without the permission of her husband, because if she does not do so, she cannot earn the auspicious reward and she falls in the hell after her death. While the husband is engaged sportively or is comfortably seated, she should not disturb him or ask him to get up for attending some house-hold work.

Irrespective of the husband being impatient, distressed, sick or senile, happy or unhappy, the husband should never be transgressed.

When a woman is in period, she should not show her face to anyone for three nights and should not shout till she is purified after her bath.

After taking her bath, she should first of all have a look at her husband alone or otherwise, she should look at the sun, thinking about her husband.

She should always use and should not forsake turmeric, vermilion, saffron, collyrium, a blouse, the betel, the ornaments, brushing and plaiting the hair, bangles and the ear-rings.

A chaste woman will never associate herself intimately with washer woman, a harlot, female ascetic and a fallen woman.

She should never talk to a woman, who is inimical to her husband. She should never remain alone, nor should she take bath naked.

A chaste lady shall never sleep over a mortar, thrashing rod, a broom, a grinding stone, near the door, a machine or a threshold.

Except at the time of sexual intercourse, she should not display her strength or initiative. She will like what her husband is interested in.

A chaste lady shall be happy when her husband is happy and shall be sorry, when her husband is sorry.

The chaste lady who remains equanimous in the time of pleasure and pain. Her mind should remain unblemished and she should keep patience always.

When *ghee,* oil, salt and other articles are exhausted in the house-hold, the chaste lady should not trouble her husband informing that the things have exhausted.

O Celestial goddess, for a chaste lady, her husband is for better than even Brahma, Visnu and Siva. But you have Siva as your husband.

The lady who disregarding the desire of her husband performs *vratas*, fasting etc. she actually reduces the life of her husband, and falls in the hell after her death.

A woman who gets enraged at the words of her husband, and gives reply in return, she is reborn as a bitch in the village or a she-jackal in the lonely forest.

A chaste lady should not be seated over the high pedestal of husband. She should not keep company of the wicked people. She should not talk to her husband in panic.

She should not denounce her husband. She should not quarrel. She should not shout in the presence of the preceptors nor should she laugh before them.

Finding the husband coming from outside, she should please her husband with food, water, betel, costumes, pressing of feet, sweet talk, wiping out the sweat, and other noble actions. A woman who pleases her husband thus, she earns the merit of pleasing all the three worlds.

The father, brother and the son, bring up or feed the daughter, sister or mother respectively for sometime, while the husband has to maintain her wife forever, therefore, she should adore him always.

For a woman, the husband is a god, besides being the preceptor, *Dharmatirthas* and *vrata.* Therefore a woman leaving everything, should adore her husband.

An evil minded woman, who leaving her husband, unites herself with others, she becomes an owl in the next birth living in the cavity of a tree.

A woman, who, after having been beaten by her husband, tries to beat back, she in her next birth becomes a tigress or a cat. A woman who looks at other persons with side glance, she becomes squint eyed.

A woman who in the absence of her husband, consumes the sweets alone, she is reborn as a she-pig in the village consuming the refuse.

A woman who talks to her husband with disrespect, she becomes dumb in her next birth. The one who becomes jealous of the co-wife of her husband, she is always reborn as an unfortunate woman.

A woman, who escaping the eye of husband looks greedily at other person, she becomes one-eyed, and ugly.

As the dead body becomes inauspicious after sometime, similarly a woman without a husband cannot be purified even after the bath.

Graceful are the mothers and the fathers in the world in which there is a chaste lady living.

Because of the merits of the chaste woman, the manes of the father, the mother and the husband’s races upto three generations enjoy all the pleasures in the heaven.

The wicked women, by their evil ways, make three generations of their parents and husband to suffer for long.

Wherever the feet of the chaste woman fall on earth, the land gets purified and the sins are washed out,

There is no doubt that the all-pervading lord, the Sun, the moon, and even the wind, remain desirous of touching the body of a chaste woman in order to purify themselves. The one who purifies others also feels that he has been purified today.

The wife is the base of the household, besides that of the comforts. With the cooperation of the wife *dharma* is achieved and there is the increase in the progeny.

One finds women with exquisite beauty and comely nature, in almost every house, but a chaste woman can be had by the grace of Siva alone.

The present and the future could be overcome by means of the wife alone. The auspicious deeds concerning the gods, manes, guests, cannot be performed without a wife.

He is the householder in reality in which there is a chaste lady. The other people are overpowered by the women, like an old demoness.

As the body is purified by having a bath in the Ganga, similarly the chaste woman, purifies everyone whosoever has a look at her.

On the other hand a woman who has a god as her husband, both the husband and wife are treated to be like Siva and Siva. Therefore both of them should be adored.

O Paravti, such a husband is the form of *omkara.* The wife is Sruti, the husband is the penance the woman is Ksama (forgiveness); the husband is the reward, while the woman is the noble action, therefore both the husband and the wife are graceful.

O Parvati, in this way I have narrated the *dharma* of a chaste woman. Now you listen from me their divisions and classifications.

O Goddess, the chaste woman are of four types, the mention of whom is always remover of the sins.

There are the best, the middle ones, the inferior and the very inferior. The characteristics of each one of them is being explained by me and you listen to me attentively.

The woman who witnesses her own husband even in dream, and never looks at the other’s husbands, she is treated as the best of the chaste ladies.

O Parvati, the one who because of her noble wisdom looks at other men like her father, brother or the son, she is called middling type of the chaste woman.

O Parvati, the woman with noble character, who possessing the knowledge of her *dharma* does not fall in evil way, she is known as the chaste woman of the degraded type.

A woman who does not involve herself in adultery, because of the fear of her race, she is called degraded one by the ancient *acaryas.*

O Siva, thus these four types of chaste women, remove all the sins and purify all the people in this as well as the future world.

With the influence of the chaste woman, the wife of the sage *Atri,* at the prayer of the three gods brought back to life a Brahmana, who was killed because of the curse of Varaha.

O Siva, O Girija, leaning about all this, you should always serve your husband, who fulfills all the desires.

You are the mother of the universe, besides being the great goddess. You are the wife of Siva. By remembering you the women become chaste.

O Parvati, O Gentle lady, for you, the words spoken are of no avail. Still I have spoken out these words following the worldly traditions.”

Brahma said, “Thus speaking the Brahmana lady, stopped, bowing to her in reverence. On the other hand Parvati- the beloved of Siva was very much pleased.”

## Chapter 55 - Siva returns to Kailasa
